Title: Head of operations
Description:
****Job Description:****
**Job summary:**
The Head of Operations (HO Operations) is responsible for the end-to-end operational performance of the subsidiary, covering spares distribution, technical support, training, Part 145 maintenance/repair activities, equipment repair, and contract management. The role ensures operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and a strong safety culture while supporting the development of multi-service support offers to customers across the region.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**
Operations Leadership
  
  

* Lead and coordinate all operational functions: spares distribution, technical support, Part 145 workshop, equipment repair, and training delivery
* Ensure operational plans are aligned with the subsidiary's business objectives and customer commitments
* Drive performance through clear KPIs, structured governance, and regular operational reviews

Part 145 & Technical Support
  
  

* Ensure the Part 145 maintenance organization operates in full compliance with applicable civil/military airworthiness regulations
* Oversee technical support activities, ensuring timely and quality resolution of customer technical requests
* Maintain strong relationships with airworthiness authorities and Airbus Helicopters engineering support

Spares & Equipment Repair
  
  

* Ensure efficient spares distribution processes, inventory accuracy, and on-time delivery performance
* Oversee equipment repair operations, ensuring turnaround times and quality standards are met

Training
  
  

* Ensure training programs (technical, operational) are delivered to required standards and support customer capability development
* Coordinate with training partners/academies as relevant

Contract Management & Support Offers
  
  

* Oversee contract execution, ensuring deliverables, SLAs, and commercial terms are met
* Support the development and structuring of multi-service support offers (bundled MRO, training, spares, technical support packages) in collaboration with Sales/Business Development

Safety Culture & Structure
  
  

* Champion a strong, visible safety culture across all operational activities - technical, workshop, and training environments
* Ensure robust risk management, incident reporting, and continuous improvement processes are in place
* Build and maintain structured, documented processes and procedures across all operational domains, ensuring consistency, auditability, and scalability as the organization grows
* Lead by example on compliance, discipline, and rigor in day-to-day operations

People Management
  
  

* Manage, coach, and develop operational team leads and their teams
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**Requirements:**

* Strong experience in Support & Services ideally in Aeronautics.
* Significant experience in MRO/aviation operations management, ideally in a helicopter or complex technical environment
* Strong knowledge of Part 145 requirements and airworthiness regulatory frameworks
* Proven track record leading multi-disciplinary operational teams (technical, logistics, training)
* Experience in contract management and support of commercial/service offer development
* Demonstrated commitment to safety culture and structured operational management
* Strong leadership, organizational, and stakeholder management skills
* Good Communication skills
* Strong network internal and external

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

The role must convert requirements into supportable outcomes, challenge weak designs, and leave clear documentation and knowledge with the organization.

Technology project and delivery management Integrated planning, milestones and critical-path management RAID, dependency and change control Multi-vendor and cross-functional coordination Technical governance, testing and production readiness Executive reporting, escalation and delivery acceptance
  
  

* Required Experience

5+ years of directly relevant professional experience in it delivery manager or a closely related technical discipline Hands-on delivery experience across the main capabilities defined for the IT Delivery Manager profile Experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions under architecture, security, operational and change controls Ability to explain personal contribution, technical decisions, trade-offs, delivery evidence and production outcomes Experience working across internal teams, technology vendors and implementation partners

Own hands-on technical delivery for the assigned IT Delivery Manager scope Translate approved requirements and architecture into implementable designs, configurations, code, controls or delivery artefacts Apply the defined capabilities using secure, maintainable, testable and supportable engineering practices Identify technical risks, dependencies, gaps and decisions early, and drive them to closure with accountable stakeholders Support end-to-end validation, production readiness, troubleshooting and controlled handover Maintain version-controlled documentation, decisions, runbooks and knowledge-transfer material

Title: Information Security Program Manager
Description:
**Key Responsibilities**

 Plan, lead and manage the end-to-end ISO/IEC 27001 program, including ISMS scope definition, timelines, budget, resources and stakeholder reporting.

 Review existing information security policies, standards, procedures and records to assess completeness and alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC 27002.

 Examine current security practices and controls across people, processes and technology to evaluate how effectively they operate in practice.

 Conduct a detailed gap analysis against ISO/IEC 27001 requirements (Clauses 4–10 and Annex A controls) and produce a prioritized remediation roadmap.

 Develop and maintain the information security risk management methodology, and conduct periodic technical risk assessments of applications, infrastructure, networks, cloud services and medical and clinical systems.

 Maintain the information security risk register and risk treatment plans, and track the implementation of treatments with risk and control owners.

 Coordinate periodic vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and configuration reviews, and ensure findings are risk-rated, remediated and verified.

 Establish and manage a CIS-based compliance program, adopting the CIS Critical Security Controls (v8) and CIS Benchmarks as secure configuration baselines for operating systems, databases, network devices, cloud platforms and applications.

 Conduct periodic CIS compliance assessments using automated scanning tools (e.g., CIS-CAT Pro, Tenable, Qualys), track compliance scores against agreed targets, and coordinate remediation or documented exceptions with system owners.

 Prepare and maintain the Statement of Applicability (SoA) and the documentation required for the ISMS, including the ISMS scope, policy, objectives and supporting procedures.

 Assess information security risks of third parties and suppliers, and ensure appropriate security requirements are included in contracts.

 Establish and run the ISMS internal audit program and management reviews, and track

non conformities and corrective actions through to closure.

 Prepare CLIENT for Stage 1 and Stage 2 re-certification audits and ongoing surveillance audits, coordinate with the certification body, and lead the response to any findings.

 Define information security KPIs and metrics, and generate and present periodic (monthly and quarterly) reports covering risk posture, control effectiveness, vulnerability and remediation status, CIS compliance scores, security incidents, audit findings and awareness completion, to support management reviews and decision-making.

 Drive information security awareness and training so that staff understand their responsibilities within the ISMS.

 Ensure the ISMS aligns with CLIENT policies and applicable UAE and Dubai Government information security and data protection requirements, including the UAE Information Assurance Standards, Dubai Electronic Security Center (DESC) requirements and healthcare data regulations.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

 Support the implementation, maintenance and certification of the IT Service Management System (ISO/IEC 20000-1) and the Business Continuity Management System (ISO 22301), working closely with the IT Service Management and Business Continuity teams.

 Align ISMS controls with ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, capacity, availability and supplier management.

 Contribute to business impact analysis (BIA), the definition of recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) and continuity risk assessments for critical IT services and information assets.

 Support the development, review and testing of IT service continuity, disaster recovery and business continuity plans, and ensure lessons learned are captured and acted upon.

 Identify opportunities for an integrated management system across ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including shared policies, documentation, internal audits and management reviews.

 Support internal and external audits for ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301, including evidence preparation and follow-up of corrective actions.

**Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.

 [7–10]+ years of experience in information security, including at least [3] years leading ISMS, security risk or compliance programs.

 Proven track record of leading at least one ISO/IEC 27001 implementation or certification.

 In-depth knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27002 and ISO/IEC 27005, and of risk

assessment methodologies.

 Hands-on experience implementing and assessing the CIS Critical Security Controls and CIS Benchmarks, including the use of configuration compliance scanning tools.

 Solid technical understanding of networks, operating systems, cloud platforms, identity and access management, and security technologies (e.g., firewalls, SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners).

 Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 20000-1 and ISO 22301; hands-on implementation or audit experience with these standards is a strong advantage.

 Familiarity with UAE and Dubai information security regulations and healthcare data protection requirements.

 Experience in healthcare or government environments is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

 ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer and/or Lead Auditor

 CISSP, CISM or CISA

 ISO/IEC 20000-1 and/or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (advantageous)

 CRISC or an equivalent risk management certification (advantageous)

 PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification

**Key Competencies**

 Program and change management

 Risk-based thinking and sound technical judgement

 Stakeholder management and ability to influence without direct authority

 Analytical thinking and attention to detail

 Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Arabic is an advantage)

 Facilitation, coaching and training delivery

Pay: AED22,000.00 - AED25,000.00 per month

Title: Project Manager - Execution & Delivery
Description:
**Position title**: Project Manager (Execution & Delivery)

**Engagement type**: Contract (1099)

**Location**: Houston, TX (primarily on-site. Regular in-person presence is required due to the cross-functional coordination and project execution responsibilities of the role.)

**Receives work from**: Chief of Staff & Head of Execution

**Works closely with**: Technical, Commercial, and Corporate functions.

**Hours**: 20 – 30 hours per week

**Compensation**: $50/hr -$75/hr Hourly / contract rate, commensurate with experience

**About Cemvita**

Cemvita is a Houston-based industrial biotechnology company using biology and AI to discover, develop, and deploy new bio-based solutions. We are a fast-moving team running a mix of customer-funded programs, product commercialization, and grant-funded R&D, all at the same time. The pace is high, the work is cross-functional, and getting things done cleanly and on time matters more than titles.

**Why we are hiring**

We are bringing in a hands-on Project Manager to own the ground-level delivery of our projects so that leadership can focus on strategy, partners, and fundraising.

**Role summary**

The Project Manager keeps our projects moving. You will build the plans, track the details, chase the follow-ups, prepare the materials, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks across a portfolio of technical, customer, and grant programs. You are the person who always knows what is due, who owns it, and what is blocking it, and ensures commitments are followed through to completion..

You will serve as an independent contractor supporting the Chief of Staff & Head of Execution. Cemvita will establish project objectives, priorities, deliverables, and deadlines, while the contractor will independently determine the appropriate methods and means for completing the agreed services, subject to project requirements and coordination needs.

**What you will own (essential functions/core responsibilities)**

***1. Project planning and tracking***

* Build and maintain project plans, schedules, timelines, and Gantt charts for active programs.
* Keep one clear source of truth for tasks, owners, due dates, and status across projects.
* Track milestones, dependencies, and critical-path items; flag slippage early.

***2. Day-to-day follow-through***

* Chase the details that keep work moving: samples, shipments, tracking numbers, supplies, and deliverable status.
* Confirm handoffs happen, action items close, and open items do not go stale.
* Be the reliable follow-up so leadership does not have to personally chase routine items.

***3. Meetings and materials***

* Prepare agendas, meeting notes, action logs, and status updates.
* Build clean project materials and simple status reports for internal and partner reviews.
* Keep shared workspaces, trackers, and project folders current and organized.

***4. Coordination and communication***

* Coordinate across the internal team and with external partners and vendors to keep work on schedule.
* Serve as an execution-level point of contact for scheduling, follow-ups, and logistics on assigned programs.
* Surface risks, blockers, and decisions that need leadership attention, with enough context to act.

***5. Scope, documentation, and closeout support***

* Help keep projects inside their agreed scope, budget, and timeline, and flag when something drifts out of scope.
* Support documentation, records, and formal closeout for completed or paused projects.
* Support grant and proposal logistics (for example, assembling documents and tracking submission milestones).

**Where the lines are**

To set clear expectations from day one, here is what this role owns and what it does not.

***This role owns (day-to-day delivery)***

* Building and maintaining project plans, schedules, and action logs for active programs.
* Chasing follow-ups: samples, shipments, tracking numbers, supplies, deliverable status.
* Preparing meeting materials, agendas, notes, and keeping shared workspaces current.
* Coordinating across the team and external partners to keep work moving on schedule.

***This role does NOT own***

* Setting technical scope or making scientific/technical decisions (owned by technical leads).
* Company strategy, priorities, or portfolio stop/start calls (owned by CEO and Chief of Staff).
* Managing people or directing other employees' time (stays with their managers).
* Finance, contracts, or legal ownership (supports Finance and Legal, does not replace them).

**What we are looking for**

***Must-have***

* 3+ years of project coordination or project management experience, ideally in a technical, scientific, engineering, laboratory, or manufacturing environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through: you track many moving pieces at once and nothing slips.
* Comfortable working hands-on across both detailed coordination activities and broader project deliverables; no task is too small.
* Clear, direct, professional communicator, in writing and in person.
* Proficient with Microsoft 365 (Teams, Planner, SharePoint, Excel, Outlook)
* Ability to work on-site at Cemvita's Houston location as required to perform the essential functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation
* Self-directed and dependable: can take a goal and run with it without being managed closely.

***Nice-to-have***

* Background or coursework in a technical, life-sciences, or engineering field (helpful for understanding the work).
* Experience supporting customer-funded programs, grants, or vendor coordination.
* Exposure to a startup or other fast-changing, lean environment.
* Familiarity with project tools and light automation (Planner, Power Automate, Copilot or similar).

**How the engagement works**

* This engagement is a contract assignment based on defined project needs and deliverables. Any future employment opportunity would be evaluated separately based on business needs and would not be guaranteed
* Priorities come from the Chief of Staff & Head of Execution; you own how the work gets done and delivered

**How we operate — Cemvita core values (the FUEL)**

* First-Principles Action — simplify complexity, question assumptions, and act with clarity and speed.
* Unconventional Curiosity — explore what others overlook, keep learning, and find better solutions.
* Extremophile Resilience — operate under pressure, adapt fast, and keep momentum through challenge.
* Legacy Builders — build lasting systems, knowledge, and relationships, not short-term wins.

**To apply:** Send a résumé and a short note on a project you personally kept on track. We move quickly and will start conversations on a rolling basis.

Cemvita is committed to equal opportunity and considers qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Pay: $50.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

**About Yalla Bullion**
Yalla Bullion is a digital-first retail bullion dealer, bringing the experience of buying and selling gold and silver online, through our e-commerce store and a wider digital platform. Headquartered in Dubai, we are here to make wealth preservation as easy as ordering a Careem by combining the world's oldest store of value with the high-speed efficiency of modern technology and distribution.
  
  
Yalla Bullion LLC is part of Goldstrom Group. Together we leverage 250+ years of collective expertise and a global "Mine to Market" infrastructure that ensures world-class liquidity and rock-solid trust.
  
  
With a team equipped with deep bullion retail and e-commerce expertise, we use proprietary technology and data to deliver a best-in-class customer experience that sets us apart from our competition.
  
  
We aren't looking for siloed staff ; we are looking for "Builders." We value energy, small-business grit, and those who take pride in building teams and processes.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As Operations Lead you will own the customer journey from first enquiry to delivered order, and every touchpoint in between. That covers customer service, inventory, risk, fulfilment and delivery. You'll run the day-to-day so the business runs like clockwork, and you'll lead, train and upskill the customer service team to deliver world-class service.
  
  
This role suits someone with a warm, people-first personality and a precise, process-driven mind: someone who genuinely enjoys looking after customers and their team, takes pride in getting the detail right every time, and thrives on managing the daily rhythm of an operation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer journey & service**

* Manage the full customer journey from enquiry through order, payment, fulfilment and delivery, and optimise every touchpoint for world-class service.
* Supervise and mentor the customer service team so that support is responsive and best-in-class across WhatsApp, email and telephone.
* Maintain a premium, discreet office environment for in-person clients, with the confidentiality expected in bullion trading.
* Look after office-based B2C and B2B clients buying or selling in person, making sure each transaction follows our process accurately.
* Trading with our suppliers is automated. Make sure the process is followed every time, and monitor it daily for errors or mismatches (price, quantity, settlement), resolving any you find quickly.
* Identify opportunities during face-to-face interactions to introduce clients to storage solutions or larger investment plans.
* Set and track service standards: response times, first-contact resolution, customer reviews and complaint resolution times.
* Own complaints and escalations end-to-end, and make sure every recurring issue gets a root-cause fix, not just an apology.
* Feed the voice of the customer (common questions, objections, friction points) back to the Ecommerce & Marketing Lead to improve the site.

**Team leadership & training**

* Lead, train and upskill the customer service team; build their confidence and product knowledge.
* Run structured onboarding, a training plan and a living knowledge base so that every team member answers the same question the same, correct way.
* Coach regularly against a clear KPI framework, with call/chat quality reviews, one-to-ones and recognition of good work.
* Manage rotas and cover (including weekend and market-volatility peaks) so service never drops.

**Inventory & fulfilment**

* Oversee inventory management and daily reconciliation of digital stock against physical holdings.
* Implement and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for fulfilment, vaulting and asset transfers.
* Liaise with secure logistics providers to ensure safe, on-time delivery.
* Reconcile client holdings, stock and orders daily against vault-operator and bank statements, and investigate any variance the same day.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships (mints, refiners, vaults, insured couriers) and hold them to agreed service levels.
* Own delivery exceptions end-to-end: failed deliveries, damaged or missing parcels, insurance claims and customer communication throughout.
* Run the buyback and returns process, including authenticity checks on items we buy back.
* Track operational KPIs: order-to-dispatch time, on-time delivery, pick/pack accuracy, and stock variance (target: zero).

**Risk & compliance**

* Ensure the team strictly follows established AML and KYC protocols, keeping "audit-ready" documentation for every transaction.
* Manage operational risk across the customer journey.
* Spot and escalate AML red flags and suspicious activity to the Compliance Officer / MLRO, and support UAE regulatory reporting for dealers in precious metals (e.g. via goAML).
* Apply fraud controls: payment fraud, chargebacks, account takeover and counterfeit risk.
* Maintain physical security and stock controls (dual control on stock movements, access logs, regular stock counts and internal audits).
* Keep SOPs current, and make sure the operation could pass an audit on any given day.

**Candidate profile**
**Experience & Background**

* 3–5 years in operations or customer service, including directly managing and training a small-tomidsized team.
* Industry preference: background in luxury retail (e.g. watches, jewellery), bullion or other high-value assets is highly desirable.
* Small business grit: a "no task too small" mentality, rolling up your sleeves to deliver great service for our customers.
* Experience running a high-value or regulated fulfilment operation (insured logistics, vaulting, KYC/AML) is a strong advantage.

**Personality & approach**

* A warm personality: you get real satisfaction from making customers, and your team, happy.
* High attention to detail and a process mind; you notice when something is slightly off and fix it.
* You thrive on managing day-to-day tasks and on a well-run routine, and you improve processes step by step rather than reinventing them.
* You enjoy training people and watching them get better.
* High integrity and discretion: you handle clients' wealth and personal data with care.
* Warm but firm: you can say no politely when a process or compliance rule requires it.
* Calm resilience: you stay calm and assertive during periods of high market price volatility.

**Technical & Soft Skills**

* Languages: full professional proficiency in English is mandatory. Strong Arabic and/or Hindi is highly preferable.
* Tech literacy: proficient with e-commerce backends, inventory management software and CRM tools.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets and reporting, and able to build and read a daily reconciliation.

**Location & working pattern**
This is an office-based role in Dubai; office working is the standard. There is day-to-day flexibility to work remotely when the operation allows, but the operation always comes first.
  
  
**Why join us?**

* Professional growth: opportunity for career advancement into regional roles as we expand across the GCC.
* Impact: direct reporting line to the MD in a performance-driven, high-growth environment.
* Culture: work at the heart of the world's gold capital within a professional, high-security environment.

Title: Restoration Manager
Description:
**RESTORATION MANAGER**

  
  

**About telMAX Inc.:**

  

Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.

  
  

**Your Position & How You Will Contribute:**

  

The Restoration Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all restoration activities associated with TelMAX’s Fibre-to-the-Home (FTTH) construction program. This role will have primary accountability for ensuring that all construction vendors complete required restoration work in a timely, safe, compliant, and high-quality manner across all build areas. The Restoration Manager will act as the primary point of contact for restoration activities, coordinating multiple vendors, tracking outstanding deficiencies, managing priorities, and working closely with Construction, Engineering, Municipal Relations, Quality, and other internal teams to ensure restoration requirements are completed and accepted. The successful candidate will be highly organized, field-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple vendors and competing priorities across a large geographic footprint.

  
  

**Responsibilities & Key Duties:**

  

Restoration Management

  

  
* Own the end-to-end restoration process for all FTTH construction areas.
  
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive inventory of outstanding restoration requirements by area, vendor, project, and municipality.
  
* Establish restoration priorities and drive vendors to complete work within required timelines.
  
* Ensure all restoration activities are completed in accordance with municipal standards, approved construction requirements, permits, and TelMAX standards.
  
* Monitor restoration progress from initial construction through final completion and municipal acceptance.
  
* Identify and escalate restoration risks, delays, deficiencies, and potential compliance issues.
  

  
  

Vendor Management

  

  
* Act as the primary point of contact for vendors responsible for restoration activities.
  
* Establish clear expectations, schedules, deliverables, and completion dates with each vendor.
  
* Hold vendors accountable for outstanding restoration work and deficiencies.
  
* Conduct regular vendor reviews and follow up on overdue or incomplete work.
  
* Coordinate additional resources or corrective action where vendors are unable to meet required timelines.
  
* Track vendor performance and identify recurring quality or performance issues.
  
* Support vendor performance management, including escalation of persistent non-performance to Construction leadership.
  

  
  

Field Coordination & Quality

  

  
* Conduct regular field inspections to verify that restoration work has been completed properly.
  
* Validate that restoration meets municipal, property, and TelMAX requirements.
  
* Coordinate the correction of deficient restoration work with vendors.
  
* Work with municipalities and inspectors to address restoration-related concerns and deficiencies.
  
* Ensure temporary restoration is transitioned to permanent restoration where required.
  
* Confirm that completed restoration is properly documented and ready for municipal inspection or acceptance.
  

  
  

Project Tracking & Reporting

  

  
* Maintain an accurate restoration dashboard showing:
    
    
  + Outstanding restoration items
    
  + Vendor assignments
    
  + Target completion dates
    
  + Aging of outstanding items
    
  + Deficiencies and rework
    
  + Municipal inspection status
    
  + Completed/closed restoration
  
* Provide regular reporting to Construction leadership on restoration progress, risks, and vendor performance.
  
* Establish KPIs and reporting mechanisms to measure restoration performance across the FTTH program.
  
* Identify trends and recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
  

  
  

Municipal & Stakeholder Coordination

  

  
* Work closely with Municipal Relations and Construction teams to understand municipal restoration requirements and deadlines.
  
* Support responses to municipal restoration complaints, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* Coordinate vendor responses to municipal requirements and inspection findings.
  
* Help ensure restoration commitments made to municipalities are tracked and delivered.
  
* Support the resolution of property-owner restoration concerns where required.
  

  
  

Financial Management

  

  
* Monitor restoration costs and vendor spend against approved budgets.
  
* Identify potential cost overruns, unauthorized work, and additional restoration costs.
  
* Review vendor restoration claims and supporting documentation as required.
  
* Escalate material cost variances and financial risks to Construction leadership.
  
* Support the recovery of costs from vendors where restoration deficiencies or rework are attributable to vendor performance.
  

  
  

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  

Accountable for improving and maintaining performance against key restoration metrics, including:

  

  
* Percentage of restoration completed within required timelines
  
* Aging of outstanding restoration items
  
* Number of overdue restoration items
  
* Municipal restoration deficiencies
  
* Restoration rework rate
  
* Vendor restoration performance
  
* Time from construction completion to final restoration
  
* Time from deficiency identification to correction
  
* Number of open municipal complaints related to restoration
  
* Restoration cost per home/premise
  
* Percentage of builds achieving municipal closeout/acceptance
  

  
  

**What You Bring:**

  

  
* **Accountability:**
   Takes ownership of restoration outcomes and drives issues to closure.
  
* **Vendor Management:**
   Holds vendors accountable while maintaining productive working relationships.
  
* **Execution:**
   Focuses on completing work and closing outstanding items rather than simply tracking them.
  
* **Organization:**
   Maintains accurate records, priorities, schedules, and follow-ups across a large program.
  
* **Problem Solving:**
   Quickly identifies root causes and develops practical solutions to restoration challenges.
  
* **Communication:**
   Clearly communicates expectations, deadlines, deficiencies, and escalations.
  
* **Attention to Detail:**
   Ensures restoration meets municipal and telMAX standards.
  
* **Leadership:**
   Influences vendors and internal stakeholders to achieve results without necessarily having direct authority over them.
  
* **Continuous Improvement:**
   Identifies opportunities to improve restoration processes, vendor performance, and overall construction closeout.
  

  
  

**Experience:**

  

  
* 5+ years of experience in construction, restoration, civil construction, telecommunications, utilities, or a related field.
  
* Experience managing construction or restoration vendors.
  
* Experience working with municipalities, inspectors, or right-of-way requirements is strongly preferred.
  
* Experience in FTTH, telecommunications, utility construction, or civil construction is an asset.
  
* Strong understanding of construction restoration practices, including asphalt, concrete, landscaping, sod, topsoil, curbs, sidewalks, and related municipal infrastructure.
  
* Strong project and vendor management skills.
  
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  
* Ability to manage multiple projects, vendors, and geographic areas simultaneously.
  
* Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
  
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction/project management systems.
  
* Valid driver's licence and ability to travel regularly to construction sites.
  

  
  

Success in this role will be measured by the Restoration Manager's ability to take ownership of the restoration backlog, establish clear accountability with vendors, reduce aging and outstanding deficiencies, and consistently drive restoration through to final completion and municipal acceptance.

  
  

**ImPACT Values**

  

  
* Performance & Commitment
  

  

We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering exceptional results through dedication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our commitment to excellence drives us to push boundaries, take ownership, and always follow through.

  

  
* Agility & Collaboration
  

  

We move fast, adapt with courage, and work together to solve challenges. Through empowerment and open communication, we foster a culture where bold ideas thrive. We leverage our collective strengths, achieve shared success and deliver exceptional results for our customers and teams.

  

  
* Customer Centricity
  

  

In every decision we make, we think through the customer’s lens. We know that anticipating and exceeding their expectations isn’t just good service—it’s the foundation of who we are. By staying deeply connected to our customers’ needs, we build loyalty, enhance our reputation, spark positive word-of-mouth and drive company growth.

  

  
* Trust & Integrity
  

  

We build trust by acting with integrity, respect, and transparency in everything we do. We communicate with each other openly and presume positive intentions. By upholding these principles, we strengthen relationships, create a culture of respect, and empower teams to succeed together.

* Set clear standards and build scalable capabilities from the ground up, enabling consistent ways of working across functions and geographies.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in business, technology, finance, life sciences, project management, law, data science, or a related discipline; a Master's degree or equivalent extensive professional experience is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience across portfolio management, program or project management, business operations, financial management, alliance or partnership management, supplier governance, contracting, or a related discipline in a complex global organization.

Title: Assistant Manager | Technology & Cyber Advisory | Technology Risk
Description:
About Us 

Grant Thornton UAE is a leading professional services firm, providing audit and assurance, tax and advisory services across multiple industries. We have served public and private sector clients in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) for almost 60 years and are committed to delivering quality and excellence driven by fresh thinking, diverse perspectives and a personalised approach. Grant Thornton UAE is part of a global network of independent firms with over 76,000 professionals across 150 markets.
  
  
We're driven by a purpose of shaping the world we live in, grounded in trust, integrity and the belief that dynamic businesses and thriving communities go hand in hand. By living our purpose and focusing on quality in everything we do, we strive to be the go-to firm for growth. 

At Grant Thornton UAE, our people drive our impact. With over 50 nationalities represented across our teams, we’re proud to foster a culture that celebrates diversity, empowers individuals and delivers meaningful outcomes for our clients and communities. Our unique environment combines the opportunities of a major global organisation with the connection and collaboration of a close‑knit firm.

Here, you can widen your opportunities. Be inspired. Be challenged. Be yourself. Here, you can.

 

Service Line Overview

Our Advisory practice helps organisations solve their most critical challenges across strategy, operations, risk, and technology. We work with clients to improve performance, manage uncertainty, and unlock sustainable growth. Our multidisciplinary teams combine deep technical expertise with commercial insight, delivering solutions across Business Advisory, Financial Advisory, Mergers & Acquisitions / Transaction Advisory and Technology & Digital Advisory.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Manager to lead complex technology risk, IT audit, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, resilience, and emerging technology engagements. The role requires strong technical knowledge combined with the ability to define assessment approaches, manage multidisciplinary delivery, review technical outputs, challenge evidence and conclusions, and present significant risks to senior client stakeholders.



The successful candidate will lead engagements across financial services, government, critical infrastructure, and other regulated sectors while supervising delivery teams and maintaining responsibility for technical quality.

Key Responsibilities

·
       

Lead IT audits, ITGC assessments, technology risk reviews, application control reviews, technology governance assessments, and pre- and post-implementation reviews

·
       

Define risk-based work programmes and review coverage across applications, databases, operating systems, networks, cloud platforms, interfaces, infrastructure, and data centres

·
       

Lead cybersecurity maturity, compliance, gap, and regulatory assessments against UAE Information Assurance Standards, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, PCI DSS, SWIFT CSP, and applicable Central Bank cybersecurity and technology risk frameworks

·
       

Review maturity methodologies, control mappings, regulatory self-assessments, management attestations, risk ratings, and prioritised remediation roadmaps

·
       

Lead reviews of core banking and critical applications, covering system architecture, access, configurations, product parameters, segregation of duties, interfaces, batch processing, audit trails, availability, and recovery

·
       

Lead technical assessments of IDS/IPS, firewalls, WAF, PAM, IAM, EDR/XDR, DLP, SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability-management, email-security, and cloud-security solutions

·
       

Assess security-tool architecture, configuration, integration, coverage, administration, monitoring, lifecycle management, and alignment with regulatory and risk requirements

·
       

Lead SOC and SIEM assessments covering operating models, log-source coverage, detection use cases, threat intelligence, alert handling, incident escalation, threat hunting, retention, tuning, orchestration, and service-provider governance

·
       

Oversee vulnerability management, penetration testing, secure configuration, application security, API security, cyber incident readiness, and technical remediation reviews

·
       

Lead cloud security reviews across Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365, and hybrid or multi-cloud environments

·
       

Lead BCM, disaster recovery, ICT continuity, cyber resilience, and operational resilience assessments, including BIA, RTO and RPO alignment, recovery architecture, crisis management, testing, and third-party resilience

·
       

Lead data centre reviews covering physical and environmental security, power, cooling, fire protection, network redundancy, server and storage infrastructure, backup, capacity, availability, and single points of failure

·
       

Lead data protection, privacy, Microsoft Purview, AI governance, and emerging technology assessments, including reviews against ISO 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework

·
       

Define engagement approaches, evidence requirements, testing methodologies, maturity-rating criteria, and reporting structures

·
       

Review working papers, technical assessments, observations, maturity ratings, risk conclusions, and client reports to ensure they are complete and evidence-based

·
       

Manage client workshops, status meetings, validation discussions, and presentations to senior technology, cyber, audit, risk, and business stakeholders

·
       

Supervise project teams, allocate technical workstreams, review deliverables, and provide technical guidance

·
       

Support technical proposals, scope development, effort estimation, and the development of new Technology and Cyber Advisory offerings

Success Criteria

* Six to eight years of relevant experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, cloud security, BCM, disaster recovery, or related advisory services
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technology and cybersecurity assessments
* Strong knowledge of UAE IA, NIST, ISO 27001, and relevant Central Bank cybersecurity or technology risk frameworks
* Experience leading core banking, critical application, SOC, SIEM, security solution, cloud, data centre, BCM, or disaster recovery reviews
* Strong understanding of security technologies, including PAM, IAM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, SIEM, SOAR, DLP, WAF, vulnerability management, and cloud-security solutions
* Experience defining technical assessment approaches, reviewing evidence, challenging conclusions, and presenting significant risks to senior stakeholders
* Experience supervising technical teams and reviewing client deliverables
* CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, ISO 22301, ISO 42001, CCSP, CCSK, AZ-500, SC-100, SC-200, AWS Security Specialty, CEH, CREST, OSCP, GIAC, PMP, or an equivalent relevant certification
  
  

Our Values

We’re looking for people who connect with and live our CLEARR values. These values shape how we work with our clients, support one another and contribute to the communities we serve.

* Collaboration – Ask for help, give help – we work well together
* Leadership – Have courage and inspire others – we challenge each other to be the best we can be
* Excellence – Find a better way every time – we never get complacent
* Agility – Think broadly, act quickly – we thrive in change
* Responsibility – Use influence wisely – we own our actions
* Respect – Listen and understand, be forthright – we create honest relationships
  
  

Our Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package, flexible work arrangements, professional development support, and a range of wellbeing and community initiatives—designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

* Must possess sound credit knowledge with proven skills of writing credit proposals

Title: Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing
Description:
We seek an individual inspired by our mission, whose beliefs align with our core values of integrity, inquiry, compassion and courage, and who reflects our core competencies to join our Upper School as **Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing** beginning in August 2027. This is a full-time position.

Salary range: $124,000 to $165,000. The total compensation for this Assistant Head position is based on placement on the Havergal College faculty grid plus a $20,000 leadership stipend (included in the above salary range). Grid placement is determined by teaching qualifications and experience up to a maximum of 11 years. Final placement within the range is based on the successful candidate's credentials and years of experience.

**Why Teach with Us**

At Havergal College, we believe that our strength lies in our faculty and staff's collective efforts, talents, and accomplishments. Together, we can make a positive and lasting impact on our students' lives.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package for teachers, including a faculty teaching grid that is well above the major urban school boards; contributions to and participation in the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan and/or Group RSP; generous holidays that allow employees to recharge; comprehensive health and dental benefits; support for professional development including support for graduate work, additional qualifications (AQs), faculty-wide and individual professional development in teaching and learning, wellbeing, equity and inclusion, assessment, and experiential education; and teaching on a beautiful 22-acre campus with excellent facilities.

**Why Havergal is the Place to Be**

Founded in 1894 and located on a beautiful 22-acre campus in midtown Toronto, Canada, Havergal College is one of Canada’s pre-eminent independent schools for girls from Junior Kindergarten through Grade 12.

At Havergal College, we believe great schools are made up of great people. With a rich history spanning over 130 years, we are committed to offering a contemporary liberal arts education rooted in the Anglican tradition. Our mission is to prepare young women to make a difference. Through our outstanding academic and co-curricular programs and a cohesive, collegial team of faculty and administrative staff, we nurture a culture of capability that fosters self-confidence, leadership, critical thinking, and global-mindedness in our students.

We take pride in attracting and retaining highly qualified faculty and administrative staff to ensure our school remains at the forefront of educational excellence. Join us in this transformative education journey, working together to empower young women to make a positive difference in our world.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that an inclusive environment fosters a culture of mutual respect, creativity and innovation, collaboration and accountability. To this end, we encourage applications from all qualified candidates with diverse experiences and perspectives, including women, BIPOC (Black, Indigenous and People of Colour) peoples, LGBTQ2S+, and persons with disabilities to join our thriving team. We seek candidates committed to nurturing a community where integrity, compassion, inquiry and courage thrive.

**The Position:**

The Assistant Head of Upper School, Student Support & Wellbeing provides operational leadership for student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12. Working collaboratively with the Upper School Leadership Team, this role ensures that every student is known, valued, and cared for, and has access to the relationships, resources, and support necessary to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing oversees the integrated work of Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role. Through the leadership and development of these teams, the Assistant Head establishes a coordinated and responsive approach to student support that promotes belonging, engagement, inclusion and student success.

Guided by Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing, the Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing leads proactive and preventative approaches to wellbeing across the Upper School, building the capacity of faculty and staff to support students and ensuring effective systems are in place to identify and respond to emerging student needs.

The Assistant Head of Upper School – Student Support & Wellbeing reports directly to the Head of Upper School and is accountable for fostering a safe, equitable and inclusive school culture aligned with Havergal's mission and values. This is a faculty leadership position requiring teaching qualifications and experience in an educational setting.

**Specific Accountabilities:**

**Leadership of Student Support & Wellbeing**

* Lead the development, implementation and ongoing evaluation of a comprehensive, coordinated approach to student support and wellbeing across Grades 7–12, aligned with Havergal's Commitment to Wellbeing.
* Champion proactive, preventative, strengths-based and evidence-informed approaches to wellbeing that promote student belonging, resilience, engagement and healthy development.
* Identify emerging trends in student wellbeing and learning needs, using relevant data, research and professional expertise to inform priorities, programming and resource allocation.
* Partner with the Assistant Heads of Middle and Senior Divisions and the Director of Boarding to ensure that wellbeing priorities are meaningfully embedded in the student experience, including Form, Teacher Advisor, grade-level and Boarding programming.
* Build faculty and staff capacity through professional learning and shared practices that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive education and effective responses to student needs.
* Contribute to school-wide strategic initiatives that strengthen student wellbeing, inclusive excellence and the overall student experience.

**Leadership and Oversight of Student Support Services**

* Provide leadership, direction and oversight to Guidance, Learning Support, Health Services, Social Work and the pastoral dimensions of the Chaplain's role.
* Lead, coach and develop Student Support leaders and team members, fostering professional growth, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities and communication practices across Student Support services to ensure an integrated and effective approach to student care.
* Oversee the effective allocation of staffing, resources and budgets across Student Support services.
* Ensure the effective delivery and continuous improvement of student support services, promoting responsive, accessible and coordinated support that meets the evolving needs of students and families.
* Provide leadership for Learning Support practices, ensuring effective systems for accommodations, Individual Education Plans and appropriate academic interventions.
* Champion the development of executive functioning skills, learning strategies and student self-advocacy in collaboration with academic leaders and faculty.
* Promote effective transitions for students entering, moving through and graduating from the Upper School, with particular attention to students requiring additional support.

**Coordinated Student Care and Intervention**

* Lead the development and implementation of effective systems for identifying, assessing, supporting and monitoring students experiencing academic, social, emotional, behavioural or health-related challenges.
* Oversee the Upper School Student Support Team, ensuring effective multidisciplinary collaboration, clear processes for case management and appropriate follow-through.
* Establish consistent protocols for student referrals, documentation, communication, intervention planning and escalation of concerns.
* Provide leadership and consultation in complex student support matters, working closely with Student Support professionals, divisional Assistant Heads and the Head of Upper School.
* Ensure that student support planning reflects appropriate professional expertise, confidentiality, safeguarding responsibilities and relevant school policies.
* Partner with families and external professionals, as appropriate, to coordinate student care and support successful school engagement.
* Oversee processes for student re-entry and reintegration following health-related leaves or other circumstances requiring coordinated support.

**Collaborative and Engaged Member of the Upper School Leadership Team**

* Serve as an active member of the Upper School Leadership Team, collaborating with divisional Assistant Heads, the Director of Boarding, Academic Leadership and Student Life leaders to advance shared priorities for student learning, wellbeing and engagement.
* Provide advice to the Head of Upper School on emerging student support needs, complex cases, resource priorities and opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to the ongoing review and development of relevant school policies, procedures, the Family Handbook and communications relating to student support and wellbeing.
* Support Admissions in reviewing prospective applicants with IEPs or social-emotional needs.

**Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience**

* A recognized teaching qualification and membership in good standing with the Ontario College of Teachers (OCT), or equivalent qualifications and eligibility for OCT certification.
* Demonstrated teaching experience in a school setting, preferably with students in Grades 7–12.
* Experience in educational leadership, student support, Guidance, Learning Support or a related area of school-based practice.
* Deep understanding of the developmental, academic, social and emotional needs of students in Grades 7–12.
* Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary approaches to student wellbeing, mental health promotion, inclusive education and coordinated student support.
* Familiarity with the priorities and contemporary approaches within a girls' school.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary teams and foster a collaborative, accountable team culture.
* Sound professional judgement, discretion and problem-solving ability, particularly in navigating complex and sensitive student and family matters.
* Strong understanding of safeguarding, confidentiality, professional boundaries and appropriate student support and intervention practices.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships, think strategically and manage competing priorities.
* Leadership qualifications are an asset.
* Demonstrated ability and commitment to the Core & Leadership Competencies of:
  + Inclusive Excellence
  + Collaboration & Teamwork
  + Integrity & Trust
  + Learning Agility
  + Communication
  + Growth Mindset
  + Coach & Develop Others
  + Managerial Courage
  + Champion Change & Innovation
  + Purpose Alignment & Results

**How to Apply**

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply and express their interest to HC Careers no later than **December 1,** **2026.** *This posting is for an existing vacancy. We use an AI transcription tool for note-taking during the initial telephone pre-screening. This helps us capture key details, with Human Resources maintaining full oversight and final determination on all records. * Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors and the compliance function as and when required.

Title: Night Duty Assistant Front Office Manager
Description:
Job Description – Night Duty Assistant Manager

Department: Front Office  
Reports To: Front Office Manager / Rooms Division Manager / Hotel Manager  
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall hotel operations during the night shift, ensuring smooth and efficient service delivery, guest satisfaction, safety, security, and compliance with hotel standards and company policies.

The role serves as the senior management representative on duty during nighttime hours, handling guest concerns, managing operational issues, supervising night staff, and ensuring the hotel operates efficiently in the absence of daytime management.

Key Responsibilities1. Hotel Operations Management

* Ensure proper handover from the evening team to the morning team.
* Make operational decisions in the absence of senior management.

2. Guest Relations and Customer Service

* Welcome VIP guests and ensure special attention is provided where required.
* Handle guest complaints, requests, and service recovery professionally.
* Ensure high levels of guest satisfaction throughout the night.
* Follow up on unresolved guest issues and ensure appropriate corrective action.
* Maintain a visible management presence in the hotel.

3. Front Office and Night Audit

* Supervise night reception and front office activities.
* Ensure smooth check-in and check-out procedures.
* Monitor room availability, occupancy, room status, and arrivals.
* Ensure the night audit is completed accurately and on time.
* Review daily reports, financial transactions, and operational discrepancies.
* Ensure proper cash handling and compliance with financial procedures.
* Process Front Office Duty Roster and other Front Office related works

4. Security and Safety

* Ensure the safety and security of guests, employees, and hotel property.
* Conduct regular security and safety inspections.
* Monitor incidents, unusual activities, and emergency situations.
* Ensure compliance with fire safety, health and safety, and emergency procedures.
* Act as the incident coordinator during emergencies until the relevant senior management or emergency services take over.
* Complete incident reports and escalate serious matters immediately.

5. Team Management and Supervision

* Supervise and support all employees working during the night shift.
* Ensure adequate staffing and effective allocation of duties.
* Monitor employee attendance, grooming, conduct, and performance.
* Motivate team members and maintain a professional working environment.
* Address operational and staff-related issues appropriately.
* Ensure proper communication and handover between shifts.

6. Financial and Administrative Responsibilities

* Monitor overnight revenue and financial transactions.
* Ensure accurate completion of daily revenue and night audit reports.
* Investigate discrepancies and report irregularities.
* Ensure compliance with company financial controls and procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, guest complaints, and operational activities.

7. Reporting and Communication

* Prepare and submit the Night Manager's Daily Report.
* Communicate important operational updates to the Hotel Manager and relevant department heads.
* Highlight maintenance issues, guest concerns, security incidents, and outstanding matters.
* Ensure a detailed handover to the morning management team.

Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in hospitality management, Hotel Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in hotel operations, preferably in a supervisory or management position.
* Previous experience as a Duty Manager, Night Manager, or Assistant Front Office Manager is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of front office operations, night audit, and hotel management systems.
* Knowledge of hotel health, safety, security, and emergency procedures.
* Experience in handling guest complaints and managing operational challenges.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Excellent guest relations and conflict-resolution skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and hotel PMS systems.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Night Duty Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Guest satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Smooth and efficient overnight hotel operations.
* Accuracy and timely completion of night audit.
* Compliance with company policies and operational standards.
* Security, safety, and incident management.
* Staff supervision and performance.
* Quality of daily reports and shift handovers.
* Reduction of operational errors and financial discrepancies.

Authority and Accountability

The Night Duty Assistant Manager is authorized to:

* Make operational decisions during the night shift.
* Handle guest complaints and approve service recovery within company guidelines.
* Coordinate all departments and allocate available resources.
* Take immediate action in emergency situations.
* Escalate major financial, security, guest-related, or operational matters to senior management.

Overall Accountability: To ensure the hotel front office operates safely, efficiently, and professionally throughout the night, while maintaining the company's service standards, protecting its assets, and delivering an excellent guest experience.

Pay: AED2,500.00 - AED3,500.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Description:

Referral Program  

Full Time roles are eligible for the above, plus:

* Health Insurance; Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, and Vision Insurance plans (for eligible seasonal employees after working 500 hours)

**Job Summary:**

The Assistant Manager of Lift Maintenance provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all mechanical and electrical aspects of aerial lifts, surface lifts, conveyors, and related equipment at both Attitash and Wildcat. This role ensures that lifts operate safely, reliably, and in full compliance with ANSI B77.1 standards, OSHA, and all manufacturer and company policies.

This leader manages both mechanical and electrical lift teams, driving operational excellence, safety culture, preventive maintenance, workforce development, and long-range asset planning. The position supports innovation, continuous improvement, and alignment with enterprise standards and resort operating goals.

**Job Specifications:**

* Starting Wage: $55,048.00 - $75,928.00
* Employment Type: Year Round
* Shift Type: Full Time hours available
* Minimum Age: At least 18 years of age
* Housing Availability: No

**Job Responsibilities:**

Leadership & Team Management

* Lead and manage lift maintenance and lift electrical teams.
* Recruit, coach, and develop a high-performing team aligned with company values and competencies.
* Drive workforce planning, training programs, performance management, and succession planning.
* Build strong, collaborative relationships across Mountain Operations, Health & Safety, and corporate partners.

Safety & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with ANSI B77.1, OSHA, EPA, New Hampshire State lift codes, USFS and internal policies.
* Promote a safety-first culture and ensure timely documentation of inspections, repairs, and maintenance activities.
* Conduct or oversee safety audits, accident investigations, and operational readiness procedures.
* Maintain all lift maintenance and electrical records required by authorities, including daily logs, inspections, ops reports, and incident documentation.

Mechanical & Electrical Maintenance Operations

* Direct mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, diagnostics, repairs, and system upgrades.
* Oversee preventive maintenance programs, including annual maintenance and component lifecycle planning.
* Maintain inventory controls for parts, tools, and equipment; manage warehouse processes and long-term stock needs.
* Support and participate in capital projects, new lift installations, and major mechanical/electrical upgrades.

Strategic Planning & Program Development

* Develop annual work plans, preventive maintenance schedules, and long-range asset replacement strategies.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including technical training, workflow optimization, and documentation improvements.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise asset management (EAM) systems and accurate maintenance tracking.

Collaboration & Communication

* Serve as primary contact for regulatory agencies, manufacturers, contractors, and internal leadership.
* Provide regular updates to the Mountain Maintenance Manager and Sr. Director of Mountain Operations regarding lift status, reliability metrics, safety issues, and project progress.
* Ensure operations staff are informed and trained to support lift safety and performance.

Budgeting & Resource Management

* Manage operating and capital budgets for both mechanical and electrical lift maintenance programs.
* Forecast financial needs, develop capital project scopes, and ensure efficient departmental spending.
* Support procurement processes and maintain accurate financial documentation.

Working Conditions

* Mountain outdoor environment with variable weather; requires climbing, accessing lift towers, machinery rooms, and moving equipment.
* May operate snowmobiles, UTVs, and specialized vehicles.
* Requires availability for nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during peak periods.

**Job Requirements:**

* 3-8 years of mechanical and/or electrical lift maintenance experience.
* Expert knowledge of aerial lifts (detachable and fixed-grip), surface lifts, conveyors, and electrical systems.
* Strong working knowledge of ANSI B77.1, OSHA, EPA, and applicable state regulations.
* Proven leadership, communication, organizational, and team-development skills.
* Proficiency with CMMS/EAM systems and Microsoft Office.
* Valid U.S. driver’s license.
* Ability to lift and carry 50+ pounds and work in demanding mountain environments.
* Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions.

Preferred

* 5+ years of electrical lift experience, including programmable logic controllers (PLC), variable frequency drives (VFDs), and control systems.
* 3+ years in a supervisory or management role.
* Experience in alpine resort maintenance leadership.
* Intermediate skiing or snowboarding ability.

The expected pay range is $55,048.00 - $75,928.00. This is the pay range we reasonably expect to pay for this position. Individual compensation decisions are based on a variety of factors.

Title: VP, Construction & ETO
Description:

Appficiency is a global technology and professional services firm that solves complex business challenges through the intelligent application of enterprise software, automation, and AI. The Opportunity
  
  
As Vice President, AI & Multitech, you'll position yourself and your team as the technology leaders clients turn to across Appficiency's full platform portfolio - spanning ERP, CRM, AI, and beyond. This is a role built for someone who thinks in ecosystems, not single platforms: you'll build and coach a team fluent across multiple technologies, shape long-term account strategy in step with our sales targets, and push AI-driven delivery efficiency to new heights. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales to shape regional strategy, ensuring the team you build reflects where the business is headed next.

* Champion delivery excellence for construction and ETO engagements, ensuring every project lands within scope, on time, on budget, and to Appficiency's quality standard
* Cultivate deep, senior-level relationships with key stakeholders across your most strategic construction and ETO accounts
* Take direct ownership of reducing escalations - since this industry generates a disproportionate share of the firm's escalations today, this is one of the clearest measures of your impact
* Partner with the product team to shape a stronger, more tailored customer experience for construction and ETO clients

* Act as a true partner to the SOS team, giving them the delivery support and credibility they need to win and grow construction and ETO business

* 10+ years in Professional Services or construction/ETO industry leadership, with 7-8 of those years in systems implementation, integration, or process re-engineering for construction or engineering-driven organizations
* A track record of managing distributed delivery teams across multiple regions on concurrent, complex projects
* Strong command of business analytics, BI, and financial performance management, including genuine fluency in reading and acting on job-cost reporting and P&L
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of your time, with flexibility for site visits and client needs

What Will Set You Apart
  
  

* A rare blend of construction industry experience and enterprise technology delivery background - you've credibly operated in both worlds, not just one
* A track record of reducing escalations and stabilizing delivery in complex, industry-specific engagements
* Strong executive presence with construction and ETO clients who expect a partner who understands their business, not just their software
* Experience partnering with product and sales teams to shape offerings and win business in a specialized vertical
* A reputation in the industry that opens doors - clients and prospects recognize your name before you walk into the room

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Escalations originating from construction and ETO accounts trend consistently downward under your leadership
* Your portfolio's false-start and early-termination rate holds well below the firm's threshold
* Clients recognize your delivery team as genuine construction and ETO experts, not generalists applying a standard playbook
* Sales consistently reports strong, proactive support from Delivery on construction and ETO opportunities, and the partnership shows up in win rates
* Your product feedback loop measurably improves the customer experience for construction and ETO clients over time

Description:

433116
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**Résumé**
**Programme IA Fabric de Bell**
est une initiative de transformation visant à déployer une infrastructure de centres de données évolutive et essentielle aux opérations. Le
**gestionnaire, contrôle de programme**
sera responsable d’établir et de maintenir les processus de gouvernance qui assurent la coordination entre les différents services, projets et parties prenantes du programme.
  
  
Relevant du ou de la
**directeur, contrôle de programme**
, cette personne fournira un leadership dans les domaines suivants : la gestion des interfaces et des transferts, la gouvernance des risques, l’analyse des causes fondamentales, la capitalisation des leçons apprises, l’amélioration continue, la gestion des mesures de suivi ainsi que la coordination du contrôle des changements.
  
  
Le titulaire du poste contribuera à maintenir une vision intégrée et fiable des risques, des dépendances, des actions et des initiatives d’amélioration du programme afin de soutenir une exécution prévisible et efficace des projets.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
**Gestion des interfaces et des transferts**

* Administrer le registre des transferts et interdépendances du programme.
* Coordonner les revues interfonctionnelles entre les équipes de développement, d’ingénierie, d’approvisionnement, de construction, de mise en service, d’exploitation, de sécurité, des TI et les parties prenantes réglementaires.
* Surveiller les dépendances, les critères d’entrée et de sortie ainsi que les exigences de transfert à chaque phase du projet.
* Identifier et signaler les enjeux liés aux dépendances, aux livrables, aux responsabilités et aux étapes critiques.

**Gestion des risques et analyse des causes fondamentales**

* Maintenir le registre RAID du programme et soutenir les processus de gouvernance des risques.
* Coordonner les revues de risques, le suivi des mesures d’atténuation et les actions correctives.
* Diriger ou faciliter les analyses des causes fondamentales pour les enjeux majeurs ayant un impact sur les coûts, les échéanciers ou la performance.
* Analyser les tendances et recommander des mesures préventives ou correctives.

**Leçons apprises et amélioration continue**

* Développer et maintenir un cadre structuré de leçons apprises.
* Recueillir et intégrer les apprentissages aux principaux jalons du programme.
* Traduire les leçons retenues en améliorations des procédures, normes, outils et pratiques de livraison.
* Animer des ateliers et revues visant l’amélioration continue et l’efficacité des contrôles.

**Gestion des actions et gouvernance**

* Mettre en place un processus de suivi des actions à boucle fermée.
* Veiller à ce que les actions, risques, décisions et initiatives d’amélioration soient assignés, suivis et clôturés adéquatement.
* Assurer des suivis réguliers et fournir à la direction une visibilité sur les enjeux, retards et décisions requises.

**Gestion du changement**

* Coordonner le processus de contrôle des changements et les évaluations d’impact.
* Assurer l’alignement des changements avec les risques, les dépendances, les transferts et les références du programme.
* Maintenir des registres, journaux de décisions et rapports de gouvernance vérifiables.

**Rapports et soutien au contrôle de programme**

* Produire des tableaux de bord et rapports exécutifs sur les risques, les interfaces, les actions, les changements et les initiatives d’amélioration.
* Soutenir les cycles de gouvernance et de reddition de comptes du programme.
* Fournir des analyses sur les tendances, les dépendances et les risques émergents.
* Contribuer à la mise en œuvre et à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils, normes et pratiques de contrôle de programme.
* Agir comme point central d’intégration de l’information tout en assurant l’imputabilité des équipes responsables de la livraison.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* Expérience progressive en contrôle de programme, contrôle de projet, gestion de bureau de projets (PMO), gestion des risques, gouvernance de programme, amélioration continue ou réalisation de grands projets d’investissement (CAPEX).
* Expérience démontrée dans la coordination de programmes ou de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires impliquant plusieurs équipes internes, consultants, entrepreneurs et fournisseurs.
* Solide compréhension des pratiques de gestion des risques, des enjeux, des mesures correctives, des changements, des interfaces et de la gouvernance.
* Expérience dans l’animation d’analyses des causes profondes (Root Cause Analysis) et dans la mise en œuvre et le suivi d’actions correctives jusqu’à leur résolution.
