Title: Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director
Description:
**Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery**

**(This role can be based in any global Worley office)**

**About Worley**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets.

With more than 40,000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The role**

Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio.

**Why this role matters**

At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers.

DPD is part of Digital Operations at Worley and exists to support Operations, so your work in this global role will have impact across the organisation.

This is where deep digital expertise meets senior leadership. Rather than writing code yourself, you'll set the technical direction and lead a talented team across multiple locations, bringing them together to turn that vision into results on our projects. You'll engage with functional representatives in Operations to ensure C&C project needs are understood and delivered.

Worley has placed Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) at the centre of project execution. A key part of this role is supporting the seamless digital enablement of AWP on projects. AI is also central to our digital strategy, and this role will help shape how we adopt AI across C&C delivery.

**What you will do**

* Set the strategy: Define the strategy for digital enablement of C&C as part of the wider DPD strategy, build the plans to deliver it, and develop strategic relationships with external technology partners that support our DPD ambition.
* Own the solution: Take ownership of the C&C technology stack, including tools, integrations, automation, AI, data management and reporting, across its full build-operate-support-retire lifecycle, partnering closely with other parts of the Worley digital team.
* Own the approach: Define the end-to-end C&C workflow for digitally enabled projects in collaboration with the project delivery function.
* Lead implementation: Drive adoption of the C&C digital way of working, collaborating with the DPD People and Processes team to ensure a consistent approach across project delivery.
* Enable our people: Contribute to organisational change management, define the digital competency requirements for project personnel, and support the governance framework that embeds the Worley digital approach.
* Deliver standout support: Build a support culture focused on keeping our people productive, using service metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Lead and grow the team: Manage geographically dispersed direct and indirect reports, including subcontractors, and develop and manage the team budget in line with company delegation of authority requirements.

**What you will bring**

* Demonstrated experience in construction and commissioning.
* Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability.
* A proven record of directly leading and managing teams.
* A relevant university degree.
* Experience collaborating across teams to deliver practical solutions.
* Experience developing strategies, operating models and frameworks, with a track record of successfully implementing new ways of working.
* Experience with digital solutions on projects and awareness of software commonly used for C&C delivery. Knowledge of O3 is preferred.
* Thought leadership, with the ability to move between strategic and tactical thinking and work comfortably with new concepts and complexity.
* Strong relationship and influencing skills across all levels, cultures and external parties, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and facilitate discussions with large groups.

**What's in it for you**

* A senior leadership role on the DPD leadership team, with genuine authority and autonomy over C&C digitalisation.
* The opportunity to shape how digital technology is used to build and commission projects globally.
* The opportunity to build capability in deploying digital solutions across a large multinational organisation.
* Latitude to explore emerging C&C digital technologies with technology providers that could shape the future of project delivery at Worley.

***\*Applicants must possess valid working rights for the country in which the role will be based.***

Title: Construction Manager
Description:
**About Us**
------------

  

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

  

**Purpose**
-----------

  

We are currently recruiting for a Construction Manager to support the successful delivery of capital projects across the mining, renewable energy, clean energy, traditional energy, chemicals, and industrial sectors.

The Construction Manager is responsible for leading site-based construction execution and ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements. This role provides leadership to construction teams, contractors, subcontractors, and field support personnel while serving as the primary construction interface between the project site, project management team, engineering disciplines, procurement, customers, and key stakeholders.

The successful candidate will bring strong construction leadership experience, a commitment to health, safety, and environmental excellence, and the ability to manage complex multidisciplinary projects through construction, commissioning, startup, and turnover.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Construction Leadership and Execution**

  

* Lead all site construction activities in accordance with project objectives, execution plans, schedules, budgets, and quality requirements.
* Provide overall leadership and direction to construction teams, contractors, subcontractors, and field supervision personnel.
* Develop and implement project construction execution strategies, construction management plans, staffing plans, and site mobilization plans.
* Coordinate construction activities to ensure efficient execution and alignment with project milestones.
* Monitor productivity, workforce performance, and construction progress against project targets.
* Identify schedule risks, execution challenges, and resource constraints and implement mitigation and recovery plans as required.
* Support construction readiness planning and ensure appropriate work packaging and workface planning processes are in place.
* Participate in project planning, risk assessments, constructability reviews, and execution strategy development from early project phases through project completion.

### **Health, Safety, Environment and Quality**

  

* Champion a strong safety culture and ensure all work is executed in accordance with project and corporate health, safety, environmental, and security requirements.
* Promote visible safety leadership and participation throughout all stages of project execution.
* Lead safety meetings, field observations, incident reviews, and corrective action implementation.
* Ensure all contractors and subcontractors comply with project safety standards and regulatory requirements.
* Support environmental stewardship and compliance with applicable permits and regulations.
* Ensure construction activities comply with approved quality management systems, inspection requirements, and project specifications.
* Support quality audits, inspections, and verification processes throughout project execution.

### **Engineering, Procurement and Construction Integration**

  

* Collaborate closely with Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Project Controls, and Commissioning teams to ensure effective project delivery.
* Participate in constructability reviews, model reviews, design reviews, and risk assessments.
* Provide construction input into engineering deliverables, installation methodologies, schedules, and sequencing strategies.
* Ensure construction teams receive required engineering deliverables, materials, equipment, and information to support efficient execution.
* Coordinate resolution of field technical issues and construction-related requests for information.
* Support implementation and management of project change processes and management of change requirements.
* Monitor material availability, equipment delivery, and procurement activities to identify and mitigate potential impacts to construction execution.

### **Contractor and Stakeholder Management**

  

* Develop and maintain effective working relationships with customers, contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, regulatory agencies, Indigenous communities, and other project stakeholders.
* Manage contractor performance related to safety, quality, schedule, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Facilitate regular construction coordination meetings and communicate project priorities and expectations.
* Support contract administration activities, including scope reviews, change management, claims mitigation, and performance evaluations.
* Serve as the primary site representative and construction point of contact for project stakeholders.

### **Project Controls and Reporting**

  

* Monitor construction progress, productivity, staffing levels, schedule performance, and cost trends.
* Collaborate with Project Controls to maintain construction schedules, forecasts, and progress measurement systems.
* Review and evaluate progress reports, productivity metrics, and key performance indicators.
* Support development of mitigation and recovery plans when schedule or productivity challenges arise.
* Provide regular reporting on construction performance, risks, opportunities, and project status.
* Ensure accurate documentation of field activities, changes, non-conformances, inspections, and project records.

### **Commissioning, Startup and Project Closeout**

  

* Support construction completion, mechanical completion, commissioning, startup, and turnover activities.
* Coordinate punch list management and completion of outstanding construction activities.
* Ensure as-built documentation, turnover packages, quality records, and completion documentation are properly managed and submitted.
* Support successful transfer of facilities to operations teams and customers.

### **Team Leadership and Development**

  

* Build and maintain a high-performance project team focused on safety, quality, accountability, and project delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and develop construction personnel and emerging leaders.
* Promote collaboration and effective communication across all project functions.
* Support workforce planning, succession planning, and talent development initiatives.
* Foster an inclusive and respectful work environment that encourages engagement and continuous improvement.

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

### **Technical and Industry Experience**

  

* Experience leading construction execution on major capital projects within one or more of the following sectors:
  + Mining and Minerals Processing
  + Traditional Energy (Oil & Gas, Refining, Petrochemical)
  + Renewable Energy (Wind, Solar, Hydro)
  + Clean Energy (Hydrogen, Carbon Capture, Biofuels, Energy Transition)
  + Chemicals
  + Infrastructure, Utilities, Manufacturing, or Heavy Industrial Facilities
* Demonstrated success managing multidisciplinary construction teams on complex projects.
* Strong understanding of construction management practices, field execution, contractor management, and project delivery processes.
* Experience supporting projects through construction, commissioning, startup, and turnover.
* Strong understanding of construction scheduling, workface planning, productivity management, and construction work packaging.
* Experience leading constructability reviews and construction planning activities.
* Strong understanding of health, safety, environmental, and quality management systems.
* Experience with EPC and EPCM project delivery models.
* Knowledge of contract administration, change management, risk management, and construction controls.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, schedules, contracts, and technical documentation.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
* Proficiency with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft Office applications is considered an asset.
* Willingness and ability to travel and work at client sites and remote project locations as required.

### **Education and Qualifications**

#### **Required**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience managing industrial construction projects.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in complex construction environments.

#### **Preferred**

  

* Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Construction safety certifications or related health and safety qualifications.
* Previous experience in EPC or EPCM project environments.
* Experience supporting major greenfield and brownfield capital projects.

Title: Planning Manager- Food/ Demand Planner
Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 183582

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview Of The Role:**

* The Demand Planner for M&S Food MENA is responsible for delivering precise demand forecasts to ensure the optimal stock volumes reach every product, store, and channel, actively contributing to meeting availability and waste targets. Utilizing RELEX, the planner optimizes system-led forecasting parameters, focuses on genuine exceptions, and collaborates closely with Category Managers and Supply Chain for smooth commercial alignment. The role requires adept incorporation of promotions and regional events into forecasts while upholding high standards of forecasting accuracy and bias minimization. It also involves a strong emphasis on planning master data accuracy and the effective adoption of new forecasting capabilities, influencing stock levels tied to significant annual sales values in AED.
  

**What You Will Do:**

#### **Forecasting**

  

* Deliver accurate, unbiased forecasts for assigned categories such as Chilled, Ambient & Frozen using RELEX, considering sales trends, seasonality, and customer behavior.
* Configure and optimize forecasting parameters within RELEX to ensure planner focus on genuine exceptions, aiming to maximize forecast release without manual overrides.
* Incorporate promotions, range changes, new product launches, trading plans, and regional events into forecasts prior to cut-off, ensuring the accuracy of promotional forecasts and new-line forecasts in the early weeks.
* Explain variances with clear root causes, agree upon and deliver improvement actions, and conduct monthly accuracy reviews.
* Align commercially with Category Managers to ensure one agreed demand view and flag supply constraints early with the Supply Chain team.
* Maintain accurate and current forecasting master data, including lead times, delivery schedules, and product lifecycle data.
* Drive RELEX adoption and capability by executing effective UAT, logging enhancements, and coaching colleagues on best practices.
  

**Required Skills To Be Successful:**

* Strong analytical and data skills, including advanced Excel, Power BI/Tableau; SQL or Python skills desirable.
* Ability to work with AI/ML driven forecasts, questioning the system with evidence rather than habitually overriding.
* Structured problem-solving skills focused on identifying root causes.
* Excellent communication skills for presenting forecasts and analysis to senior stakeholders.
  

**What Qualifies You For The Role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in demand planning or forecasting, particularly in food/grocery retail or FMCG environments with short-shelf-life products.
* Hands-on experience with advanced planning systems, preferably RELEX, as well as familiarity with regional trading patterns and events.
* Professional certification such as ASCM CPIM or IBF CPF is desirable, along with system implementation or UAT experience.
  

About Al-Futtaim Retail

At Al-Futtaim Retail, we are part of a 90-year legacy built on ambition, progress and long-term vision. As one of the region’s leading retail operators, we partner with some of the world’s most trusted brands – including IKEA, ACE, Marks & Spencer and the Inditex Group – bringing global excellence to customers across MENA and Southeast Asia.

We don’t just operate stores; we shape retail experiences. From launching brands like Watsons and Kiabi to our regions for the first time, to investing in digital innovation, AI capabilities, the customer experience and loyalty platforms, we are constantly redefining the future of retail.

With over 100 nationalities spread across more than 10 countries, our strength lies in our diverse and collaborative community. Here, you’re equipped to turn your ambition into action, building the career you want, while helping us move retail forwards.

Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.

55 rooms. Previous hotel management housekeeping required. Must be able to work weekends. As this is a smaller hotel, the exec would be expected to have a board of their own near daily.

Guided by our core values, we will exceed the expectations of our guests and members and enhance the value of our partners' investments.

The Hotel Executive Housekeeper at Berkeley plays a pivotal role in ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness and guest satisfaction throughout the property. This leadership position is responsible for managing and supervising the housekeeping team to maintain impeccable guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces. The Executive Housekeeper will develop and implement cleaning procedures, schedules, and quality control measures to optimize operational efficiency and uphold brand standards. Additionally, this role involves coordinating with other hotel departments to support seamless guest experiences and address any housekeeping-related concerns promptly. * High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 years of experience in housekeeping, with at least 1 year in a supervisory or management role.
* Strong knowledge of cleaning.
* Ability to lead and motivate a diverse team effectively.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working in a branded hotel environment.
* Familiarity with budgeting and inventory management.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations and environmental sustainability practices.

Manager, Legal ComplianceOverview:  
  
At Mastercard, we believe that how we do business is as important as what we achieve. That is why we are committed to the highest standards of ethics and integrity in all our dealings around the world. Indeed, ethics and compliance are embedded in our core company values and are essential both to the personal success of every Mastercard employee and to the continued success of the company. Mastercard's Legal Compliance Group is responsible for ensuring the organization’s compliance with a series of laws and regulations, and for implementing, overseeing and executing programs, policies and procedures to that effect.
  
  
The role of Manager, Legal Compliance reports to the Vice President, Legal Compliance Risk Management. The Manager acts as a central point of contact across Global Ethics & Compliance for all Compliance M&A due diligence and integration activities globally, with primary responsibility for coordinating compliance activities associated with mergers, acquisitions, minority investments, joint ventures, divestitures, and other strategic transactions, as well as key compliance risk-management processes. The Manager supports the continued development and operation of the compliance risk-management frameworks, including risk and control assessments, risk appetite reporting, control governance, issue management, and executive reporting.  
  
Role:  
  

* Support compliance due diligence and integration for acquisitions, minority investments, joint ventures, fund investments, divestitures, and other strategic transactions
* Review due diligence materials and screening results, document findings, and escalate matters requiring specialist or management review
* Engage with subject matter experts within Global Compliance as needed in the M&A / JV life cycle
* Provide guidance and thought leadership to business throughout the M&A / JV process
* Maintain transaction trackers, pipeline reporting, risk-register inputs, and supporting documentation
* Support the end-to-end Compliance Risk and Control Self-Assessment process, including planning, stakeholder engagement, assessment completion, quality review, management reporting, documentation, and assessment enhancements.
* Support Compliance assessments in line with the Operational Risk and Controls framework, including process identification, risk and control mapping, taxonomy alignment, and assessment guidance
* Provide advice and guidance to Compliance Program Owners on the design and effectiveness of their controls
* Reconcile assessment results across source documentation, risk-management systems, and leadership presentations, preserving traceability and reporting consistency
* Manage the Compliance ERM Risk Appetite metrics reporting; analyze trends, threshold exceptions, risk appetite breaches, underlying business drivers, and remediation progress
* Support broader compliance risk, issue, and change-management initiatives by identifying process improvements, applying relevant best practices, and tracking enhancements through completion
* Stay current on compliance best practices and apply enhancements to the compliance risk management program
* Lead and support ad hoc projects across Global Compliance areas
* Identify opportunities to improve compliance and risk-management processes through automation, standardized tools, and AI-enabled solutions

  
The successful candidate will effectively support the execution and continuous improvement of compliance and risk-management programs through risk assessments, governance, data analytics, executive reporting, transaction due diligence, and technology enablement.  
  
All About You  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, or advanced degree desirable
* Understanding of the legal and regulatory requirements of a payment system
* Working knowledge of Compliance related areas (AML, Sanctions, Anti-Corruption)
* Experience in developing process maps, dashboards, and levering AI to improve reporting and program efficiencies
* Experience conducting risk assessments
* Ability to translate data into information to drive improvements
* Demonstrated ability as an effective project manager
* Practical problem solver with demonstrated ability to partner effectively with others in handling complex and/or sensitive issues
* Proven leadership ability to manage, motivate others, able to set ambitious goals and translate into clear objectives
* Demonstrated effectiveness operating in complex organizational structure
* Confident and seasoned leader with strong interpersonal skills and sound business judgment
* Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills
* Experience in payments technology is a plus

Title: Sr Strategy & Programs Manager, Internet Local Marketing Strategy Lead
Description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. The Sr. Strategy and Programs Manager, FWA HSI Local Marketing Activation is the connection between FWA High Speed Internet local marketing strategy and what happens in market. This role owns how local marketing gets activated for FWA HSI: partnering with the HSI acquisition team to identify opportunities and priorities, deciding where, why, and how to activate, designing the programs that do it, and enabling the field to run those programs with confidence.
  
  
The role works where network capacity and demand are out of balance. That includes High Supply and Low Demand markets, where available capacity isn’t converting into activations, and markets where churn and disconnects are eroding growth. This person turns market-level data into targeted local programs, runs them, measures them, and scales what works.
  
  
This is not a project coordinator role. This person builds the activation programs, owns their delivery, and is accountable for whether they drive new accounts and retention in market.
  
  
This is a remote role. Travel expectation is up to 30% nationally, covering market visits, National Marketing engagements, planning sessions, and team collaboration. The best activation programs are designed by people who spend time in the markets they are building.
  
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Activation Strategy & Program Design**

* Own the activation approach. Develop the framework for how FWA HSI local marketing gets activated: which markets, which audiences, which tactics, in what sequence, and what principles guide local decisions.
* Lead High Supply and Low Demand programs. Combine network capacity data with local marketing levers to build programs that convert available capacity into activation and define when a geography qualifies.
* Build complete program designs. Every program should have a clear objective, target audience, channel mix, offer and messaging direction, timeline, budget, and success metric, with rationale for each choice.
* Develop retention-oriented programs. Partner with the disconnect and churn effort to design local programs that reduce HSI churn, not just drive new orders.
* Close the gaps. Identify moments where the organization lacks a proven tactic or a defined approach for FWA HSI, and build the solution instead of flagging it for someone else.

**Program Execution & Field Enablement**

* Run the programs. Own program management from design through launch and close-out: timelines, dependencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional deliverables.
* Enable the field. Give the field everything it needs to execute: program briefs, targeting lists, messaging guidance, creative assets, and clear success criteria.
* Sequence the rollout. Pilot first, then scale in phases, tied to the commercial calendar and to the team’s 2027 expansion into HSI.
* Make it stick. Partner with the Hyperlocal Playbook Manager so proven programs are captured in the playbook as operating standards.

**Measurement & Test-and-Learn**

* Design the tests. Build test-and-control structures for local programs so the team can separate real lift from noise.
* Target with data. Use propensity and segmentation analysis to choose and size markets and opportunity.
* Report what works. Produce clear readouts on incremental new accounts, churn impact, cost per acquisition, and program ROI, and recommend scale, adjust, or stop.
* Close the loop. Run a retrospective at the end of each program and each quarter: what the program produced, where execution diverged from the plan, and what changes next.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with National Marketing. Pull national campaigns, brand guardrails, and creative into field-ready formats, and push field learnings back up so what gets built centrally serves local needs.
* Partner with HSI Acquisition team to identify commercial opportunities and priorities for hyperlocal marketing campaigns
* Partner with Network and Capacity Planning. Get timely, usable capacity data so programs target the right markets at the right time.
* Partner with Analytics and Sales Operations. Align on data, measurement, and incentives so programs are measurable and the frontline is incented to action off of them.
* Coordinate with the Fiber team. Manage the places where FWA and fiber overlap, including footprint eligibility changes and creating an ecosystem accounting for customer moves from HSI to fiber.
* Steward the brand. Ensure local activity stays within T-Mobile brand guardrails while remaining locally effective.

**Quarterly Planning & Field Intelligence**

* Contribute to the planning cycle. Translate commercial targets, capacity conditions, and national priorities into a 90-day activation program plan with market-by-market priorities.
* Synthesize the signal. Aggregate market observations, competitive activity, and program performance into insights that inform local decisions and national direction.
* Find the pattern. Identify which market conditions, audiences, and tactic combinations are producing results and what the team should do more of.
* Brief leadership. Produce a regular update for the Sr. Manager and Director on what’s working, what isn’t, and what the field needs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree and 7 years of related work experience, or a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent
* 7-10 years in marketing strategy, field marketing, growth marketing, or program management, with demonstrated ownership of programs from design through measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including campaign measurement, segmentation, and test-and-control design.
* Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with many stakeholders and no direct authority.
* Experience translating strategy into field-executable programs that people actually use.
* Strong written and verbal communicator who can brief the field, partner teams, and senior leaders.
* Comfortable operating without complete information and adjusting quickly when results come in.
* Experience in telecom, broadband, or a brand with a significant field or local marketing component preferred
* Background managing the interface between a national marketing organization and a distributed field team preferred
* Familiarity with hyperlocal marketing channels — OOH, community partnerships, ambassador programs, geo-targeted digital preferred
* Experience developing audience segmentation frameworks and channel-audience matching strategies preferred
* Background in capability building — has developed training, toolkits, or frameworks adopted by a field team preferred
* At least 18 years of age

Title: Restaurant Technology Manager
Description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Restaurant Technology Manager – UAE is the single point of accountability for all restaurant technology across the UAE market, reporting directly to the Global Head of Technology Operations. The role leads the delivery, support and continuous improvement of all in-store and guest-facing technology across brands, including POS/MIS, BSP, Digital, ALMP, Kiosk, Digital Menu Boards, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, as well as store networks, Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals. The role also manages the restaurant technology vendor portfolio end to end, including contracts, SLAs, service reviews, billing and invoice validation, and payment tracking with Finance and Procurement. By maximizing restaurant uptime, enabling fast incident resolution and ensuring accurate, cost-effective technology spend, the role protects restaurant sales and guest experience while supporting growth and digital ambitions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Restaurant Technology Ownership:**
  Own the end-to-end management of all restaurant technology components in the UAE – POS / MIS, BSP, Digital ordering, ALMP, Kiosk, DMB, Drive-Thru, Last Mile and Aggregator integrations, store network / Wi-Fi, payment terminals, CCTV and peripherals – ensuring stable, secure and standardised operation across all brands.
* **Service Operations & Incident Management:**
  Lead the UAE restaurant technology support team; define, implement and continually improve incident, problem, request and change management processes in line with ITIL and ATO standards.
* **Escalation & Major Incident Management:**
  Act as the escalation point for UAE restaurant operations both in and out of hours; lead major incidents, stakeholder communication and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Vendor Management:**
  Manage all UAE restaurant technology vendors and service providers (POS / hardware, kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, network / telecom, payment, aggregator integration, field service): onboarding, SOWs, SLA governance, monthly service reviews, vendor scorecards, penalties / service credits and renewals, in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* **Vendor Billing & Invoice Validation:**
  Validate every vendor invoice before approval against contract rates, POs, SOWs, asset / license / site counts, delivered services, GRNs and SLA performance; identify and recover over-billing, duplicate charges and unapplied credits.
* **Vendor Payment Validation & Tracking:**
  Validate and track vendor payments with Finance / Accounts Payable; maintain the vendor payment and accruals tracker, ensure payments are released on time and only for accepted deliverables, and resolve vendor payment disputes.
* **Budget & Cost Management:**
  Prepare and manage the UAE restaurant technology opex and capex budget; track actuals vs budget and forecast; drive cost optimisation across licenses, maintenance contracts, telecom and hardware.
* **New Store Openings, Remodels & Rollouts:**
  Deliver restaurant technology for new store openings, remodels, relocations and closures, and lead UAE rollouts of new technology (kiosk, DMB, drive-thru, digital) on time, on budget and to standard.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Maintain an accurate register of restaurant hardware, software licenses and spares; plan lifecycle refresh and manage the spares pool.
* **Information Security & Compliance:**

Title: Senior Health and Safety Manager
Description:
At Mace, our purpose is to redefine the boundaries of ambition. We believe in creating places that are responsible, bringing transformative impact to our people, communities, and societies across the globe. To learn more about our purpose, culture, and priorities, visit our strategy site.

Within our consult business we harness our unique combination of leading-edge practical expertise and project delivery consultancy to unlock the potential in every project.

**You'll Be Responsible For:**

* Provide visible executive leadership for health, safety, and wellbeing across the program and model Mace’s Safety First value.
* Set and maintain program health and safety strategy, policy, standards, governance, delegated authorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Ensure effective control of critical risks including excavation, shafts, temporary works, lifting, work at height, confined spaces, mobile plant, electrical systems, fire, track access, and simultaneous operations.
* Lead health and safety input into design, constructability, logistics, procurement, construction sequencing, energization, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.
* Chair executive safety governance and critical-risk reviews, ensuring decisions are evidence-based and actions are owned and closed.
* Exercise authority to stop or defer work where risk is unacceptable, controls are ineffective, or legal and project requirements are not met.
* Promote occupational health, mental health, fatigue management, exposure control, ergonomics, inclusion, and workforce wellbeing.
* Act as the client’s principal health and safety adviser and provide clear recommendations to the program executive and governance bodies.
* Develop and govern the program health and safety management system, assurance plan, critical-risk framework, audit regime, and reporting model.
* Ensure constructors, contractors, designers, and suppliers discharge their legal, contractual, and project health and safety obligations.
* Lead risk-based assurance across stations, shafts, underground works, compounds, rail systems, testing and commissioning, and operational interfaces.
* Own executive reporting on leading and lagging indicators, high-potential events, critical controls, occupational health, regulatory matters, and contractor performance.
* Lead strategic engagement with Ontario regulators, emergency services, joint health and safety committees, workforce representatives, and independent assurance providers.
* Provide health and safety leadership through major transitions including mobilization, excavation, structural completion, fit-out, permanent power, dynamic testing, trial operations, and handover.
* Sponsor serious incident investigations and learning reviews, ensuring systemic causes are addressed and improvements are verified across the program.
* Provide independent, evidence-based advice where schedule, cost, production, or stakeholder pressure conflicts with safe delivery.
* Ensure incidents, near misses, hazards, occupational illnesses, and regulatory interactions are reported and governed transparently.
* Maintain auditable records and ensure executive decisions, acceptance of risk, exemptions, and corrective actions are documented appropriately.
* Challenge normalization of deviance, weak supervision, under-reporting, recurring deficiencies, and superficial close-out.
* Escalate significant legal, safety, reputational, or operational risks promptly with clear options and recommendations.
* Protect workers’ rights and confidentiality while meeting legal, contractual, and governance obligations.
* Lead, structure, and develop the program health and safety function, including senior managers, managers, advisers, inspectors, occupational health resources, and specialist support.
* Establish clear functional accountabilities, competency requirements, succession plans, resource forecasts, and performance expectations.
* Coach program executives, project directors, construction leaders, and contractor leadership to integrate risk control into business and delivery decisions.
* Promote worker engagement, learning teams, joint inspections, critical-control verification, and effective joint health and safety committees.

**You’ll Need To Have:**

* Proven Director-level or head-of-function health and safety leadership experience on major subway, metro, railway, underground, or similarly complex infrastructure programs.
* Demonstrated accountability for multiple contractors, projects, stations, or work packages within a major program environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of underground station construction, deep excavations, shafts, temporary works, lifting, confined spaces, utilities, MEP, rail systems, and commissioning interfaces.
* Thorough knowledge of Ontario occupational health and safety requirements, constructor duties, employer responsibilities, worker rights, and joint health and safety committees.
* Experience designing and governing health and safety management systems, critical-risk frameworks, assurance programs, and executive performance reporting.
* Experience leading serious incident investigations and organizational learning across major projects.
* Ability to influence program executives, clients, contractors, designers, regulators, and workforce representatives.
* Strong executive communication, governance, negotiation, decision-making, coaching, and crisis-management capability.
* A record of improving culture, leading indicators, critical-control effectiveness, contractor accountability, and occupational health outcomes.
* A degree or recognized qualification in occupational health and safety, engineering, construction management, or a related discipline.
* A Canadian Registered Safety Professional designation, Canadian Health and Safety Consultant designation, National Construction Safety Officer designation, or equivalent professional credential is preferred.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience, including substantial Director-level or head-of-function responsibility on major infrastructure programs.
* Experience with ISO 45001-aligned management systems, risk-based assurance, human factors, organizational learning, and critical-control management.
* Formal training in incident investigation, auditing, emergency management, occupational hygiene, or behavioural and human factors approaches is advantageous.
* Experience in operational rail environments, underground works, brownfield interfaces, or transit commissioning is strongly preferred.
* A visible, credible, authoritative, and solutions-focused executive leadership style with the confidence to challenge decisions at any level.
* Eligibility to work in Canada and willingness to work across project offices, stations, shafts, tunnels, compounds, and operational environments in the Greater Toronto Area.

**Our values**

**Safety first - Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

**Client focus - Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

**Integrity - Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

**Create opportunity - For our people to excel:** We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

**Note:** The estimated salary for this position is 130,000 - 180,000 CAD. Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills and qualifications.

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organization.

We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable with-in the role.

Title: Vice President Safety
Description:
**Pay Rate:**

$170,000 - $200,000/year

**Position Summary**

The Vice President, Safety serves as the company's senior subject-matter leader and executive advisor on occupational safety, health, regulatory compliance, and loss prevention. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this role develops and executes a comprehensive, company-wide safety strategy aligned with organizational objectives and the unique risks associated with low voltage and specialty contracting operations. The Vice President, Safety leads the company's Safety leadership team, provides executive oversight of safety programs, incident management, training, and performance reporting, and partners with operational leaders to build a culture in which safety is incorporated into business decisions at every level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Safety Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive, company-wide safety strategy aligned with organizational objectives, operational priorities, and the unique risks associated with low voltage and specialty contracting operations.
* Serve as the company's senior subject-matter leader and executive advisor on occupational safety, health, regulatory compliance, and loss prevention.
* Establish enterprise-wide safety goals, performance expectations, leading and lagging indicators, and accountability standards.
* Provide executive leadership with regular assessments of safety performance, significant incidents, emerging risks, regulatory developments, and recommended actions.
* Partner with operational leaders to ensure safety is incorporated into business decisions rather than functioning as a separate compliance activity.
* Build and sustain a culture in which leaders at every level understand their responsibility and accountability for safe operations.

**Safety Programs & Risk Management**

* Provide executive oversight of the company's safety and loss-control programs, policies, procedures, and management systems.
* Ensure programs remain aligned with applicable OSHA requirements, NFPA 70E, client requirements, and federal, state, and local regulations.
* Establish consistent company-wide standards for hazard identification, jobsite safety, electrical safety, fall protection, ladder safety, personal protective equipment, fleet and driver safety, and other risks applicable to company operations.
* Evaluate emerging operational risks and ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into policies, training, project planning, and field execution.
* Partner with Risk Management, insurance carriers, brokers, and operational leadership to reduce the frequency and severity of workplace injuries, vehicle incidents, property losses, and other safety-related exposures.
* Provide executive oversight of drug and alcohol testing programs, including pre-employment, random, reasonable-suspicion, post-accident, and other testing required by company policy or applicable regulations.

**Incident Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish standards for reporting, investigating, documenting, and responding to injuries, incidents, near misses, vehicle accidents, and significant safety events.
* Provide executive oversight of serious incident and root-cause investigations, ensuring corrective and preventive actions address systemic issues rather than individual events alone.
* Review incident trends and leading indicators to identify recurring hazards, operational weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure significant corrective actions are assigned, tracked, validated, and closed.
* Partner with Operations and Human Resources on return-to-work and restricted-duty strategies following workplace injuries.

**Field Operations & Project Safety**

* Establish expectations and standards for field audits, inspections, observations, and project safety reviews across company operations.
* Ensure Safety leadership maintains a visible field presence and develops strong working relationships with field employees, supervisors, project managers, and operational leaders.
* Provide oversight of project-specific safety plans and requirements for complex, high-risk, or strategic projects.
* Participate in or assign appropriate Safety leadership to preconstruction, pre-bid, project-startup, and client safety meetings.
* Evaluate customer and general-contractor safety requirements and work with Operations to address requirements that create significant operational, contractual, or financial risk.
* Ensure lessons learned from field observations and incidents are translated into improvements across the organization.

**Training & Safety Culture**

* Establish the company's safety training strategy and minimum training requirements by position and level of responsibility.
* Oversee the development and effectiveness of safety orientation, toolbox talks, supervisor training, regulatory training, and continuing education programs.
* Ensure required certifications and regulatory training are appropriately tracked and maintained.
* Develop leadership capability among managers and supervisors so that safety ownership resides with Operations as well as the Safety organization.
* Lead initiatives that increase employee engagement, hazard reporting, near-miss reporting, and proactive identification of unsafe conditions.
* Chair or provide executive sponsorship for the company Safety Committee and other safety-related leadership forums.

**Performance Measurement & Executive Reporting**

* Establish and monitor meaningful safety performance metrics, including leading indicators as well as traditional lagging measures.
* Provide monthly, quarterly, and annual safety reporting and analysis to executive leadership.
* Monitor trends involving recordable incidents, lost-time injuries, severity, vehicle incidents, near misses, corrective actions, training completion, inspections, and other relevant measures.
* Use safety data to establish priorities and direct company resources toward areas of greatest risk.
* Benchmark company performance against relevant industry trends, insurance data, customer expectations, and organizational goals.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the company's Safety leadership team, including Safety Directors, Managers, Leads, and Specialists as applicable.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, territories, reporting structures, and performance expectations throughout the Safety organization.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing safety professionals capable of partnering effectively with field and operational leadership.
* Assess organizational staffing needs based on company growth, project locations, customer requirements, and operational risk.
* Build succession plans and develop future Safety leaders.

**External & Regulatory Relationships**

* Serve as a senior company representative, as appropriate, with OSHA and other regulatory agencies, insurance carriers, brokers, customers, general contractors, trade associations, and other external stakeholders.
* Maintain awareness of regulatory changes and emerging industry practices and determine their implications for company operations.
* Support major customer qualification processes, audits, and requests involving company safety performance and programs.
* Represent the company's safety philosophy and capabilities during strategic customer discussions, major project pursuits, and other executive-level engagements.

**Budget & Administration**

* Develop, manage, and monitor the annual Safety department budget.
* Evaluate investments in training, technology, PPE, equipment, outside consultants, and other safety resources based on organizational risk and business need.

* Maintain executive oversight of the corporate safety manual and ensure policies and programs remain current, practical, and aligned with company operations.
* Evaluate safety management technology and reporting systems to improve visibility, accountability, trend analysis, and field adoption.

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work expected for this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. The company reserves the right to modify job duties at any time based on business needs.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Safety Management, Environmental Health and Safety, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and executive-level experience.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible safety experience, preferably within electrical, low voltage, specialty contracting, construction, or similarly distributed field operations.
* 5+ years of senior safety leadership experience with responsibility for multiple locations, regions, business units, or a geographically dispersed workforce.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing professional safety teams.
* Extensive working knowledge of OSHA regulations and construction-industry safety practices.
* Strong knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical workplace safety requirements relevant to company operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading serious incident investigations, root-cause analysis, corrective-action programs, and organizational learning.
* Experience developing and presenting safety performance information and risk recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to influence operational leaders and drive organizational change without relying solely on positional authority.
* Ability and willingness to travel regularly to company offices, projects, and jobsites.

**Preferred**

**Professional Credentials**

One or more of the following is strongly preferred:

* Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
* Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST)

* Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), where applicable
* OSHA 30-Hour Construction
* OSHA Outreach Trainer authorization or comparable advanced safety credentials

**Leadership Competencies**

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Executive presence: Communicates credibly and effectively with executives, customers, field employees, regulators, and business partners.
* Strategic thinking: Identifies risks beyond individual incidents and develops scalable solutions that improve the organization as a whole.
* Operational credibility: Understands how construction work actually gets performed and develops safety expectations that are practical, enforceable, and effective in the field.
* Influence: Builds commitment to safe work practices through relationships, credibility, coaching, and accountability.
* Accountability: Establishes clear expectations and follows through when performance does not meet company standards.
* Data-driven decision making: Uses incident data, observations, trends, and leading indicators to establish priorities and allocate resources.
* Change leadership: Successfully implements new programs, expectations, technologies, and operating practices across a distributed organization.
* Talent development: Builds a strong Safety organization and develops leaders who can operate effectively at both the field and management levels.
* Business partnership: Balances employee protection, regulatory obligations, client requirements, operational realities, and business risk without compromising essential safety standards.

Description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 182470

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. This position ensures the governance, quality, and final sign-off of technical solutions, estimates, cost sheets, and bid submissions. The role is pivotal in qualifying opportunities, ensuring technical compliance, deliverability, cost competitiveness, and successful handover to delivery teams. The Head of Pre-Sales also manages the pre-sales operating model, engagement frameworks, and feedback loops to improve bid speed, solution differentiation, and customer conversion rates while safeguarding gross margin.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Leadership, Strategy and Capacity**

  
  

* Lead the regional Pre-Sales function and establish a high-performance, customer-centric and control-focused culture with clear LOB ownership, workload allocation, succession and capability plans.
* Develop and execute the Product and Services Strategy across supported domains, aligned with market priorities, partnership strengths, recurring-revenue opportunities and AFT delivery capability.
* Maintain a capacity plan by geography and LOB; prioritize strategic bids; identify skill gaps; and recommend hiring, cross-utilization, automation or approved external support.
* Ensure senior pre-sales governance remains independent enough to challenge scope, pricing, and risk while collaborating closely with Sales.
  

  

#### **Opportunity Qualification and Bid Governance**

  
  

* Implement a documented bid/no-bid and Go/No-Go process covering strategic fit, probability, client budget, technical feasibility, compliance, delivery capacity, cash/credit exposure, contract risk, vendor readiness, and expected margin.
* Assign a bid owner, independent reviewer, RACI, timeline, and dependency plan at kickoff; front-load site surveys, portal access, RFIs, vendor engagement, and approvals.
* Chair deal-desk reviews for major or high-risk opportunities and obtain all required DOA approvals before submission.
* Maintain clear decision records for proceed, re-scope, partner, no-bid, and management-approved strategic-margin exceptions.
  

  

#### **Solution Architecture, Design Assurance, and Consultant Management**

  
  

* Govern the design basis and solution architecture, including integrations, capacity, redundancy, lifecycle, supportability, cybersecurity, authority requirements and delivery feasibility.
* Ensure a requirements traceability and compliance matrix is completed for every material bid, with each requirement classified as compliant, qualified, deviated, excluded, or subject to clarification.
* Lead consultant/client technical strategy: workshops, RFIs, technical clarifications, alternative approvals, material-submittal dependencies, brand/specification changes, and documented acceptance of deviations.
  

  

#### **Cost Estimation and Estimate Completeness**

  
  

* Establish and enforce an Estimate Completeness Standard for project, service and AMC proposals. No estimate is complete until the scope, quantities, interfaces, duration, resources, risks and commercial inputs have been independently checked.
* Ensure cost sheets capture, where applicable: Principal and local materials; freight, customs, duty, FX and escalation; accessories, consumables, back boxes and mock-ups; BIM/CAD/design.
* Validate manpower using the programme, work breakdown, geography, site conditions and Finance/HR-approved fully loaded rates. Obtain Delivery/PMO or Service Delivery validation before finalization.
* Approve the estimate only when unresolved items are quantified, allocated to a named owner and covered through contingency, qualification, variation entitlement or management-approved risk acceptance.
  

  

#### **Commercial Competitiveness and Vendor/OEM Management**

  
  

* Create a competitive solution and pricing strategy from the first submission, normally including a fully compliant base option and an AFT-designed value-engineered alternative where the tender permits.
* Build and manage principal, OEM, distributor and specialist-partner relationships; secure registrations, certifications, rebates, project discounts, price validity, lead-time commitments, and technical support early in the cycle.
  

  

#### **Proposal Quality and Submission Control**

  
  

* Ensure proposals are complete, accurate, persuasive and aligned with RFP format, technical and commercial separation, required certificates, datasheets, drawings, compliance matrices and submission instructions.
* Enforce a two-level review for major bids: preparer/LOB review followed by independent cross-check and Head of Pre-Sales sign-off.
* Ensure timely submission of all tenders across UAE, KSA and Qatar, with documented exceptions and recovery actions.
  

  

#### **Service, AMC and Casual-Job Costing**

  
  

* Ensure Pre-Sales is the single point of accountability for service-proposal solution design, BOQ, vendor quotations and costing completeness before customer submission.
* Use Finance-approved loaded man-hour rates and validate service frequency, response/resolution commitments, standby/on-call requirements, vehicles, tools, spares, subcontract support, escalation, warranty overlap and contract duration.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Technical proficiency in solution architecture across ICT, ELV, and integrated digital systems.
* Advanced estimate review and cost modeling capabilities including Excel, CRM, and analytics platforms.
* Strategic leadership and decision-making skills with a focus on competitiveness and risk management.
* Strong negotiation, executive presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Controls/Automation or a relevant discipline.
* MBA, Master's degree, chartered/professional engineering credential or recognized commercial/estimating qualification is preferred.
* 12-15 years of progressive experience in ICT, ELV/SSLV, BMS, AV, digital or systems-integration pre-sales, including significant regional leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-country tendering and major, multi-system bids in UAE and/or KSA; experience in Qatar is advantageous.

Title: Head of Sales
Description:
**About Us**

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

We recently acquired Adaptify, bringing its engineering team in-house and accelerating our platform roadmap. We are now a fully remote team backed by private equity, with consulting expertise and technology under one roof.

**The Opportunity**

We are hiring a Head of Sales to lead our sales team day to day and build the sales engine for Martin’s next stage of growth. In this newly created role, you will own team performance, pipeline, forecasting, and sales process. That frees our Chief Revenue Officer to focus on revenue strategy, strategic relationships and new markets.

With our recent acquisition of Adaptify, we have a bigger story to tell and a broader offering to sell. This role will shape how we take that combined offering to market.

Selling at Martin is consultative. Our clients increasingly buy expertise and software together, and our deals range from productized platform sales to complex, custom engagements. You will lead a team that sells both well, working alongside Sales Engineers and our Professional Services Group so that what we sell is what we deliver.

This is a builder's role. We are looking for a leader who coaches as well as they close, who brings structure without slowing the team down, and who is energized by taking a capable sales team to the next level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead and develop the sales team**

* Manage, coach and develop the sales team through regular one-on-ones, deal coaching and call reviews
* Set clear expectations for activity, pipeline and results, and hold the team accountable to them
* Hire, onboard and ramp new sellers as the team grows
* Build the team's fluency in selling services and software together

**Own pipeline, forecast and results**

* Own team quota attainment across new business and expansion
* Run a disciplined pipeline and forecast cadence, and report results to the CRO and executive team
* Stay close to the deals that matter: join key client conversations, shape strategy and help the team close
* Use CRM data to spot what is working, what is stalling and where to focus

**Build the sales engine**

* Define and document a repeatable sales process, from qualification through close, for both productized and custom deals
* Establish the playbooks, messaging and tools the team needs to sell consistently
* Partner with the CRO on territory and account planning, pricing approach and compensation design
* Work with Marketing on pipeline generation and with Product on market feedback
* Lead the team's shift to selling the combined services and technology offering, including positioning, messaging and cross-sell into existing clients

**Partner across the business**

* Work with Sales Engineers on discovery, demonstrations and solution design
* Bring the Professional Services Group into deals early so scope, pricing and timelines are right before signature
* Represent Sales in deal review alongside Operations, Finance and Product
* Stay engaged through the transition from sale to delivery, so clients experience one team
* Coordinate with Account Management on renewals and growth within existing clients

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of B2B sales experience, including 3+ years leading and developing a sales team
* A record of meeting or beating team targets in a consultative, multi-stakeholder sale
* Experience selling professional services, software, or ideally both together
* Insurance, insurtech or financial services experience strongly preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn a technical domain quickly are required
* Experience building sales process and forecasting discipline in a growth-stage company, ideally PE- or VC-backed
* A coaching mindset, with examples of sellers you have developed and promoted
* Comfort working in the details: CRM data, deal strategy and live client conversations
* The ability to build trust across Sales, Delivery, Product and Finance in a fully remote company

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real scope at the right moment.** You will shape how Martin sells as we scale, with direct access to the CRO and executive team.
* **Expertise that scales.** Our value comes from deep insurance expertise, delivered through people and a platform. You will sell something clients need and that few firms can offer.
* **Own the outcomes.** We give leaders room to build and expect them to deliver. You will have the mandate to make the changes the team needs.
* **Do the right thing.** We sell what we can deliver and stand behind it. Long-term client trust matters more to us than a quick close.

* **A remote team that stays connected.** We are fully remote by design and invest in bringing people together.
* **Momentum you can sell.** A recent acquisition, an expanded engineering team and private equity backing give us the product, the resources and the ambition to grow.

**Salary and Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $185,000 – $210,000, based on experience.

* **Variable compensation:** On-target earnings (OTE) of $290,000 – $330,000, with an approximately 65/35 base-to-variable mix. Variable pay is tied to team performance.
* **Benefits:** Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance, including:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Fully remote work environment

Title: Trans Cost & Productivity PM, ACES TREX
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Transportation Excellence (TREX) team in AMET (Middle East, Turkey and Africa) is looking for a Program Manager to drive cost and productivity improvements across our Last Mile delivery network. The team is the single owner of labor cost optimization and productivity across the region. We work with Operations, Finance, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) and Science teams to deliver great service at the lowest cost per shipment.  
  
You'll be based in Dubai and own a portfolio of cost and productivity programs in one or more AMET countries (UAE, KSA, Egypt and Türkiye). You'll find inefficiencies in route productivity, fleet utilization against paid hours, DSP capacity and channel mix. You'll measure the opportunity and lead launches from pilot to regional scale. You'll build and own weekly and monthly reporting and run deep dives on cost per shipment (CPS) and productivity drivers. You'll also present results in business reviews and help shape annual operating plans (OP1/OP2) with clear, data-backed targets.  
  
This role suits a builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and can move between detailed data analysis and leading teams that don't report to them. You'll be encouraged to use automation and AI tools to scale how we plan and optimize, and to raise the bar on how the network runs. Your work will directly affect the cost structure and customer experience of one of Amazon's fastest-growing regions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Own and deliver cost and productivity programs end to end: find the opportunity, build the business case, pilot, launch and sustain
* Track and report key metrics and explain what's driving changes
* Work with Operations, Finance, DSPs, Tech and Science teams to launch process and tool improvements
* Help set annual planning targets and track progress against plan
* Write clear narratives and status updates for senior leadership

  
About the team  
Transportation Excellence (TREX) is the central team that improves how Amazon's Last Mile network runs across the Middle East, Turkey and Africa (AMET). We work closely with the operations teams in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Türkiye. We own the programs that cut cost, raise productivity and improve the delivery experience across the region.  
  
Inside TREX, the Cost & Productivity team is the single owner of Last Mile labor cost and productivity for AMET. We look at the whole picture: route planning, fleet use, partner capacity and how the network is set up. We find where money is being lost and fix it in ways that last and work at scale. We work with Operations, Finance, Delivery Service Partners, Science and Tech teams. We also work side by side with the other TREX teams, such as Customer Experience & Escalations and Line Haul, so that savings never come at the cost of the customer.  
  
We're a small, senior team based in Dubai. We're hands-on, we rely on data, and we're always building. Everyone on the team owns their programs end to end, from the first analysis to launch across the region. You'll get exposure to senior leaders through our weekly and monthly business reviews. We're also early users of automation and AI tools in how we plan, report and make decisions. If you like hard problems, fast-growing markets and seeing your work directly change the business, you'll fit in well here.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
* Experience in lean or six sigma methodologies for operational, process, and performance improvement projects including process mapping and process re-design
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
