Title: Technical Architect – SAP S/4HANA, ABAP & BTP
Description:
### **Technical Problem Solver | Solution Navigator | Trusted Advisor**

**Location**: Remote

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Department**: Professional Services / Delivery

**Reports To**: Practice Director / VP Delivery

### **About the Role**

Bramasol is seeking an experienced SAP Technical Architect with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) to help customers translate complex business challenges into practical, scalable, and sustainable SAP solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge with business understanding, curiosity, sound judgment, and strong consulting skills. This individual understands not only how SAP technologies work, but when and why to apply them to achieve the best business outcomes.

This is a hands-on, client-facing technical leadership role focused on bridging business and technology. The Technical Architect will evaluate requirements, explore alternative approaches, and recommend appropriate solutions leveraging standard SAP functionality, ABAP development, SAP BTP services, integrations, extensions, automation, and emerging technologies.

We are looking for a natural problem solver who asks thoughtful questions, challenges assumptions constructively, and approaches complex challenges with a “let’s figure out how” mindset, rather than simply explaining why something cannot be done.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Business Understanding & Technical Problem Solving**

* Engage with business stakeholders and functional teams to understand business objectives, challenges, and underlying requirements.
* Ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to solving business problems.
* Translate business requirements into practical SAP technical solution options, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, costs, and long-term implications.
* Evaluate when to leverage standard SAP functionality, ABAP, SAP BTP, integrations, extensions, automation, or other technologies.
* Recommend solutions that balance business value, technical feasibility, implementation effort, and long-term maintainability.

### **Technical Architecture & Solution Design**

* Design scalable, secure, and supportable technical solutions across SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Public Edition, and hybrid landscapes.
* Apply SAP Clean Core principles when evaluating standard capabilities, ABAP Cloud, in-app and side-by-side extensibility, APIs, and integration approaches.
* Provide architectural guidance across SAP BTP services, including Integration Suite, API Management, and relevant development and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, data flows, integration patterns, security considerations, performance requirements, and operational supportability.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, solution design workshops, and architecture reviews.
* Establish and promote technical standards, reusable patterns, and development best practices.

### **Technical Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Provide technical leadership across SAP implementations, migrations, integrations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Take ownership of technical architecture decisions and remain engaged throughout development, testing, deployment, and stabilization to ensure successful outcomes.
* Guide and mentor ABAP developers, integration specialists, BTP consultants, and other technical team members.
* Review technical designs, challenge proposed approaches, and assist in resolving complex technical issues.
* Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, and other architects to identify risks, manage dependencies, and drive decisions to closure.
* Proactively communicate technical concerns, recommend solutions, and follow through on commitments.

### **Customer Consulting & Collaboration**

* Build trusted customer relationships through technical credibility, clear communication, responsiveness, and a commitment to customer success.
* Translate complex technical concepts into understandable business language to support informed decision-making.
* Work collaboratively across functional and technical disciplines to develop solutions that address customer needs.
* Demonstrate ownership, professional judgment, and accountability when navigating challenging customer situations.
* Maintain a solutions-oriented approach, exploring possibilities and practical alternatives when faced with technical or business constraints.

### **Innovation & Business Development**

* Stay current with SAP S/4HANA, BTP, ABAP Cloud, RAP, Fiori, Integration Suite, and emerging SAP technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI-enabled tools, and modern SAP capabilities to improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to Bramasol’s technical knowledge, reusable solutions, accelerators, and delivery practices.
* Support pre-sales activities, including technical discovery, architecture discussions, solution estimates, and proposal development.

### **Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Extensive experience in SAP technical consulting, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong foundation in SAP ABAP development, including object-oriented ABAP, enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and modern development approaches.
* Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, extensibility, integration technologies, and technical design principles.
* Practical experience with SAP BTP and modern SAP integration approaches, particularly Integration Suite.
* Familiarity with SAP Clean Core principles, ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, OData, and SAP Fiori development approaches.
* Demonstrated experience defining technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
* Ability to evaluate competing technical approaches and recommend solutions based on business value, architectural suitability, and long-term supportability.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated accountability for technical decisions, delivery commitments, and successful customer outcomes.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Architecture experience across multiple full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and/or Public Edition.
* Working knowledge of SAP Finance (FI/CO), Sales and Distribution (SD), or other enterprise business processes.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, API Management, SAP BTP extension services, and automation.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales, solution estimation, and customer advisory engagements.
* SAP certifications in relevant S/4HANA, ABAP, BTP, or Integration Suite technologies.

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Beyond technical expertise, we value consultants who demonstrate:**

* **Curiosity**: A genuine desire to understand business challenges, ask meaningful questions, and explore new possibilities.
* **Ownership and accountability**: A willingness to take responsibility, identify risks early, and follow through until issues are resolved.
* **Collaboration**: The ability to work effectively with customers, functional consultants, developers, and other stakeholders.
* **Practical problem-solving**: The judgment to recognize constraints while finding creative, achievable ways forward.
* **Customer focus**: A commitment to responsiveness, clear communication, professionalism, and earning customer trust.
* **Continuous learning**: An interest in emerging technologies, evolving SAP capabilities, and improving how solutions are delivered.

### **The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a business-oriented technical architect, natural problem solver, and trusted consultant who can move comfortably between business conversations, architectural decisions, and detailed technical discussions.

They understand the SAP technology ecosystem well enough to determine not simply how to build something, but whether it should be built, where it belongs, and which approach creates the greatest long-term value for the customer.

Most importantly, they combine technical expertise with curiosity, collaboration, sound judgment, and the accountability to see solutions through to successful delivery.

Are you a technology-focused problem solver who enjoys helping others and finding practical solutions to technical challenges?

We are seeking a customer-focused and technically skilled professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys troubleshooting a wide range of technology issues, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service to end users.
  
As a Technical Support Specialist, you will serve as the first point of contact for employees requiring IT assistance, providing hands-on support for desktops, laptops, software applications, network connectivity, and peripheral equipment. Working closely with users across the organization and collaborating with senior IT team members, you will help maintain a reliable technology environment through technical problem resolution, hardware and software deployment, user onboarding, account administration, and ongoing system support.
  
Please note that this is a 100% in-office position, working out of East Penn Canada’s Head Office location in Courtice, ON.
  
Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Act as the first point of contact for IT support for employees at head office as well as satellite branch locations across Canada, by phone, remotely, and in person
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, email, network and peripheral issues, and escalate to senior resources when needed
* Set up, configure and deploy laptops, desktops, monitors and peripherals using modern device management tools
* Support Microsoft 365 and Teams users, including account setup, password resets and multi-factor authentication
* Support warehouse technology, including handheld RF scanners, label printers and mobile devices
* Carry out IT tasks for employee onboarding and offboarding, including accounts, equipment and access
* Make sure all service desk tickets are properly logged, routed, escalated and closed according to service levels
* Keep company IT assets tracked, tagged and documented in our systems of record
* Help train staff on standard business software and IT procedures
* Follow IT security procedures and promptly report suspected phishing or security incidents

You will receive comprehensive training on our systems and processes, but a strong foundation and background in the following will set you up for success:
  

* 2+ years of help desk, technical support or customer-facing tech experience, including corporate help desk roles (co-op placements, internships and retail tech-support roles are also valued)
* Diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Systems, Network Technology or a related field, or mix of relevant experience and education
* Hands-on familiarity with Windows, Microsoft 365 and common PC hardware
* Excellent spoken and written communication in English, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and patiently to users at all levels, from warehouse staff to executives
* Strong customer-service attitude and business acumen
* Strong organization and dependability, with timely follow-through on tickets and documentation
* Eagerness to learn and comfort asking for help when needed
* CompTIA A+ or a Microsoft Fundamentals certification is an asset
* Bilingualism (English/French) is considered a major asset

**Important Considerations:**  

* Role-specific background checks are a condition of employment and may include, but are not limited to, employment verifications, criminal record checks, and professional reference checks
* Applicants who are interviewed for this position will receive a notification regarding the hiring decision within 45 days of their final interview date
* Hiring range is approximately $50,000-60,000 (actual salary will be determined based on the successful applicant's education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data)

Join a team within the battery industry that values your contributions and invests in your long-term success.

* Competitive compensation with results-based rewards and annual merit increases tied to performance
* 100% employer paid health and dental benefits, plus insurance coverage, a Health Spending Account, and paid sick days to support your health and wellbeing

Profit sharing and deferred profit-sharing programs to support long-term financial planning
  

* Career growth opportunities, with many roles across our four divisions filled through internal promotions

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada to be considered. East Penn Canada is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and accessibility. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, upon request.

Title: SRO, Customer Excellence.
Description:
We are looking for a Senior Responsible Owner (SRO) for Customer Excellence to lead Echelon’s Customer Excellence Program and own the customer 360, our single view of each customer. You will set how AI agents and account teams work together, so that everyone who serves a customer works from the same, accurate picture.
  
  
****The role: one view of the customer****
Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, you own the customer 360 across our accounts. You work with the CRO’s account teams, the Head of AI Transformation and the deployment strategists, the engineers in the pods, and the leadership team. You bring partner insight into each customer’s view and work closely with the marketing and communications lead on customer engagements.
  
  
****What you’ll do****

* Build the customer 360. One record and one account plan per customer, kept current by AI agents and approved by the account owner: organization and decision makers, systems and data landscape, AI maturity, contracts, projects, pipeline, delivery history and value delivered.
* Own customer data. The quality of customer data in our CRM and delivery tools: what is captured, by whom and when, who can edit it, and how the account teams and pods use it.
* Read the customer. Each customer’s strategy, budgets, AI priorities, leadership changes and buying cycles, briefed to the account teams and strategists before key meetings.
* Measure customer health. Satisfaction and health measures across accounts, feedback after each engagement, and early warnings on accounts at risk.
* Run the cadence. The weekly presence on accounts: account reviews, executive touchpoints, customer events and programs, and their follow-up.
* Inform leadership. A regular customer review for the COO and the leadership team: where we win, where we lose, and what customers ask for that we do not yet deliver.

****What you bring****

* Customer record: 6+ years in customer success, account operations, CRM or customer analytics in a technology or services business.
* Data fluency: At ease with CRM systems, dashboards and imperfect data, and able to make them useful to others.
* Rigour: You keep records accurate and current without being asked, and build simple processes that last.
* Connector: You work across sales, delivery and leadership, and earn trust by being useful.
* AI fluency: You find use cases for AI and turn them into agentic workflows that serve the Customer Excellence Program end to end, and you decide where a person must review their work.

****Strong advantage****

* Sector knowledge: Experience with customers in a sector where Echelon leads, such as government, energy, financial services or healthcare.
* CRM platforms: Hands-on administration of a major CRM platform.
* Arabic: Professional fluency in Arabic.

****Our values****

* Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritize accordingly.
* Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* Builds others: You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

****How we work****
You start from the customer’s problem and choose the tool to fit it. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.
  
  

* Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves.
* Speed: You move from brief to a first working result quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* Rigour: You test claims against the data, check what is delivered and can explain every choice.
* Confidence and humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organize the work yourself.
* Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar organization: you find a way with what is available.
* Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* A force multiplier: Your playbooks, reviews and coaching make the whole bench faster.
* AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you research, write and decide. You are comfortable working alongside AI agents and setting the rules for when a person must approve their work.
* Who you are: An organized operator who loves customers and data in equal measure, and wants to build a function from the start.

****The seat****

* Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* Reports to: Chief Operating Officer
* Travel: Time at customer sites and events across the Kingdom
* Package: A base salary with housing, transport and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity program. Terms are shared at offer stage.

Title: Legal Counsel
Description:
Echelon contracts continuously: a portfolio of technology partners on structural, programme and referral agreements, MOUs and term sheets with defence and energy technology companies, customer Scopes of Work delivered by our forward deployed teams, and a share plan that reaches every employee.

We are looking for a qualified hands-on lawyer — admitted to practice, with the training that comes with it — who has drafted and negotiated the contracts behind technology and AI delivery services, understands how those businesses work, and has the head for it: one who would rather be the only counsel in the room than one of twenty. The legal function grows next year; you will have shaped how it works before it does.

**THE ROLE: WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
-------------------------------

You will run the day-to-day legal work of the group: drafting, negotiating and closing under the group’s standards, keeping the corporate house in order, and working with the General Counsel and external counsel on the matters that need them. The growing part of that work is services contracting: Echelon sells the expertise and time of its engineers, and the master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, staffing and subcontracting agreements under which they are deployed are heavily negotiated contracts the group signs. You will draft them, negotiate them and close them. Under the Delegation of Authority the CEO is the only signatory, so the quality of what reaches his desk is the whole of the job. Partnerships with technology companies require a different discipline: referral, revenue-share and reseller agreements, IP boundaries and exclusivity terms that must protect Echelon’s margin and position over the life of the relationship, not only the length of one engagement.

You will carry files from first draft to signature, hold Echelon’s positions on exclusivity, margin protection and first right of refusal for our forward deployed teams, and decide what needs the General Counsel and what does not. The method exists; you own the outcome inside it and decide the sequencing and the trade-offs, so that most files close on standard paper and the exceptions get the attention they deserve.

* **Services contracting:** Master services agreements, Scopes of Work, rate cards, and staffing and subcontracting agreements for our engineering services business — with customers, with the partners we deploy for and with the firms we deploy alongside. Large, recurring contracts, often negotiated on the other side’s paper: you draft, negotiate and close them.
* **Partner & commercial contracting:** NDAs, MOUs, term sheets, referral and revenue-share agreements, from first draft to signature through the DoA signature process.
* **Templates & playbooks:** The recurring instruments — partner referral agreement, Partner Revenue Share terms, Scope of Work, NDA, employment contract and amendment — so that most files close on standard paper.
* **Corporate housekeeping:** Board and shareholder resolutions, registers, the shareholders’ agreement and the share plan documentation for the holding company and the Saudi operating company, with the GNRC.
* **Employment & regulatory:** Contracts, performance-bonus amendments, policies and Saudi labour-law compliance with the People function; the regulatory perimeter around data, licensing and, with Echelon Defense Industries, clearance-bound activity.
* **Intellectual property:** Engineering IP held at group level, partner IP boundaries in every deployment, and the protection of Echelon-developed capability as it is productised.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR - WHERE WE ALIGN**
-------------------------------------------

A hands-on lawyer who reads fast, drafts clean and marks uncertainty rather than inventing a position. You find contracts interesting because of what they make possible, not because of what they prevent.

* **Curiosity:** You want to understand the deal before you paper it: where the value sits, what the partner actually wants, what the technology does. You hold the position that protects it.
* **Speed of learning:** An unfamiliar instrument — a share plan, a referral agreement, a defence MOU — comes back from you as a workable draft, not as a list of questions.
* **Ownership & pace:** A file is yours from first draft to signature. You turn a term sheet in days and keep the corporate record current without being asked.
* **Judgement:** Pragmatic on commercial points, immovable on the ones that matter. You escalate the right things and explain why in three sentences.
* **Where you are:** A qualified lawyer — a law degree and admission to practice are required — based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE, with hands-on experience of delivery-services contracting — Scopes of Work, master services and subcontracting agreements — and a working understanding of the technology and AI sector; fluent legal drafting in English, with Arabic spoken and written. What you have closed counts for more than how many years you have been closing.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality :**You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* **Clear communicator:** You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* **Long-term builder:** You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.

**THE SEAT**
------------

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to candidates based in Saudi Arabia or the UAE  
**Languages:** English & Arabic fluent  
**Reporting:** Echelon CEO; dotted line to Echelon’s holding Legal Counsel department  
**Package:** A base salary with housing and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the precedent. You meet an unclear brief or an unfamiliar instrument with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** You learn how the business and its technology really work, and keep learning as the deals and the law move.
* **Speed:** You move from brief to workable draft quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** You check before you rely, read every clause you put forward for signature and can explain every position you take.
* **Confidence & humility:** You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself.
* **Resourcefulness:** Missing documents, partial facts, an unfamiliar jurisdiction: you find a way with what is available.
* **Situational leadership:** You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* **A force multiplier:** Your templates, playbooks and clear guidance make every team you work with faster.
* **AI-native practice:** AI tools are part of how you research, draft and review, and you know where their output needs a lawyer’s check.

Title: Infrastructure Engineer TID
Description:
**Company Description**

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 23,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

 **Job Description**

**Job Purpose:**

Under general supervision performs responsible professional engineering review, assessment, inspection, and administrative duties. This includes reviews of design- & construction- and development proposals related to all infrastructure projects (i.e., roads, highways, bridges, utilities of all kinds, etc.) and ensuring compliance with Qatar Rail requirements, asset protection and future safeguarding. Further advises interfacing parties on NOC requirements, conditions and required actions to obtain approvals.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

The **Infrastructure Engineer** will be responsible for the review of 3rd party applications in reference to Metro/ LRT/Long Distance project interfaces for the operational railways and future phases. The tasks will include review of plans, schematics, calculations, and specifications. The Infrastructure Engineer is required to effectively work with all involved parties, assess proposals, make recommendations, and determines comprehensive response to 3rd party requests. It includes working closely with, coordinating, and collaborating with all Qatar Rail departments, agencies/authorities, designers, and contractors internal and external to ensure conclusive and timely response. These responsibilities include attending meetings with various stakeholders.

* Provide infrastructure interface & coordination services (assistance, guidance) for the Qatar Rail schemes in relation to multiple interfaces with applicants, designers, utility agencies, contractors, stakeholders, etc.
* Review, assess, evaluate, and respond to third party requests, design-, engineering-, and construction- documents including plans, work method and specifications to ensure compliance with applicable requirements, codes, ordinances, and standards (NOC, MME, DR, RO, PTW, IPD, others); with sound understanding of utility works.
* Supporting the sr. engineer and manager as well as the relevant co-workers, departments in tasks related to approvals.
* Ensure & check completeness of documents and submissions as part of the NOC process.
* Provide and prepare interface drawings and relevant response documents.
* Participate in and create manuals, forms, procedures for processing stakeholder applications.
* Identify elements for optimizations and improvement of the department.
* Act as a link between PMC, D&B contractor and third parties.
* Attend and record meetings and act as contact person for local authorities.
* As required, inspect sites on a periodical basis to ensure conformance with permits, design specifications and adherence to quality. Provide site inspection reports.
* Resolve issues within level of authority and address modifications or changes.
* Plan, organize, track, control and evaluate the assigned functions and activities. Works proactively and responsibly.
* Maintain logs and records of work performed; prepares periodic and special reports.
* Monitor and track the TID correspondence (documentation of day-to-day work).
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**General:**

* Incorporate zero harm into staff yearly performance reviews by incorporating and taking into consideration, staff commitment to the Qatar Rail values of safety and environment.
* Commitment to the Zero Harm Ethos by leading by example and taking personal responsibility for their own health and safety and proactively ensuring that any health and safety concerns observed are raised to prevent harm.
* Support the QR Environmental program in reducing QR carbon footprint.
* Managers need to be familiar with relevant laws, regulations and standards that apply to their area of operation.
* Proactive identification of potential hazards/environmental aspects and implementing effective control measures to minimize risks.
* Liaise with HSE professionals from QSHESE Department on complex issues.
* Comply with Qatar Rail’s Company Management System requirements which covers Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, Information Security, Business continuity, Security and Emergency preparedness requiements.
* Attendance of any QSHESE Induction, training, briefing, or meeting as and when required and/or requested to.
* Be mindful that Health and Safety, Quality, Security and Environment is everyone’s responsibility and as such all-Qatar Rail employees are accountable for reporting and intervening in Health, Safety, Quality, Security and Environmental violations.
* Report all incidents and/or near misses, and/or unsafe acts or conditions and where appropriate make recommendations for improvement.
* Ensure your visitor (including contractors, PMCs) are aware of Qatar Rail premise’s emergency response plans.
* Act ethically and within Qatar Rail’s Code of Conduct.
* Undertake additional tasks as required based emerging business needs.

**Authorities:**

The position covers all interfaces through Technical Interface Department with the relevant authorities and governmental bodies. The main interface is related to authorities and stakeholders in relation to 3rd party management for the purpose of permitting within the Rail-Protection-Zone.

**Accountabilities:**

* Establishing clear line of communication with the relevant team members, departments, external stakeholders.
* Review and approve NOC-third party applications, for resign review (DR)- and road opening (RO), permit applications.
* Participate & prepare clear procedure(s) related to stakeholder management.
* Produce status- and progress reports.
* Participate in meetings, audits, presentations, workshops, and other events

**Key Interfaces:**

***Internal:***

* All Metro-, Tram lines and Long-Distance Railway.
* Departments within Program Delivery & Service Delivery
* Contractors & Joint Ventures & Consultants.
* RKH Qitarat (Service Provider)

***External:***

* Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Municipality, Public Works Authority, Civil Aviation Authority, Qatar Foundation, Private Engineering Office, Ministry of Interior (multiple departments), Supreme Committee for Delivery & Legacy, Qatar Olympic Committee, Qatar Ports Authority, Qatar Armed Forces, Hamad International Airport .
* Kahramaa Electricity & Water, Qatar Cool, Qatar Energy (Petroleum), Vodafone, QNBN, Ooredoo, MOI Police, other affected utility companies.
* Third party developers (governmental & private)
* Contractors & consultants
* Third party entities potentially affecting the Qatar Rail assets within the Rail Protection Zone.

 **Qualifications**  

* (B.Sc.) degree in civil engineering or related engineering discipline.
* A minimum of 4 years of documentable experience in fields of infrastructure/utility design and preferably large-scale projects and railway projects. GCC experience is beneficial.
* Knowledge of permitting procedures, requirements, and public approvals.
* Knowledge in infrastructure planning, design, and construction of roads, bridges, drinking water, wastewater, storm drainage, irrigation, power transmission/distribution, and preferably gas-, oil pipelines, district cooling.
* Registered as professional engineer is desirable.
* Membership with professional bodies is desirable.

 **Additional Information**

**Skills:**

* Advanced computer skills in Microsoft office including Word, Excel, Power Point and other computer programs.
* Experience with web-based collaboration technologies for project information and process management software (i.e., Aconex, QDRS / QPRO, etc.).
* Experience with AutoCAD is desired.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Applicant to be fluent in English (verbal/written); Arabic language skills are beneficial.

**Soft Competencies:**

* Excellent verbal, written communication skills and presentation skills
* Self-motivated team-player, capable of working independently & organized
* Ability to analyze situations accurately and take effective action & make critical decisions in stressful situations
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders, peers, and members of the public.

Title: Senior Cybersecurity Specialist - Saudi National
Description:
**Job Description**

The Cybersecurity Senior Specialist shall be responsible for the leadership, governance, assurance, and oversight of all cybersecurity activities. The role will ensure that cybersecurity requirements are defined, implemented, verified, and maintained throughout the project lifecycle, from design and procurement through testing, commissioning, handover and operations readiness.

The Cybersecurity Manager will provide strategic direction and management oversight across Information Technology (IT), Operational Technology (OT), railway control systems, communications systems, station systems and connected infrastructure to ensure cyber risks are identified, managed, and reduced to an acceptable level.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cybersecurity Leadership**

* Develop and implement the project cybersecurity management strategy and cybersecurity assurance framework.
* Establish cybersecurity governance arrangements across all project stakeholders.
* Lead cybersecurity working groups, technical reviews and management reporting activities.
* Act as the primary cybersecurity focal point for the project.

**Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Interface directly with RCRC regarding cybersecurity requirements, compliance activities and assurance reporting.
* Interface with the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) on matters relating to regulatory compliance and cybersecurity controls.
* Coordinate cybersecurity reviews with government agencies, Contractor, Metro Operators and other external stakeholders.
* Support cybersecurity audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.

**Project Delivery Assurance**

* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are integrated into project requirements, specifications, contracts and supplier deliverables.
* Verify cybersecurity requirements are appropriately addressed throughout system design, implementation, testing and commissioning.
* Review and approve cybersecurity documentation produced by contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor implementation of cybersecurity measures across all project packages and disciplines.

**Risk Management**

* Establish and maintain the project Cybersecurity Risk Register.
* Identify, assess and manage cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities affecting project systems and assets.
* Ensure cybersecurity risks are addressed through appropriate mitigation measures and assurance evidence.
* Support risk acceptance and management decision-making processes.

**System and Operational Technology Security**

* Provide cybersecurity oversight of the Contractor for railway signalling, telecommunications, control systems, SCADA, networking infrastructure, station systems and operational technology environments.
* Ensure the Contractor provides appropriate segregation, protection and monitoring of critical operational networks.
* Review the Contractor’s cybersecurity architecture and defence-in-depth strategies and propose guidance.
* Support secure integration between operational and enterprise systems.

**Assurance and Compliance**

* Oversee and guide Contractor’s cybersecurity assurance management activities across the project lifecycle.
* Oversee cybersecurity testing, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and compliance verification activities with the Contractor.
* Ensure the Contractor develops quality cybersecurity case documentation and evidence required for project approvals.
* Support independent assessment and certification activities where required.

**Handover and Operational Readiness**

* Support the development of operational cybersecurity procedures and incident management arrangements.
* Ensure cybersecurity controls are fully implemented prior to system acceptance and handover.
* Coordinate cybersecurity readiness reviews for revenue service commencement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.

Title: Administrator Practice
Description:
Overview:

The Practice Administrator is the senior operational and administrative leader for a high-revenue, multi-location practice portfolio with combined annual net billed revenue of $10 million or more. This role is accountable for the full P&L performance, clinical operations, patient experience, workforce strategy, regulatory compliance, and business development of all assigned locations. The Practice Administrator leads all staff across assigned locations and functions as a strategic operational partner to market operations and medical leadership on quality, access management, growth strategy, and multi-site organizational efficiency.

Responsibilities:

**Financial Management & Performance**

* Own full P&L accountability across the assigned portfolio of locations, including revenue optimization, expense management, and EBITDA performance; report financial results, variances, and action plans on a regular cadence.
* Develop and manage operating budgets; analyze budget-to-actual variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective measures to achieve financial targets.
* Oversee revenue cycle performance at the clinic level, including charge capture accuracy, coding compliance, point-of-service collections, insurance verification, authorization management, and denial resolution in partnership with Revenue Cycle leadership.
* Manage pricing for aesthetic services and retail products; ensure accuracy, consistent application, and alignment with organizational pricing strategy.
* Approve purchase orders within defined authority thresholds; oversee supply and inventory expenditures against budget.
* Monitor and report on key financial KPIs: revenue per visit, clinician productivity, collections rate, and cost per visit.

**Clinician Scheduling, Capacity & Template Management**

* Manage and continuously optimize clinician scheduling templates, with direct accountability for fill rates, appointment lag times, capacity utilization, and each clinician’s achievement of their personally defined ideal schedule ranges; develop and execute action plans to close performance gaps.
* Monitor template performance data on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis; partner with central scheduling where applicable to ensure template structures maximize patient access while aligning to clinician preferences, care model requirements, and budgeted hours.
* Ensure fulfillment of contracted patient care hours for all employed and contracted clinicians; proactively identify and resolve shortfalls before they affect access or financial performance.
* Manage clinician leave, absence coverage, and schedule adjustments to minimize disruption; maintain alignment of staffing hours to budget and demand.
* Monitor the effective and appropriate use of scheduling template blocks, including block types, hold patterns, same-day availability, and recall slot structures; ensure template design reflects current demand patterns, payer mix, and access goals.
* Leverage scheduling technology and access analytics to reduce no-shows and cancellations, improve schedule density, and enhance the patient scheduling experience.
* Partner with the clinician compensation team on productivity reporting, compensation calculations, and contract-related operational data; ensure accuracy and timeliness.

**Clinical Operations & Patient Experience**

* Maintain full operational accountability for all clinic functions, including patient access and intake, clinical support workflows, scheduling coordination, supply management, and administrative operations.
* Monitor operational performance using available dashboards and data; identify gaps, develop action plans, and implement solutions to sustain efficiency, compliance, and patient satisfaction targets.
* Establish and enforce standard operating procedures and care standards; ensure consistent application across all teams and service lines.
* Own the patient experience establishing and enforcing service standards for patient communication, access, wait times, and care environment; respond to patient concerns in a timely and professional manner.
* Monitor patient satisfaction data; develop and execute action plans to address service gaps and drive measurable improvement in experience metrics.
* Conduct regular clinic rounding, operational reviews, and team huddles to assess performance, patient experience, staff morale, and compliance posture.

**People Management & Organizational Development**

* Provide full supervisory authority and administrative leadership for all assigned staff across all assigned locations; hold all direct and indirect reports accountable to performance expectations and organizational standards.
* Primary duties are to provide direct supervision and leadership to an assigned team, with responsibility for managing the full employee lifecycle — including hiring, onboarding, performance management, professional development and, when necessary, separation of staff — in accordance with company policy and in partnership with Human Resources. May provide direct supervision to Managers, Supervisors, Team Leads, Leads, and/or individual contributors.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones with direct reports, providing direction, feedback, coaching, and development support; build leadership bench strength at all levels of the reporting structure.
* Manage and approve timekeeping, scheduling, and administrative entries for all assigned staff; including submissions from those with direct and indirect reporting relationships.
* Partner with HR on complex employee relations matters, performance improvement plans, leave administration, workplace investigations, and compensation actions.
* Foster a high-performance, accountable culture that supports staff engagement, professional growth, and a shared commitment to exceptional patient care.

**Clinician Relations & Medical Affairs**

* Build and maintain strong, trust-based working relationships with physicians and advanced practice clinicians, ensuring alignment on operational expectations, patient care standards, schedule performance, and growth priorities.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for clinician concerns and requests; resolve issues within scope and escalate material or clinical matters appropriately.
* Ensure supervision designations for Advanced Practice Clinicians (APPs), aestheticians, and other staff requiring clinical oversight are clearly communicated; proactively coordinate with medical leadership as needed.
* Partner with medical leadership on clinical performance opportunities, quality improvement initiatives, and align operational programs with clinical goals.
* Manage onboarding and clinic integration for newly recruited or acquired clinicians in coordination with Credentialing, HR, and IT.

**Regulatory Compliance, Risk & Quality**

* Ensure full compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations governing practice operations, including CLIA, OSHA, HIPAA, state medical board requirements, and applicable payer standards.
* Lead annual compliance audits, survey preparation (including CLIA), and regulatory inspections; develop and implement timely remediation plans for any identified findings.
* Ensure all staff complete/maintain current required licensure, certifications, and compliance training. Work closely with HR and Credentialing to support internal tracking procedures.
* Maintain and regularly review clinic policies and procedures to ensure currency with regulatory requirements and organizational standards.
* Implement and monitor risk management plans; escalate safety events, near-misses, and liability concerns promptly.

**Human Resources & Workforce Management**

* Develop and maintain staffing models that align labor hours to patient demand, clinician schedules, and budgeted FTE levels; adjust proactively in response to volume trends, clinician changes, or operational needs.
* Oversee and enforce attendance, punctuality, and schedule adherence; manage FMLA/LOA administration, and absence coverage planning to minimize patient access disruption.
* Facilitate development and delivery of staff training, onboarding programs, and competency verification processes in partnership with other leaders within the clinic(s).
* Monitor workforce metrics including turnover, vacancy rates, overtime utilization, and time-to-fill; develop and present workforce data and action plans.

**Facilities, Technology & Information Systems**

* Oversee facility management across all assigned locations: asset management, room utilization, equipment maintenance, and coordination of expansion, renovation, or relocation activities; escalate capital needs and lease considerations.
* Partner with IT on EHR/EMR and practice management systems, telecommunications, ACD systems, digital scheduling tools, and patient engagement platforms; lead adoption and change management for technology.
* Support business continuity planning for assigned clinic(s), ensuring documented protocols and staff training are in place for technology failures or operational disruptions.
* Manage vendor and service relationships for facilities, clinical equipment, and support services; coordinate repairs and routine maintenance and escalate capital needs within defined protocols.

**Business Development & Strategic Growth**

* Partner with the market operations leadership and M&A teams to support integration of newly acquired practices and clinicians; lead operational readiness evaluation and assist integrations team with onboarding execution as needed.
* Identify and communicate organic growth opportunities including capacity optimization, clinician recruitment support, service line expansion, de novo development, and referral partnership development.
* Oversee aesthetic service line and retail operations, including pricing execution, loyalty program management, and coordination with Marketing on local campaigns and patient acquisition initiatives.
* Collaborate with Marketing to support programs that drive patient volume, improve capacity utilization, and strengthen community presence.
* Represent the assigned portfolio on organizational committees and cross-functional working groups as directed.

**Multi-Site Portfolio Coordination**

* Ensure consistent application of organizational standards, workflows, compliance programs, and performance expectations across locations; identify and address site-level variation that creates operational, financial, or patient experience risk.
* Develop and maintain a structured cadence of site visits, operational reviews, leadership check-ins, and performance discussions across all assigned locations to maintain visibility into performance, culture, and emerging issues.
* Coordinate cross-location resource sharing, staffing support, supply management, and best practice dissemination to maximize efficiency and consistency.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for site-level leaders provide guidance, remove barriers, and resolve or escalate issues appropriately.
* Partner with the market leadership on portfolio-level planning including site improvement priorities, staffing models, capital needs, facility considerations, and market growth opportunities.

**Perform other duties as assigned.**

Qualifications:

**Required Competencies and Skills**

* Expert-level ability to manage a high-revenue, complex, multi-site ambulatory dermatology practice portfolio across P&L performance, clinical operations, workforce management, patient experience, and regulatory compliance.
* Advanced financial acumen including multi-site P&L management for portfolios of $10M+ net revenue, budget oversight, revenue cycle optimization, charge capture governance, EBITDA management, and executive financial reporting.
* Expert proficiency in clinician scheduling template management, capacity optimization, fill rate and lag time KPI management, contracted hours fulfillment, charge capture governance, and access analytics across a multi-location portfolio.
* Demonstrated expertise in clinician performance management, including productivity monitoring, compensation program partnership, APP and aesthetician supervision compliance, and medical leadership collaboration on clinical quality initiatives.
* Strong executive people leadership skills including managing managers and supervisors across a distributed portfolio; expertise in hiring, performance management, coaching, succession planning, and organizational development.
* Comprehensive knowledge of PE-backed healthcare operational frameworks, ambulatory compliance requirements (CLIA, OSHA, HIPAA, state licensure), and multi-jurisdictional regulatory standards.
* Proficiency in EHR/EMR systems, scheduling optimization tools, financial reporting platforms, analytics dashboards, and healthcare operations technology.
* Exceptional executive communication and influence skills; able to engage credibly with frontline teams, clinicians, organizational leadership, and PE ownership stakeholders.
* Strategic operational judgment, financial discipline, and organizational leadership capability commensurate with a senior practice administration role in a high-growth, PE-backed dermatology enterprise.
* Not a remote position. Must be able to travel.

**Education & Experience**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field required**
* ACMPE Fellowship (FACMPE), FACHE preferred
* Master's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Nursing, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 5+ years of progressively responsible medical practice or clinic management experience required, with a minimum of 3 years managing a multi-site ambulatory practice portfolio; $10M+ revenue portfolio experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in a PE-backed, MSO-model, or other high-growth, multi-site ambulatory healthcare organization preferred; Dermatology or medical aesthetics experience preferred.
* Proven P&L accountability for a multi-site portfolio, including financial reporting, budget management, revenue cycle governance, and EBITDA performance management.
* Demonstrated expertise in scheduling template optimization, clinician productivity management, contracted hours compliance, charge capture oversight, and clinician compensation reporting.
* Experience managing Practice Managers, Clinic Managers, and Supervisors across geographically dispersed, high-volume locations required.

Title: Airport Security Officer
Description:
**The Jacksonville Aviation Authority (JAA) welcomes applications for the position of Airport Security Officer (ASO) through midnight on Monday, Novemebr 30, 2026.**

**Job Summary**

This position is a force multiplier for the police department by handling calls that do not require the direct involvement of a sworn officer. The position performs infrastructure protection and regulatory enforcement duties to safeguard the traveling public. This role ensures the physical integrity of the airfield through proactive perimeter inspections, property checks, and management of secure vehicle access gates. They perform primary compliance enforcement by verifying the authorizations of personnel around the airport, conducting comprehensive regulatory testing, issuing security violations, and performing screening operations to detect explosives, incendiaries, and firearms on aviation workers. This role functions as a responder to operational emergencies, including investigating security incidents, managing suspicious or abandoned property, and providing first aid for medical emergencies. The role also maintains curbside safety through traffic mitigation and digital signboard management. This position reports to the Access Control Manager within the Public Safety and Security Department.

**Essential Functions**

* Serves as a first responder to medical emergencies, deploying advanced first aid equipment (Trauma Kits, Tourniquets, AEDs) to stabilize patients and support life prior to the arrival of EMS.
* Maintains an active FDLE/CJIS Limited Access Certification to operate encrypted public safety radio systems and computers, ensuring strict compliance with federal information security standards.
* Conducts administrative investigations into security breaches and Airport Security Program (ASP) violations, utilizing root cause analysis to determine failure points and recommending corrective actions.
* Executes daily comprehensive regulatory audits and vulnerability assessments of the physical security perimeter with adherence to 49 CFR Part 1542 standards.
* Monitors and audits airport construction zones to ensure temporary security barriers and access procedures maintain the integrity of the SIDA areas in compliance with TSA amendments.
* Conducts unannounced compliance inspections of sterile area leaseholders to enforce strict "Tools of the Trade" inventory controls, ensuring prohibited items (knives, scissors, tools) are secured against theft or misuse.
* Audits and validates the performance of contracted security personnel, ensuring they are aligned with JAA security standards and documenting training deficiencies for contract compliance.
* Conducts physical screening operations of aviation workers and property utilizing visual inspection and detection techniques or equipment to prevent the introduction of explosives, incendiaries, and firearms.
* Operates advanced Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) and chemical analysis technology to conduct secondary threat resolution and interpret diagnostic data to definitively determine the presence of energetic materials.
* Enforces "Two-Person Integrity" protocols by serving as an alternate witness during the transfer of K9 explosive training aids, verifying the chain of custody and ensuring sworn officers adhere to strict safety standards.
* Responds to unattended or suspicious property reports, conducting initial threat assessments and executing established removal protocols to ensure public safety.
* Challenges the authorization of all individuals within restricted areas, auditing access media for validity and ensuring regulatory challenge procedures are being followed by airport employees.
* Performs surveillance and compliance inspections of airport tenants and employees to detect insider threat indicators and enforce strict adherence to the ASP.
* Manages traffic strategies and curbside security operations across the JAA enterprise, enforcing safety corridors during holiday surges to prevent vehicle-borne threats (VBIEDs) and maintain emergency lane accessibility.
* Provides operational security support for high-profile dignitary visits (VIP/POTUS) and major events to enforce access to areas and secure motorcade routes during elevated threat periods.
* Conducts parking logistics for large-scale events at general aviation properties, managing parking layouts in non-standard environments (e.g., unpaved surfaces) to ensure pedestrian safety and clear emergency egress routes.
* Regulates non-compliance by issuing formal security violations or civil parking citations, ensuring the evidentiary chain of custody for administrative enforcement actions.
* Execute administrative vehicle removal procedures by issuing Notice of Impound Reports (NOIR) for abandoned or prohibited vehicles, ensuring strict adherence to legal notification statutes prior to authorizing towing.
* Authors accurate and objective general liability reports for accidents and provides detailed supplemental statements to support law enforcement investigations.
* Applies effective conflict resolution techniques to manage non-compliant individuals or tense situations, working to achieve voluntary compliance with airport regulations while maintaining a safe and professional environment for the traveling public.
* Acts as a security ambassador for the traveling public and tenants, resolving inquiries and assisting passengers to ensure a positive culture that balances strict regulatory enforcement with professional empathy.
* Participates in special projects and assumes other responsibilities as directed to support the department’s security objectives.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Knowledge of federal aviation security regulations (49 CFR Part 1542/1540) and the Airport Security Program (ASP)
* Knowledge of compliance auditing principles, vulnerability assessment methodologies, and "Red Team" testing protocols.
* Knowledge of access control systems, alarm monitoring logic, and the analysis of system denial codes or causes.
* Knowledge of advanced emergency medical response, including critical injury stabilization, AED operation, and CPR.
* Skill in investigative analysis and root cause determination to reconstruct security incidents and identify failures.
* Skill in the operation and data interpretation of Explosive Trace Detection (ETD) technology.
* Skill in technical and legal writing to compose objectively defensible investigative reports for regulatory review.
* Skill in conflict de-escalation and behavioral assessment to manage non-compliant individuals.
* Skill in observational tradecraft and situational awareness in high-traffic environments.
* Ability to act quickly, decisively, and calmly during high-stress emergencies to execute life-safety protocols.
* Ability to adhere to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and post orders to ensure consistent operational compliance.
* Ability to work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support 24/7 airport operations.

**Required Education & Experience**

* High School diploma or its equivalent **and**
* Possess a passing score on the Law Enforcement Criminal Justice Basic Aptitude Test (CJBAT) taken within the past five (5) years (proof required) **or** has held an active law enforcement or corrections certificate (proof required) **and**
* Ability to successfully pass a comprehensive criminal background check, polygraph, and a psychological evaluation **and**
* No felony convictions or dishonorable discharge from any branch of the military.

**Preferred Education & Experience**

* Associate’s degree (or higher) in Criminal Justice, Aviation Management, Homeland Security, or a related field.
* Prior professional experience in security work within a corporate institution open to the public, military service, or other highly regulated environment (e.g., hospitals, universities, seaports, or government facilities).
* Experience in conducting preliminary investigations, interviewing witnesses, and writing detailed incident reports for management or legal review.

**Licenses & Certifications**

* Must possess and maintain a valid State Driver's License with an acceptable driving record
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Security Identification Display Area (SIDA) badge.

**Physical Demands**

* Regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel, or operate equipment and talk or hear clearly over radios.
* Frequently required to stand for extended periods, walk long distances during patrols, sit, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl to inspect restricted areas. Occasionally required to climb ladders or balance on uneven surfaces/terrain.
* Must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and must occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds (e.g., emergency equipment, disabled items, or luggage) and ability to wear load-bearing duty gear weighing approximately 15–20 pounds for continuous duty periods (8 to 12 hours).
* Required to work in varying environmental conditions, including exposure to aviation noise, exhaust fumes, extreme heat/cold, heights, glare, biohazards, and potential physical confrontations.

**Lead Operational Excellence at Toronto South Detention Centre**  
  
The Ministry of the Solicitor General is seeking an accomplished and forward-thinking leader to serve as **Deputy Superintendent of Operations at Toronto South Detention Centre (TSDC).** As a key member of the institution's executive leadership team, you will work closely with the Superintendent to provide strategic direction and operational oversight for one of Ontario's largest and most complex correctional institutions. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for advancing institutional priorities, fostering a culture of safety and accountability, and ensuring correctional operations are delivered effectively in support of public safety, staff wellbeing, and organizational excellence.
  
  
The **Deputy Superintendent of Operations** provides strategic and operational leadership for institutional security, emergency preparedness, incident management, workforce planning, labour relations, risk management, and operational performance. Leading a team of managers and front-line correctional professionals, you will ensure the safe, secure, and efficient operation of the institution while promoting employee engagement, continuous improvement, and respectful workplace practices. You will play a critical role in managing complex operational challenges, supporting organizational change, and ensuring compliance with legislative requirements, ministry policies, and professional standards, while helping to shape the future direction and success of TSDC.

**Leadership That Makes a Difference**
  
  
At its core, leadership in the Ontario Public Service (OPS) is about creating positive change for people and communities across Ontario. We're looking for leaders who are authentic, accountable, and courageous. People who bring others together, ask bold questions, and lead with purpose.

**About the job**
-----------------

We believe great leadership starts with high standards and strong support. In the OPS, that means showing up with authenticity, acting with integrity, and having the courage to do what's right, even when it's hard.
  
  
As a leader, you'll shape a team culture that sparks innovation, supports collaboration, and champions inclusion. You'll help build a workplace that is diverse, anti-racist, and accessible, where everyone feels safe, respected, and able to thrive.
  
  
You won't be doing it alone. We invest in our leaders through mentorship, learning opportunities, and cross-ministry networks that help you grow your impact and connect with peers across the organization.
  
  
Leadership is about impact, and in this role, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful one. You will:  
  
  

* **Provide Strategic Leadership** by leading multidisciplinary teams, setting operational direction, and fostering a positive, accountable, and high-performing workplace culture that supports institutional and ministry objectives.
* **Oversee Correctional Operations** by providing strategic leadership for the day-to-day operation of the institution, ensuring the safe custody, supervision, and care of inmates while maintaining effective and efficient service delivery.
* **Manage Operational Resources and Performance** by directing workforce planning, staff deployment, scheduling, and resource allocation to support institutional safety, operational readiness, and organizational objectives.
* **Drive Operational Excellence** by monitoring performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, and implementing strategies, policies, and initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, accountability, and service quality.
* **Build Collaborative Partnerships** by developing and maintaining productive relationships with institutional leaders, correctional staff, bargaining agents, community partners, and justice-sector stakeholders to support institutional priorities.
* **Lead Through Emergencies and Complex Operational Issues** by providing leadership during critical incidents, emergency situations, operational challenges, and organizational change initiatives while delivering effective solutions in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  
Your ability to align your team's efforts with broader organizational goals will be key to your success, and to the success of the people we serve.

Title: Senior Technical Marketing, and Application Engineer
Description:
Movandi has made a big impact on 5G in a short amount of time — from foundational research and innovative modular, high efficiency mmWave system design to the introduction of our BeamXR 5G system that delivers improvements in performance, coverage, and latency to connect 5G everywhere. Now more than ever, 5G--supported by Movandi technology--is becoming an integral part of the telecommunications landscape. And we're only getting started.
  
  
We are looking for exceptional leaders to join our team and our exciting journey. We are looking for highly creative, entrepreneurial sales managers to lead our service provider and carrier sales in the Saudi Arabia. and help shape the future of wireless services there.
  
  
In this role you will work with executives, technology specialists and procurement teams in carrier accounts to identify and create opportunities related to 5G infrastructure deployments and wireless services. You will create sales targets, identify channel and technology partners and manage day to day account level activities to drive sales and awareness around our breakthrough technology.

You will be leveraging your extensive technical background and strong communications skills to act as a translator between engineering and customers. Specific responsibilities include:
  
  

* Giving presentations on Movandi technology, case studies, and technology whitepapers
* Following up with customers questions
* Translating complex product features into compelling and understandable messages for technical buyers
* Understand market dynamics, competitors and bring back to Movandi greater understanding of the customer needs

* BS with + 15 years of experience, or MS + 13 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 10 years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field 8–12+ years of experience in wireless communications, with a strong mix of technical and customer-facing roles
* Proven experience in technical marketing, product marketing, systems engineering, or solution architecture
* Deep understanding of wireless communication systems, such as: 5G NR, satellite communication, Wi-Fi
* Experience working with chipsets, modules, radios, or network equipment
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear value propositions for customers, partners, and executives
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

* Do the right thing
* Be the patient’s advocate
* Be open and transparent

* Recognize the uniqueness of each patient
* Contribute to an outstanding patient’s experience

Title: Physiotherapist
Description:
Physiotherapists treat patients with physical difficulties resulting from illness, injury, disability or ageing. They treat people of all ages including children, the elderly, stroke patients and people with sports injuries . They work with patients to identify and improve their movement and function. They help promote their patients' health and wellbeing and assist the rehabilitation process by developing and restoring body systems, in particular the neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, cardiovascular and respiratory systems. They devise and review treatment programs, comprising manual therapy, movement, therapeutically exercise and the application of technological equipment, e.g. IDD therapy. Physiotherapists also provide advice on how to prevent injury.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corresponding Key Activities performed by the role**

  

**Managerial**

* Maintaining sufficient inventory of material supplies and equipment for performance of duties

  + Reporting shortage of materials to supervisor at earliest convenience, maintaining records for ordering and replenishments

  

**Technical**

* Undertake duties in accordance with the philosophy, business practices and policies of NMCRH-DIP, and practicing within the standards and ethics of the Physiotherapy profession typical work activities include :

  + Working with patients to identify physical problems.

    - Developing and reviewing treatment programs.
    - Assisting patients with joint and spinal problems, especially following surgery.
    - Helping patients' rehabilitation following accidents, injury and stroke.
    - Writing patient case notes and reports.
    - Collecting patient statistics.
    - Educating and advising patients and their cares about how to prevent and/or improve conditions.
  + Working as a professional member of a multi-disciplinary rehabilitation team and actively participating in team meetings.

  + Effectively communicating with staff members, health professionals, clients and family with regards to provision of physiotherapy services.
  + Contributing to, and participating in, education programs for residents, relatives and staff.
  + Participating in continuing education and courses updating Physiotherapy techniques and information.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy equipment is adequately maintained and liaising with the head of department for the ordering of supplies and equipment.
  + Ensuring Physiotherapy treatments are based on sound evidence of benefit.
  + Ensuring all adverse clinical events are recorded and reported.

Title: Claims Officer
Description:

Monitor and timely process claims related to Nakilat’s commercially managed fleet, collaborate and align with all related stakeholders internally to get the best possible outcomes via the charterparty terms and/or support in negotiations with the relevant counterparties.

**Key Accountabilities 1**
--------------------------

* Build a well-established knowledge of charter parties and their commercial implications in any regard that may result in exposure to claims.
* Monitor the performance of the vessels against the charter parties and highlight any areas that may result in any demurrage, performance warranty and off-hire claims, as necessary.

Further, follow up immediately with the vessels’ technical manager to address any underperformance observations or concerns.

--------------------------

* Review terms of Charter Party with Legal and Insurance functions and ensure that company’s interests are protected by ensuring necessary insurance coverage is in place, proper defense is arranged through vessels’ P&I Club and finally seek reimbursement of relevant expenses from charterers as per charter party clauses.
* Negotiate TCP claims, seek legal advice and provide recommendations to Head of Chartering.

* Use all possible means for voyage planning including the use of software tools to monitor and coordinate all activities related to voyage. Also, analyze variance between the voyage plans versus the actual plan, while generating report for the Head of Chartering.

* Implement approved policies, processes, and procedures, and provide instructions to subordinates to ensure their proper implementation.
