Title: Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting
Description:
### **Welcome to PxGeo**

PxGeo is an international offshore geophysical services company providing seismic data acquisition and related services to the energy industry. The Group operates across multiple jurisdictions with a head office in Dubai and manages projects in a complex and highly regulated environment.

PxGeo’s operations involve an extensive international supply chain, including vessel chartering, specialist equipment and technology, offshore services, logistics, and a broad range of suppliers and contractors. The Legal function supports commercial arrangements across multiple countries and legal frameworks, with a significant proportion of the Group’s contracts governed by English law.

### **What's the role?**

Official job title is Legal Counsel - Commercial Contracting and will be based in Dubai, UAE.

This position provides senior-level legal support to PxGeo’s commercial, operational and Supply Chain activities.

The role will take ownership of complex and strategically important commercial agreements, provide practical and commercially focused legal advice throughout the contracting lifecycle, and support the development of consistent contracting standards across the Group.

The successful candidate will work closely with Operations, Technical Solutions, Finance, Supply Chain, Sales and other business functions. The role requires the ability to lead contractual negotiations independently, identify and communicate material legal and commercial risks, and develop workable solutions that support PxGeo’s operational objectives while appropriately protecting the Group’s interests. Key responsibilities include:  
  
**Commercial Contracting**

* Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value and strategically significant commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in connection with contracts relating to:
* + offshore and seismic services; vessel chartering and marine services;
  + specialist equipment and technology; equipment supply, rental, hire and leasing;
  + agency, logistics, freight and transportation; consultancy and contractor services;
  + software, technology and licensing; framework and master services agreements;
  + purchase orders and associated contractual documentation; and
  + other operational and project-related arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers, suppliers, contractors and other commercial counterparties.
* Review and negotiate amendments to PxGeo’s Terms & Conditions.
* Review and negotiate counterparties’ standard terms where PxGeo’s contractual documentation cannot be used.
* Advise on contractual structures and appropriate risk allocation, including:
* + liability and indemnities; consequential and indirect loss;
  + warranties and performance obligations; insurance requirements;
  + intellectual property and data rights; payment and security arrangements;
  + delivery, acceptance and delay; liquidated damages;
  + suspension and termination; force majeure;
  + regulatory compliance; governing law and dispute resolution.
* Provide practical advice on contractual interpretation, contract performance and operational issues arising during project delivery.
* Support the management and resolution of commercial claims and disputes before escalation to formal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.

**Business and Project Support**

* Act as a senior Legal point of contact for commercial and operational matters.
* Work closely with business teams to understand the technical, operational and commercial context of proposed arrangements.
* Participate in project, tender and negotiation meetings where legal input is required.
* Support the identification and management of contractual risks during the tendering, negotiation, mobilisation and performance stages.
* Advise management on material contractual exposures and available mitigation measures.
* Support the development of negotiation strategies for complex or sensitive matters.
* Promote early engagement with Legal so that material risks are identified before commercial positions are agreed.

**Contracting Standards and Legal Processes**

* Support the development, maintenance and implementation of PxGeo’s standard contracts, templates, contractual guidance and fallback positions.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of commercial contracting processes.
* Support efficient workflows and escalation routes between Legal and other functions.
* Provide guidance and support to Legal Counsel/Paralegal and other members of the Legal team on commercial contracting matters.
* Deliver practical training to relevant business functions on contractual risk and contracting procedures.
* Support with other commercial, corporate or strategic matters as required.

### **Who are we looking for?**

* Qualified lawyer with substantial 9+ post-qualification experience, although the quality and relevance of experience will be more important than the precise number of years.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB) or Master’s Degree in Law (LLM). English law qualification is desirable but not essential, provided the candidate has strong practical experience with common law commercial contracts.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex commercial agreements governed by English law or based on English common law principles.
* Demonstrated ability to lead contractual negotiations independently and engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties.
* Detailed understanding of commercial risk allocation.
* Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and translate them into workable contractual arrangements.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from matters that can be managed operationally.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex and time-sensitive matters with limited supervision.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:
* + energy or oil and gas; offshore services; seismic or geophysical services; marine or shipping; vessel chartering; procurement and Supply Chain contracting; or international project-based operations.
* Previous in-house experience within an international, operational or project-based organisation would be a strong advantage.

Initial Incident Report and final investigation report as per KAHRAMAA guidelines.

by national regulations referenced by KAHRAMAA.

escalate unresolved hazards; exercise stop-work authority where necessary; track closure

and communicate changes to personnel

* Oversee electrical safety controls during installation, replacement, testing, commissioning,

working-at-height, energized work controls, lockout/tagout, and safe cabling/antenna

of assets with KAHRAMAA access for inspection.

corrective actions (as operationally required).

* Bachelor’s degree in Fire & Safety, Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering (or

related discipline);

* KAHRAMAA-approved First Aid and Basic Fire Fighting certificates required; ISO

45001/14001 Lead Auditor, Risk Management (QRA/JSA/HAZID) training preferred.

* Demonstrated experience in Construction/Industrial Safety within utility/infrastructure

projects; ability to coordinate and manage HSE issues, conduct audits/incident

investigations, and apply applicable national/international HSE laws.

* Hands-on experience supporting metering roll-outs (including LV/HV Electricity meters) and

AMI field operations with safe methods of work and compliance to KAHRAMAA procedure.

Title: AI Enablement Engineer
Description:
Requisition ID: 278493
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Scotiabank continues to be an industry leader for Payment’s technology and innovation. We have a history of safely leveraging new tools to enable new experiences for our customers, focusing on ensuring we protect their interests and goals. The result of this leads to modernization programs which aim to offer enriched information and transparencies to support the rapidly evolving payments community.

  

**The Role**

As an AI Enablement Engineer, you will serve as the crucial bridge between our enterprise Artificial Intelligence platforms and our workforce. You will drive the adoption, effective utilization, and value realization of generative AI and intelligent productivity tools across the organization.

This is a highly strategic and user-centric role. You will not be responsible for coding, model training, or backend engineering. Instead, your focus will be on human-centric AI adoption: ensuring our teams know how to use these technologies, understand their evolving capabilities, and integrate them seamlessly into their daily workflows to maximize business value.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

  

User Onboarding & Adoption

* Design and execute comprehensive onboarding programs to introduce employees to enterprise AI tools.
* Develop user guides, technical manuals, and structured documentation to support system usage and knowledge transfer.
* Develop role-specific use cases and quick-start guides to help new users overcome initial learning curves.
* Partner with department heads to identify specific workflows that can benefit from AI integration.
* Analyze and create business workflows to improve efficiency and align them with new technology adoption initiatives.
* Lead structured information gathering sessions with stakeholders to identify business needs and opportunities for AI-driven workflow improvements.

  

Capabilities Roadmap & Strategy

* Monitor the evolving landscape of enterprise AI platforms and stay informed on upcoming feature releases.
* Translate vendor roadmaps into internal, business-focused capability roadmaps.
* Assess how new features align with business objectives and communicate these updates to the wider organization.

  

User Training & Education

* Create and deliver engaging training sessions, workshops, and webinars tailored to various technical proficiency levels.
* Develop best-practice resources, such as advanced prompt engineering libraries and functional workflow templates.
* Establish and manage a community of "AI Champions" across different departments to foster peer-to-peer learning.
* Support end-to-end platform delivery by ensuring users are equipped to adopt new tools through structured enablement and guided usage practices.
* Support the delivery and rollout of new platforms, ensuring smooth transition from implementation to user adoption.

  

User Support & Feedback Loop

* Serve as the primary functional point of contact for user questions, best-practice inquiries, and workflow troubleshooting.
* Triage technical bugs or system outages to the core technical engineering/IT teams.
* Gather, synthesize, and advocate for user feedback to shape future AI rollouts and training initiatives.
* Continuously improve workflows and user experience based on feedback gathered during post-implementation support.
* Perform functional validation and testing to ensure solutions align with business requirements and deliver expected user outcomes.

  

Value Realization & Metrics

* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to AI adoption, active usage, and user sentiment.
* Conduct surveys and interviews to measure time saved, productivity gains, and overall ROI of AI initiatives.
* Identify, document, and share internal success stories to drive continued engagement and demonstrate tangible business value.

  

**What You'll Bring:**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, technology delivery, architecture, digital transformation, AI enablement or a related technology discipline.
* Experience leading complex technology initiatives across cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery and modern engineering practices.

* Experience moving technology initiatives from discovery or proof of concept into implementation and adoption.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across Engineering, Architecture, Business, Risk and other groups.

* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technological concepts into simple, business-friendly language.
* **Empathy:** A user-first mindset with a strong ability to understand and address the frustrations, fears, or hurdles employees face when adopting disruptive technologies.
* **Analytical:** Ability to track metrics, interpret data adoption, and build reports demonstrating business impact.

Title: Division Chief - Pediatric Endocrinology

Title: Digital Practice Specialist – BIM/VDC
Description:

Technical Delivery & Workflow Development

* Provide digital leadership for major programs requiring multidisciplinary coordination and advanced model-based delivery.

* Evaluate and recommend process improvements that increase efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance project delivery outcomes.
* Represent Infrastructure Digital Practice in project planning, client discussions, and industry-facing digital initiatives.

Technical & Digital Skills

* 5+ years of experience in infrastructure digital delivery, BIM, major projects, and digital project execution.
* Demonstrated experience with Revit and Autodesk digital delivery platforms
* Strong communication, facilitation, training, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and implement digital transformation initiatives across large, complex projects.

Preferred / Differentiating Skills

* Experience supporting buildings, engineering, or consulting delivery environments
* Demonstrated experience with Autodesk Navisworks Manage for clash detection and multidisciplinary model coordination; experience with Revizto or ACC Model Coordination is preferred.
* Ability to assess clash results, distinguish meaningful constructability issues from non-actionable conflicts, and communicate findings clearly to multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience tracking coordination issues, ownership, status, and follow-up through resolution.

Professional Attributes

* Ability to connect technical solutions to real-world delivery challenges
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Proactive, adaptable, and delivery-focused mindset

Education and Experience

Title: Professional Patrol - Supervisor
Description:
Overview:

The Summit at Snoqualmie is the Pacific Northwest's premier multi mountain ski resort, located 47 miles east of Seattle at Snoqualmie Pass. The property spans five base areas and 20 chairlifts across Summit West, Summit Central, Summit East, and Alpental within the Mt. Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest. A four-season operating model includes a mountain bike park and one of the most accessible ski destinations in North America.

The Summit at Snoqualmie is proud to be part of the Boyne Resorts family of resorts. Boyne Resorts is the largest family owned, independent mountain resort company in North America, guided by five core values: Serve First, Developing Great People, Attitude is Everything, Long Term Thinking, and Excellence in Execution.

Responsibilities:

**Long Term Thinking**

* Coordinate with the Patrol Managers and Patrol Director to ensure shared vision and goal alignment across the patrol team.
* Plan and/or coordinate training in conjunction with the Training Manager.
* Lead post-incident hot washes and support critical incident stress management (CISM) debriefs, ensuring psychological safety and confidentiality, identifying contributing factors and lessons learned, and communicating corrective actions to improve future response and risk management.
* Document incidents, near misses, and corrective actions in accordance with ski area policy, and apply organizational, local, and national safety standards to patrol operations.
* Plan for night operations, including lighting considerations, closure practices, night rescue resources and staff training, and when to activate Search and Rescue (SAR).

**Excellence in Execution**

* Assign duties, tasks, and projects as needed, and ensure their completion.
* Manage terrain openings and closings in conjunction with other patrol leadership.
* Attend assigned meetings.
* Work towards completing supervisor task book and personal professional development.
* Complete daily administrative paperwork, including the Daily Ops Sheet (key personnel for the day) and Daily Brief (key events and groups, weather and snow safety report, Forecaster on Duty check-in, carryover projects, training of the day, and safety notes).
* Lead beginning- and end-of-shift briefings covering current weather, snow, and avalanche conditions, the daily operational plan (openings, closures, and hazard zones), task assignments, and safety and emergency procedures, ensuring all patrollers sign in and acknowledge the briefing.
* Submit an end-of-shift overview to Teams for handoff and leadership awareness, and ensure in-shift training is properly documented and stored.
* Complete and verify patrol timekeeping in UKG in line with company policy on sick, overtime, and vacation time.
* Manage day-to-night shift change handoffs and tasking with patrol and other departments.
* Follow the Manager on Duty (MOD) process, recognizing when to raise issues up the chain and providing complete handoff information.
* Establish base area command during major incidents, following the Summit chain of command and notification structure and delegating tasks and resources appropriately.
* Know and carry out base area-specific operations, such as Nordic coordination; night terrain closures, terrain park opening committees, and tubing operations; snowmaking coordination and medical storage access; and upper mountain sweeps, night shift handoff, and avalanche hazard-based terrain openings and closings with the Snow Safety Team.

**Attitude is Everything**

* Ensure patrollers adhere to all corporate, Summit, and department policies and procedures, taking appropriate corrective action when needed.
* Be a leader in safety culture and maintain a focus on safety every shift.
* Promote a proactive, mindful, and constructive working environment.
* Conduct daily hazard assessments, implement patrol-level risk management protocols (weather, avalanche, lift operations, and guest safety), and exercise supervisory judgment to stop or modify operations when unsafe conditions or events exist.
* Uphold the Patrol Brand Standard Audit (BSA) every day, holding self and staff accountable, and model Boyne LEADS values and WOW service (Welcoming Spirit, Own Every Moment, Willing Attitude) with staff and guests.
* Apply de-escalation principles in guest interactions and enforce resort policies, including the Skier Responsibility Code, Park Safe, uphill travel, terrain closures, and the Employee Handbook, with proper documentation, disciplinary action, and pass revocation follow-up.

**Develop Great People**

* Coordinate with Volunteer Ski Patrol leadership.
* Maintain the knowledge, skills, and abilities to operate within — and train others on — patrol duties.
* Willing and able to complete routine employee coaching and check ins, beginning and end of season reviews, and create professional development pathways for patrollers.
* Maintain familiarity with all patroller task books (Apprentice, Senior, and Supervisor) and map individual progression pathways based on noted skills, desired skills, and natural aptitude, using internal opportunities and outside training such as avalanche, rope rescue, risk management, and OEC to EMT courses.
* Issue Notices of Expectations when repeat behavior continues or point-in-time coaching is unsuccessful, reviewing with managers, processing in conjunction with HR, and scheduling and documenting follow-up.

**Serve First**

* Communicate and work in conjunction with other departments to ensure efficient and safe operations for your team.
* Know the patrol leadership team, base area supervisors, department heads, and VPs, and choose the appropriate communication avenue (email, phone, or in person) for each situation.
* Maintain working knowledge of patrol programs and their points of contact, including Medical, Snow Safety, Risk, Training, Patroller Wellness, Transportation (UTVs), Supplies, and Toboggans.
* Support patroller wellbeing by knowing employee resources (mental health, financial hardship, and benefits) and the Patroller Care binder, and by managing on-the-job injury (OTJI) reporting and the workers' compensation process.
* Process guest pass and rental refunds and paperwork requests

Qualifications:

**Required**

* Positive season reviews from your previous two operating seasons.
* Advanced skier or snowboarder.
* Physically capable of hiking in rough mountain terrain and adverse weather while carrying skis and a 20–30 pound pack daily (occasionally 60+ pounds).
* Demonstrated ability to be observant and think critically about your environment.
* Proven ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Basic computer skills, including familiarity with Microsoft Office/Suite.
* Ability to pass a background check.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* Have completed at least four full winter seasons as a paid Experienced level ski patroller and/or be deemed qualified by the Patrol Director
* Medical skills: National or Washington EMT Basic, or Outdoor Emergency Care NSP Certification, and Annual BLS Provider CPR Certification

Title: Chief Operating Officer
Description:

With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. We are seeking a seasoned and results-driven
**Chief Operating Officer (COO)**
to provide strategic and executive leadership across our data center operations, with enterprise-wide accountability for operational excellence, mission-critical infrastructure availability, reliability, resilience, scalability, customer commitments, and service delivery.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the COO will play a pivotal role in translating Syntys’ ambitious growth strategy into scalable operational capabilities, building a high-performing organization, and ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of our data center platform.

The COO will be instrumental in enabling business growth and delivering world-class operational standards to meet the demanding requirements of hyperscale cloud providers, AI infrastructure customers, GPU-intensive computing environments, and wholesale colocation clients.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Enterprise Operations & Strategic Leadership:**
  Develop and execute the enterprise-wide operations strategy, establishing scalable, standardized, and performance-driven operating models across all markets and facilities.
* **Mission-Critical Infrastructure & Engineering Operations:**
  Oversee mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, power, fire protection, and facilities infrastructure, ensuring availability, reliability, uptime, and maintenance excellence. Ensure commissioning acceptance, integrated systems testing, and seamless transition from construction and project delivery into live operations.
* **Hyperscale & AI Infrastructure:**
  Drive operational readiness for hyperscale cloud, AI training, AI inference, and high-performance computing environments, including high-density power requirements, GPU infrastructure, advanced liquid cooling technologies, large-scale customer deployments, and phased capacity activation.
* **Executive Oversight of Operational Functions:**
  Provide executive oversight across headquarters and market operations, Critical Facilities Operations (Mechanical & Electrical), Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management (FM), Physical Security, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, and Operational Sustainability.
* **Operational Governance, Risk & Compliance:**
  Establish operational governance frameworks, policies, procedures, and controls across all facilities. Oversee incident management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, business continuity, disaster recovery, emergency response, crisis management, operational audits, risk assessments, regulatory compliance, Operational Technology (OT) Security, cybersecurity resilience, and third-party operator and contractor performance. Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards and data center frameworks, including Uptime Institute Tier standards and relevant ISO standards.
* **Customer Experience & Strategic Account Management:**
  Ensure delivery against contractual obligations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and customer-specific requirements. Act as the senior executive escalation point for major operational incidents and customer concerns. Lead operational business reviews and support commercial growth through operational assurance and executive-level customer engagement.
* **Financial Performance, Asset Management & Sustainability:**
  Own operational expenditure (OPEX) performance and contribute to capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning and investment prioritization. Drive cost optimization, asset lifecycle management, operational productivity, procurement effectiveness, vendor performance, budgeting, and financial forecasting. Lead energy efficiency, carbon reduction, resource optimization, and sustainability initiatives, including Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE).
* **Leadership, Organization & Talent Development:**
  Build and lead high-performing operations teams, establish clear organizational structures and leadership accountability, and drive succession planning, talent development, retention, and performance management. Foster a culture of ownership, operational discipline, safety, customer focus, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline. A Master's degree or relevant professional certifications are advantageous.
* **Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience**
  , including significant senior leadership experience in data center operations, mission-critical infrastructure, or critical facilities environments.
* Proven track record of leading
  **large-scale, multi-site or geographically distributed data center operations**
  , preferably at COO, SVP Operations, or equivalent senior leadership level.
* Solid experience managing
  **hyperscaler, cloud service provider, and strategic customer relationships**
  , with a strong understanding of contractual commitments, SLAs, and service delivery expectations.
* Strong technical expertise in
  **mission-critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure**
  , including power systems, cooling technologies, maintenance strategies, operational reliability, and resilience.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing key operational functions, including
  **Data Center Operations, Network Operations Center (NOC), Facilities Management, Physical Security, IT, and Cybersecurity**
  , with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage operational interdependencies.
* Proven ability to manage
  **operational risks, critical incidents, business continuity, and crisis situations**
  , demonstrating sound judgment, accountability, and effective decision-making under pressure.
* Strong
  **commercial and financial acumen**
  , including operational budgeting, cost optimization, asset management, and vendor performance management.
* Demonstrated ability to
  **build and develop high-performing teams, strengthen operational governance, and scale operations**
  in a growing, multi-market business environment.
* Exposure to
  **AI infrastructure, high-density computing, GPU environments, and advanced cooling technologies**
  is highly desirable.

**Job Description:**

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

  

Global Technology & Solutions (GTS) enables the Bank’s strategy by delivering enterprise technology that supports clients and colleagues, protecting TD through strong fraud, cyber, technology, and physical security controls, enabling agility in response to evolving client needs and market dynamics, and supporting the delivery and execution of work across the organization. GTS is central to how TD modernizes, innovates, manages risk, and delivers secure, reliable, and differentiated experiences.

  

**Team Overview**
-----------------

  

The GTS Strategy and Insights team helps shape where GTS goes next—and how we tell that story. We support GTS’ most senior technology leader and leadership team by developing fact-based analysis, executive-ready narratives, presentations, memos, and insights that help drive alignment and support decision-making for audiences including the Chief Executive Officer, the Senior Executive Leadership team, and the Board of Directors.

  

The AVP - GTS Strategy and Insights will lead a team responsible for executive deliverables, strategic planning, enterprise and industry research, executive communications, and performance reporting against GTS priorities. The team sits same organization as Change Management, Communications, and Colleague Engagement, creating strong alignment between strategy, messaging, adoption, and colleague experience to ensure priorities are translated into clear narratives, practical change plans, and measurable business outcomes.

  

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Reporting to the Head, Strategy and Insights, Product Owner & Analyst Practices the successful candidate will lead the GTS Strategy function and will be accountable for influencing and shaping Senior Executive and Board-level content while overseeing the team’s day-to-day operations and delivery of high-quality analysis, insights, and strategic materials.

This role is ideal for someone who can operate at the intersection of strategy, technology, and communication—understanding complex technology and business issues, identifying what matters, and translating that thinking into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives.

  

**Key accountabilities include:**

  

* Lead all strategy-related deliverables required through enterprise processes or as directed by ESVP Global Technology and Solutions, ensuring each is grounded in evidence, aligned to GTS priorities, and positioned to support executive decisions.
* Lead the development, planning and communication of strategic narratives, insights, and recommendations that influence Executive and Board discussions, build alignment, and advance GTS' strategic priorities (e.g., Executive level presentations, memos, briefings and other materials for GTS Senior Leadership, Board, and/or Governance forums).
* Set the standard for clear, fact-based, outcome-oriented materials that simplify complex technology, workforce, financial, cyber, data, artificial intelligence, delivery, and regulatory topics for senior executive audiences.
* Responsible for leading the development and refresh of GTS’ short, medium, and long-term strategy, and priorities, translating strategic direction into actionable focus areas, investment ideas, and measurable outcomes.
* Develop insights on strategic issues facing GTS, including technology modernization, software delivery, artificial intelligence adoption, workforce transformation, productivity, cyber resilience, data and cloud, cost management, and regulatory priorities.
* Serve as GTS’ technology research lead by continuously drawing on external sources, including articles, books, podcasts, research, industry forums, and expert perspectives—to proactively identify leading-edge insights from across the technology and financial services landscape, raise critical awareness, and translate relevant insights into strategic deliverables, team priorities, and investment choices.
* Own performance reporting and executive insights for GTS priorities, ensuring timely, accurate, and data-driven assessment of strategic, transformation, financial, workforce, and operational outcomes to support informed decision-making and accountability.
* Drive alignment on GTS strategic priorities by influencing senior stakeholders, resolving cross-functional dependencies, surfacing risks and opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations that support executive decisions and drive measurable business outcomes.
* Lead the Strategy & Insights function, establishing priorities, allocating resources, managing strategic risks and dependencies, and ensuring successful delivery of key commitments.
Lead, coach, and develop a high performing of team of strategy and insight specialists while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture.  

  

**Job Requirements**

**Required:**

  

* Demonstrated ability to influence Senior Executives and support complex strategic decisions.
* Experience translating industry trends and external research into strategic recommendations and business outcomes for SVP+ level audiences.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including development of executive and Board-level materials.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of technology's role in driving enterprise outcomes.
* Proven ability to synthesize complex technical, financial, and strategic information into clear, compelling messages for senior executive and Board level audiences.
* Strong understanding of technology transformation, software delivery, artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working, data, cyber, cloud, infrastructure, digital tools, and the role of technology in enabling business strategy.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, workback plans, and senior stakeholder expectations in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.
* Exceptional relationship-building, collaboration, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to align diverse stakeholders, build trusted partnerships, and drive outcomes across functions and leadership levels. Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect technology priorities to enterprise strategy, customer outcomes, colleague outcomes, risk, and financial performance.
Experience leading teams and building high-performing, inclusive cultures.  

  

**Preferred:**

  

* Experience in software engineering, technology delivery, technology strategy, architecture, product, data, cyber, or a related discipline.
* Consulting experience, particularly in strategic messaging, executive communications, technology strategy, or enterprise transformation.
* Experience supporting the Chief Executive Officer, senior executive leadership team, Board of Directors, or equivalent senior governance forums.
* Demonstrated strategic curiosity and insight, leveraging external trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging technologies to challenge thinking, shape priorities and inform GTS strategy and decision-making.
Proven experience translating market, competitive, and technology insights into strategic recommendations that inform investment decisions, transformation priorities, and operating model evolution.  

  

**Additional Information**

This role offers the opportunity to work directly on the strategic agenda for a large, complex technology organization; influence executive and Board-level materials; lead a small, high-performing team; and help GTS make clearer choices about where to focus time, talent, and resources.

**Description**
**Joignez-vous à notre équipe et ce que nous accomplirons ensemble**
À titre de chargé de projet principal ou de chargée de projet principale dans l’équipe de gestion de projet de l’exploitation payeur-fournisseur de TELUS Santé, vous serez responsable de la mise en œuvre complexe de systèmes de santé aux enjeux importants qui ont une incidence directe sur les clients de partout au Canada. Vous gérerez des projets à grande échelle dans la sphère de nos solutions de dossier médical électronique (DME), les initiatives de gestion des régimes d’assurance maladie et/ou les déploiements de systèmes de pharmacie, en travaillant de manière indépendante pour piloter des projets à partir de l’analyse de rentabilité et d’une charte de projet jusqu’à la planification du projet, avec la flexibilité de développer votre propre encadrement. Votre leadership sera essentiel à la bonne exécution du projet, et vous travaillerez avec une équipe collaborative, axée sur les valeurs et engagée envers l’amélioration continue et l’excellence.
  
  
**Ce que vous ferez**

* Diriger des projets complexes dans notre portefeuille d’exploitation de payeurs-fournisseurs, qu’il s’agisse de solutions de DME, de gestion des régimes d’assurance maladie ou de mise en œuvre de systèmes de Solutions en pharmacie. Travailler de façon autonome, tout en supervisant une équipe chargée d’élaborer des chartes de projet, en créant des analyses de rentabilité, en gérant des calendriers, des budgets, et des risques avec un minimum de supervision et en faisant appel à des recours hiérarchiques de façon stratégique, au besoin
* Faire des présentations à la haute direction avec clarté et assurance, qui traduisent de l’information complexe de par leur nature technique ou leur spécificité au projet en renseignements exploitables permettant de prendre des décisions, que ce soit pour le client ou les parties prenantes à l’interne
* Gérer des équipes de projet diversifiées et matricielles (analystes d’affaires, analystes de données, équipes cliniques, communications, fournisseurs) par la formation et le mentorat, en veillant à l’harmonisation entre les équipes internes de TELUS et les organisations clientes externes
* Promouvoir des méthodologies, des outils et des plateformes collaboratives de gestion de projet normalisés tout en favorisant l’excellence des livrables et le mentorat de membres fonctionnels de l’équipe
* Gérer et analyser des rapports complexes et veiller à ce que les mises en œuvre procurent des avantages tangibles à TELUS Santé et aux clients
* Rédiger des communications de projet très efficaces (infographies, notes de service, rapports à l’intention des cadres) adaptées à divers publics, allant des communications destinées aux clients aux mises à jour pour la haute direction ou le comité directeur

**Qualifications**
**Vous possédez**

* Bilinguisme (français et anglais)
* Un baccalauréat en administration, en informatique, en soins de santé ou dans une discipline connexe
* Certification de professionnel ou professionnelle en gestion de projet (PMP)
* Au moins 5 ans d’expérience progressive en gestion de projets avec une expertise démontrée dans l’application de principes, d’outils et de méthodologies de gestion de projet
* Au moins 5 ans d’expérience à diriger la mise en œuvre à grande échelle de systèmes de soins de santé complexes (solutions de DME, systèmes cliniques, plateformes de régime d’assurance maladie) tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, y compris la planification de la durabilité
* Aptitude avérée à travailler de manière autonome, avec un minimum de supervision, tout en gérant de nombreuses priorités concurrentes sous pression et en respectant des échéances fixes
* Maîtrise avancée de la mise en œuvre de systèmes de soins de santé avec une compréhension démontrée des systèmes de santé, de la complexité de l’exploitation et des répercussions sur les soins aux patients
* Solides compétences en leadership, y compris la prise de décisions, la capacité d’influencer sans autorité officielle et la gestion des attentes des parties prenantes dans des environnements matriciels
* Expertise démontrée dans la gestion de l’ambiguïté et la mise en œuvre de méthodes de gestion du changement et de pensée axée sur les systèmes
* Capacité à communiquer clairement des informations complexes à un éventail de publics (du personnel clinique à la haute direction)

**Atouts**

* Diplôme d’études supérieures en administration des affaires, en gestion des soins de santé ou dans un domaine connexe
* Formation avancée ou certification en gestion du changement et en science de la mise en œuvre

Une connaissance avancée de l'anglais est requise, car vous serez appelé(e) la plupart du temps à interagir en anglais avec des parties externes (par ex. clients, fournisseurs ou partenaires externes); à interagir en anglais avec des parties internes (par ex. collègues ou parties prenantes); et à travailler dans un environnement informatique anglais dans le cadre des tâches liées à ce poste dont la portée est nationale.

The Toronto Transit Commission (TTC), North America's third largest transit system and recognized as one of the top places to work in the GTA has introduced its new 2024-2028 TTC Corporate Plan - Moving Toronto, Connecting Communities which continues the TTC’s legacy of delivering service to hundreds of millions of customers a year. The TTC’s new vision and mission statements also help promote the many environmental, social equity and economic benefits that the TTC provides:

  

**Vision:** Moving Toronto towards a more equitable, sustainable, and prosperous future.

  

**Mission:** To serve the needs of transit riders by providing a safe, reliable, efficient, and accessible mass public transit service through a seamless integrated network to create access to opportunity for everyone.

  

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------

Join our Maintenance Engineering team and play a critical role in keeping operations running efficiently. Lead supply chain, procurement, and materials management initiatives that support essential maintenance projects, ensuring resources are delivered on time, on budget, and ready to meet evolving business needs.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Reporting to the Manager of Structure Maintenance the Materials and Contract Coordinator will be responsible for the daily operation of all material and procurement related activities for the Structure Maintenance section. This will include overseeing the entire supply chain management process including the management of materials, equipment, budgets, and appropriate staffing to meet project deadlines. The incumbent will also be responsible for identifying and analyzing new structure maintenance initiatives to determine the materials, service and labour requirements needed, and ensure projects are completed in a timely and cost-effective manner.

  

This includes:

  

* Manage service/material supply contracts and purchase orders
* Assist senior staff/ Inspection Engineers with the preparation of specifications for the procurement of materials and service contracts
* Review contract documents and suggesting changes to ensure conformance to M&P regulations
* Ensure consistency and uniformity in specification writing, and adhere to Material & Procurement (M&P) rules and policies to prevent unsuccessful contract tenders
* Ensure new contracts, as well as existing contract renewals are initiated on time and in accordance with departmental rules and policies
* Implement and maintain an administrative system for the management of contracts, purchase orders, invoices, and technical specifications
* Keep up to date on policy/procedure changes that may impact the timely award of contracts
* Identify needs, technology, space requirements, equipment requirements and services; and provide cost estimate and implementation plans
* Coordinate the timely delivery of materials and services in accordance with section projects
* Forecast future material needs, plan inventory levels and establish safety stock to ensure that adequate stock levels are maintained
* Identify and analyze slow moving and obsolete material, and take appropriate action
* Prepare budgetary requirements by determining quantities, labour hours and costs
* Investigate and report on cost variances, and provide recommendations

  

As a TTC employee you are responsible for treating passengers and/or employees with respect and dignity and ensuring the needs of passengers or employees with disabilities are accommodated and/or addressed (if applicable and within their area of responsibility) in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and Related Orders so that they can fully benefit from the TTC as a service provider and an employer. You will also be participating in the TTC Customer Service Ambassador Program.

**What Skills Do You Bring?**
-----------------------------

* Plan and organize activities / projects to meet section and organizational goals
* Apply analytical skills
* Communicate in a variety of mediums
* Audit systems, processes, and products
* Use office technology, software and applications
* Secure and manage fiscal resources

**What Qualifications Do You Bring**
------------------------------------

* Your education will consist of a University or College Degree in Business Administration or the equivalent combined with several years of directly related work experience
* Your application will reveal sound knowledge of materials procurement management and materials handling principles
* Knowledge of methods and practices relating to the ordering, receiving, issuing, storing and management of equipment and materials
* Your experience will consist of advanced budgeting principles with proficiency in applying the same to the operations of materials management
* Familiarity with engineering design disciplines, and construction related practices, codes, standards, regulations and project management concepts
* Familiarity with union and trade agreements contracts is considered an asset
* Sound judgement; strong organizational, interpersonal, problem-solving skills, oral and written communication skills, combined with the ability to manage change effectively
* Proficient in the use of computer software and applications (e.g. Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.)
* Must have of rapidly acquire a comprehensive knowledge of the Ontario Human rights Code and Related Orders including disability accommodation and accessibility requirements pertaining to passengers and employee.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Commitment to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that promotes a sense of belonging and represents and reflects the needs of the communities we serve.
* One of the great benefits of being a full-time TTC employee is becoming a member of the TTC defined pension plan.
* A comprehensive package that covers health, dental, vision and more.

The TTC is committed to upholding the values of equity, diversity, anti-racism and inclusion in the delivery of its services and in its workplaces. The TTC is committed to fostering a diverse workforce that is representative of the communities it serves at all levels of the organization and supports an inclusive environment where diverse employee and community perspectives and experiences bring value to the organization. The TTC encourages applications from all applicants, including members of groups with historical and/or current barriers to equity, including but not limited to, Indigenous, Black and racialized groups, people with disabilities, women and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. The TTC values and supports an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process. Accommodations for applicants are available upon request throughout the recruitment and selection process, including for those who identify as having a disability. Please contact Talent Management at (416) 393-4570 or Jobs@ttc.ca . Any information received related to an accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

  

**General Prohibition in Hiring Process**

  

The TTC is also committed to a fair hiring process based on job related qualifications, merit, and abilities. * Experience owning or sharing responsibility for P&L performance, budgets, and operational results.
* Demonstrated ability to execute strategic initiatives and improve business performance.

**Additional advantages:**

* EOS experience (L10s, Rocks, Scorecards, IDS)

* Cross-functional issues are resolved quickly and effectively.

Title: Transport Coordinator
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Transport Services team, where you will play a key role in managing and optimizing our fleet and transportation operations. The team is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and on-time performance through quality control, route management, transport assessments, and continuous improvements our transportation standards.

If you are passionate about logistics, operational efficiency, and upholding the highest health and safety standards, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As part of the world’s largest international airline, our transport services team is essential in keeping our operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

As a **Transport Coordinator** , you will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) throughout the entire vehicle lifecycle, from inception to disposal, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with all system requirements. Generate reports and maintain comprehensive records of vehicle-related costs, monitor expenditures, reconcile pending issues, and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies. Coordinate application upgrades and system enhancements in line with operational requirements to improve efficiency. Liaise with vehicle users to identify and assess repair requirements based on reported non-technical information, conduct preliminary assessments, and assist senior management in establishing higher repair standards by recommending effective and economical solutions. Ensure efficient coordination of vehicle maintenance and repairs while maintaining cost control and optimal fleet performance.

**In this role, you will:**

* Maintain accurate and comprehensive vehicle records in CSTMS (Central Service Transport Management System) from inception to disposal. Records include vehicle specifications, user details, registration, insurance, and fuel card information. Exercise utmost care when entering technical data, as certain information cannot be amended once entered.
* Arrange repair appointments, prepare Repair Request Forms (RRFs) using appropriate technical terminology, coordinate drivers for vehicle delivery, and arrange collection upon completion of repairs. Ensure effective scheduling to minimise delays and allow sufficient time for repairs.
* Assist in inspecting vehicles and identifying technical faults within the Central Services fleet. Interpret reported problems from users who may lack technical knowledge and translate them into accurate automotive terminology to facilitate effective repairs while saving time and costs.
* Liaise with workshops to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective repairs. Obtain repair estimates and approvals from user departments, communicate approvals to workshops, follow up on repair progress, and ensure all relevant transactions are updated in CSTMS.
* Ensure timely collection and accurate uploading of workshop and agency invoices into CSTMS. Coordinate with IT and workshops to resolve data errors during invoice downloads, ensuring complete reconciliation with corresponding RRFs. Manually process invoices received from agencies and other garages on an invoice-by-invoice basis.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding vehicle registration renewals, Traffic Department repair recommendations, accident-related repairs, and settlement of fines. Liaise with insurance companies, tyre suppliers, and EPPCO for insurance-related matters, tyre requirements, and fuel card issuance or cancellation.
* Assist senior management in preparing exception reports, analysing data, preparing case notes, and communicating findings. Monitor registration renewals, fuel card issuance, quotations, invoice verification, and CSTMS records to prevent overcharging and ensure cost-effective repairs and quality workmanship.
* Maintain comprehensive records of vehicle servicing, registration, insurance documents, invoices, accident reports, and other vehicle-related correspondence. Ensure timely communication of company vehicle user details to HR, Management Accounts, and Payroll.
* Provide technical guidance to user departments and workshops, as required, to ensure repairs meet the required standards. Advise vehicle users on appropriate vehicle care following major repairs, including engine and air-conditioning system overhauls.
* Prepare vehicle handover and takeover checklists, conduct random inspections of the Central Services fleet, and prepare snag lists. In the absence of available resources, arrange or personally undertake vehicle delivery and collection to and from workshops or senior managers' residences, as required.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Have completed 12 years of schooling or equivalent.
Have at least 5 years of experience working in Supply Chain, Logistics or Transport.  

  

**You will have an edge if you have:**

* Have experience working with Resource Management Systems (RMS), Real-Time Control (RTC), Multi-Access Check-in System.
* Have experience working with Microsoft Office Applications.

Title: Solutions Architect
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration

processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our

integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating

seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.

  

As a Solutions Architect, you will architect, design, and communicate a system's high-level structural and behavioural aspects, to enable and guide

the design and development of integrated solutions that meet current and future business needs, in alignment with corporate IT standards and

architecture guiding principles. This necessitates engagement throughout the lifecycle of projects by taking full responsibility for the solution

architecture.

**In this role, you will:**

* Develop optimal, fit-for-purpose, and aligned IT architecture solutions that meet customer requirements. Ensure architecture is robust, appropriate, and high-quality, conforming to corporate IT standards and roadmaps. Take accountability for the end-to-end architecture, including architecture and technology decisions.
* Develop Enterprise Architecture standards and guidelines in the information, application, and technology domains. Work closely with Manager Enterprise Architecture and other peer architects in the development of technology advancements and adaptation of new technologies and patterns.
* Continuously monitor industry trends, identify and evaluate relevant technologies and tools, and showcase business value by executing Proof of Concepts by engaging relevant IT teams.
* Establish policy, guidelines, and strategy for selecting system components and their designs. Assess solution designs to ensure they effectively use architectural patterns and adhere to the guidelines. Promote the reuse of solutions, platforms, and services. Contribute to the enterprise architecture repository.
* Guide, mentor, and motivate the development team members in adopting good engineering practices, tools, and techniques throughout the development process. In addition, advise and support team members in overcoming technical challenges by providing expert consultancy and coaching.
* Conduct architecture reviews of vendor products as part of the selection process and other critical production applications with Software Engineering development teams. Provide architecture recommendations for the short and long-term improvement of applications.
* Develop logical infrastructure solutions in alignment with the technology standards. Work closely with infrastructure teams to ensure that the physical infrastructure designed meets project requirements. Work together, oversee, and govern the development to ensure the development team's design and implementation align with the proposed architecture definition. Work closely with the quality engineering team to ensure that the final solution meets the agreed non-functional requirements.
* Collaborate closely with Manager Enterprise Architects to ensure alignment of information, application, and technology architecture to the overall architecture principles, framework, and guidelines.
* Own, manage, and maintain the architecture roadmap and runways of small to medium-sized initiatives, products, environments, and/or platforms. Act as a product owner and be accountable for proactively identifying, prioritizing, and overseeing the development of technical enablers, technical debts, quality improvements, and application modernization activities.
* Drive architecture decisions and be accountable for their implications regarding solution costs, delivery schedules, application complexity, technical debt, and overall solution performance.

Qualifications & Experience:

* Hands-on experience in detailed business system architecture and design technical leadership across groups of technical architects and senior developers. Ability to influence delivery plans based on architecture and skills constraints.
* Understanding of Architecture Methods, Principles and Patters (OOAD, GoF, SOA etc.).
* Understanding Architecture and design artefacts (Archimate, C4, UML models, etc.
* Understanding of agile software development methodologies such as SCRUM and Scaled Agile
* Understanding of Open Source Frameworks ( Apache, Spring, etc.)
* Understanding cross-cutting architecture capabilities (Rules, Workflow, Security, etc.)
* Understanding the big picture view, non-functional requirements, and other practices such as observability, automation, etc.
* Understanding of architecture styles such as microservices, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native applications.
* Understanding of well-architected framework for cloud deployments.
* Preferably good understanding and experience in the airline domain.

Leadership Role: No

Title: Technical Services Engineer I
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Fleet Technical Management at Emirates comprises five specialized teams dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of service and reliability for our fleet.

**Airframe Systems:** Handles mechanical systems including flight controls, landing gear, and air conditioning.

**Structures** : Supports aircraft structures, including repairs and modifications for metallic and composite parts.

**Avionics** : Manages avionics systems, including navigation, communications, and advanced IFE systems.

**Powerplant** : Oversees engines and APUs, focusing on health monitoring and optimization.

**Cabin** : Maintains passenger cabins, flight decks, and retrofits, ensuring top-notch comfort and functionality.

Each team ensures our fleet operates efficiently and safely, meeting all technical and service standards.

As a Technical Services Engineer I (Structures/Operational Support) you will provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Emirates fleet to ensure compliance to regulatory & safety requirements, reliability, passenger comfort and cost effectiveness.

**In this role you will:**

* Provide fleet technical management, continuing airworthiness management and technical support functions for Structures.
* Routinely evaluate manufacturers/regulatory authorities’ technical documents, taking appropriate actions and update internal engineering documents including Engineering Order and Special Engineering Workcard.
* Review in-service data (e.g Tech log, Pilot Reports, Defects) and implement actions to improve fleet, engine, component and/or system reliability and maintainability, including optimisation of aircraft maintenance programs.
* Deliver technical assistance and operational support in disruptions scenarios including the handling of technical/AOG, troubleshooting, aircraft chronic and deferred defects and technical delays.
* Carry out Emirates Engineering design organisational activities such as but not limited to development of standard operating procedures, in house repairs, use of alternate parts, deviations from manufacturing documents by exercising Design Engineer (DE) privileges of Part 21 Design Organisation as appointed by Head of Design (HOD).
* Provide support and expertise for acquisition of new Aircraft and end of lease activities
* Act as a technical liaison with Aircraft, Engines and/or Component Manufacturers and internal stakeholders (e.g flight operations, service delivery) to address fleet significant faults, defects, design issues and quality escapements.
* Provide technical clarifications/justification to internal stakeholders in support of cost optimisation, contract negotiation, repair and modification processes.
* Carry out project management functions such as but not limited to major modifications, retrofits, cabin reconfigurations and aircraft phaseout requirements including preparation of cost benefit studies or budget requirements on changes/repairs with recommendations/proposals for approval by management.
* Review and analyse technical data in support of department KPIs, highlighting trends and making recommendation reports/proposal for improvement.

* Degree or Honours (12+3 or equivalent),
* More than 10 years of experience in Engineering, Aeronautical
* Degree in Aeronautical/Avionics/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering and/or holder of Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Licence for 5 years.
* Related Aircraft Engineering experience.
* Should have a minimum of 8 years in Technical Services function of which at least 5 year of experience pertaining to Emirates fleet type/aircraft systems.
* Knowledge of latest technical developments and industry trends on respective systems.
* Ability to analyse and synthesise technical information for implementation in cost effective ways.

* Demonstrable experience in managing complex tasks and decision making in a fast paced environment.

Title: Cargo Charter Support Officer
Description:
##### **Job Purpose**

A World leader in air cargo. We possess a geographical advantage that enables us to reach over 140 destinations across 6 continents. We are able to cater to two-thirds of the world’s population in just 8 hours and serve major international trade regions quickly and efficiently. Our SkyCargo group works in partnership to facilitate global trade and connect customers with their destinations. We have a young, efficient, wide-bodied fleet, with ample capacity to transport cargo through our

state-of-the-a

rt, multi-airport hub in Dubai and adapt to our customers ever-changing needs.

  

As Cargo Charter Support Officer, you provide dedicated and specialised support to the three areas in EK Cargo Freighters **and Charter Operations** .

Undertake planning, coordination and implementation of all matters relating to Freighter operation in SkyCargo. This includes all aspects of charter operations, ensuring both operational and commercial integrity is maintained while meeting all safety, quality and customer service standards.

Ensure that all activities take place in an effective and efficient manner so as to ensure all **freighter and charter services** are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, schedule adjustments, additional operations and new route introductions.

Undertake the management of other aspects of Freighter Department including **charter-related system requirements** .

In this role, you will:

* SCHEDULE PLANNING:
    
  Prepare seasonal freighter schedules in a timely manner ensuring all commercial and operational requirements are met. Ensure all permissions and permits are obtained from government and other agencies for the smooth operation of scheduled freighter services **and charter operations** for incorporation and publication in the quarterly airline timetable so that the freighter network information is available to customers. Provide support to the Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager in slot co-ordination activity especially from an operational perspective when additional charter flights are operated or obtaining specific slots during schedule disruptions so as to be able maintain the required performance level on slot utilisation such that slot historic are protected.
    
  Monitor the schedules of all the freighters and charter flights ensuring its effectiveness and efficiency so that all services are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, adjustments to schedules and additional operations.

* OPERATIONS PLANNING:
* Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with the wet lease aircraft operators (Atlas Air, TNT and others) ensuring that the operator is provided monthly schedules in a timely manner and that the operator is able to fulfil Emirates schedules, **including supporting charter flight requirements where applicable** .

  Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with other Emirates operational departments ensuring that they are provided in a timely manner and that Emirates is capable of fulfilling them. This also requires checking back with the operator to ensure that the operator's planning information reflect Emirates requirements **for both freighter and charter operations** .

  When special charter flights are operated, the job holder is required to travel to outstations, especially off-line stations and/or stations that do not have freighter expertise, to ensure all operational activity in relation to the charter is performed according to company standards and customer's satisfaction.

  **Support the operational planning and coordination of ad-hoc charter flights, ensuring all stakeholder requirements are met before, during and after operation.**
* DEVELOPMENT & ANALYSIS:
* Manage all other carrier (OAL) block space agreements ensuring that agreements are current and where renewal is due initiate renewal negotiations.

  Assist in the negotiate with carriers with block space agreements for the optimal cancellations in accordance with agreed cancellation allowances, so as to ensure Emirates commercial objectives are not compromised.

  Undertake planning, operations within the Freighter department, with regard to medium and long term freighter and charter operations ensuring operational integrity is maintained while meeting all safety, quality and customer service standards.

  **Conduct charter feasibility assessments including operational constraints, airport capabilities, slots, permits, aircraft suitability and customer requirements.**
* GENERIC (TO ALL 3 AREAS):
* Identify requirements that need to be incorporated into the New Generation Cargo System (NGSC) on an ongoing basis for the effective and efficient management of all freighter and charter related activity prioritising the necessary requirements and emphasising the specific requirements.

  Ascertain and collate all cost data related to freighter and charter operations ensuring that accurate data is captured in the NGSC system.

  Determine the accurate computation of all cost data related to freighter/charter operations within the system and identify and correct any anomalies.

  Provide information on the profitability of all ad-hoc freighter operations, charter operations and diversions ensuring that information related to such operations are communicated to all relevant internal departments.

  **Prepare analysis and reporting on charter performance, operational efficiency and profitability to support management decision-making.**

  Independently handle special projects as directed by Manager Freighter Operations & Charters, Manager Freighter Analysis & Development or Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager.

  The job holder will also be required to undertake special projects related to special ground handling requirements and operational procedures related to new aircraft especially the Boeing 777F and Boeing 747-8F **as well as support special cargo projects, humanitarian charters and strategic charter initiatives.**

##### **Qualification**

**Qualifications & Experience:** Should have good knowledge of IATA regulations, rules and procedures.

Should have completed approved Cargo Acceptance and Handling courses including Special Cargo Handling and Acceptance, Cargo Product Knowledge, Advanced Load Control and Freighter Load Control.

Excellent communication & IT skills.

Should have sound analytical skills.

Title: مهندس أول - الجدولة ومعلومات التنقل
Description:
مهندس أول - الجدولة ومعلومات التنقل - (26003657)

**الوصف الوظيفي**
-----------------

**Job Purpose**
  
Lead development and optimization of public bus schedules, systems, and ensure reliability to deliver efficient, integrated, and customer-focused services across the network. Coordinate stakeholders, data, and innovations so schedule changes, information, and performance continuously meet strategic and operational objectives.

**Roles and Responsibilities**
  
**Strategy**
  

* Develop bus schedules that reflect Public Transport Agency strategic objectives and enable seamless integration with metro and other transit modes in line with defined processes.
* Supervise required reserve ratios of buses and drivers using actual performance data and international best practices to maintain sufficient operational resilience and service continuity.
* Determine requirements for advanced scheduling systems, AI platforms, and related technical programs, leading proofs of concept and roadmaps that enhance network planning, OCC integration, and scheduling capabilities.
* Export error free scheduling system data to technical systems in other departments within the agreed timeline.

**Operations**
  

* Prepare and maintain detailed bus schedules in RTA systems that meet quality standards, stakeholder requirements, and agreed timelines across all public transport lines.
* Ensure concerned departments receive timely notifications of service changes so they can arrange required buses, drivers, maintenance activities, transportation systems updates, and customer service resources.
* Develop and export system technical requirements and operational data for the public transport network to RTA systems.
* Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date information on bus services, including routes, timetables, fares, conditions of carriage, destination boards, and passenger information displays.
* Ensure scheduling system availability, correct security-level user access, and resolution of GIRO scheduling system issues through coordination with IT teams, vendors, and technical committees.
* Coordinate with managers, staff, and representatives on scheduling information, system improvements, administrative tasks, and provide responses to Tarasul letters and CRMrelated matters as required.
* Manage events, manual and unplanned schedule changes by preparing implementation plans and prepare service changes notices.
* Ensure the system availability to the schedulers at the appropriate security level (system user access).
* Deploy scheduling staff and surveyors with bus drivers before and after network changes to inform passengers, brief depots, and gather feedback on diversions, roadworks, and operational issues.

**Product / Process Improvement**
  

* Support to evaluate service reliability by comparing planned and actual running times, conducting field surveys and route recces, and analysing OCC data to recommend improvements and OTP dashboards.
* Update and develop the scheduling system and associated technologies to include geographic maps and bus lines and to support new systems, TSD enhancements, electric buses, and the OCC roadmap.
* Create and maintain public bus network and operations databases in the scheduling system, and provide performance, OTP, and service change reports to PTA stakeholders.
* Coordinate with scheduling system vendor, in case of any difficulties in system performance on its various modules.
* Coordinate with managers, staff, and representatives regarding the provision of scheduling information and system improvements.

**Physical Working Conditions**
  

* Work mainly in an office environment using scheduling systems, with weekly site visits to routes, depots, OCC, and stations for surveys and stakeholder meetings.

-----------------------

**Job Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree/Master’s degree in Engineering
* 1+ years in case of Master's degree (2+ years in case of Bachelor’s degree)

**Technical Competencies**

* Core Engineering Principles
* Survey Design
* Transport Network and Route Design
* Market Research and Benchmarking
* Traffic Engineering and Planning
