Title: Supervisor, Tenancy Management (East Region)
Description:
About Toronto Community Housing Corporation
  
  
Toronto Community Housing Corporation (“TCHC”) is the largest social housing provider in Canada and the second largest in North America. We are wholly owned by the City of Toronto and operate in a non-profit manner. TCHC provides homes to over 41,000 low and moderate-income households in 88 of Toronto's neighbourhoods, with 93,000 tenants from many different backgrounds with a diversity in age, education, language, mental and physical ability, religion, ethnicity and race. We are an essential part of the City of Toronto's fabric and social system.
  
  
Our over 2,000 employees work to achieve our vision of quality homes in vibrant communities where people are proud to live and work.
  
  
**Vacancy Type:** Full-time Temporary
  
**Salary/Hourly Range:** $107,358.63 - $128,830.36
  
**Work Details (Days/Hours):** Monday – Friday 36.25 hours per week
  
Hybrid Eligible No
  
**Affiliation:** Non-Union: Management/Exempt
  
**Contract Length:** Until May 2028
  
Division and Department Tenancy Management East
  
**Number of Vacancies:** 1
  
**Existing/New Job:** Existing
  
**Grade:** 07
  
Vacancy Status Existing Vacancy
  
**Candidate List or Eligibility List:** Candidate List
  
  
What we offer
  
In addition to competitive compensation and a rewarding career where you can truly make a difference, we offer a comprehensive package that meets the various needs of our diverse employees, including:
  

* Ability to participate in inclusive employee-led networks to educate, inspire, amplify voices, build relationships and provide development opportunities;
* Minimum three (3) weeks of paid annual vacation days, increasing with years of service;
* Four (4) paid personal days;
* Defined benefit pension plan with OMERS, includes 100-per-cent employer matching;
* Health and dental benefits, including a health spending account available upon your start date;
* Employee and family assistance program;
* Maternity and parental leave top up (93% of base salary);
* Training and development programs including tuition reimbursement of $1500 per calendar year;
* Fitness membership discount;

Make a difference
  
  
Reporting to the Manager of Tenancy Management, the Supervisor, Tenancy Management is responsible for overseeing the full scope of the day to day tenancy experience within one of our three service regions, including rent determination, arrears administration, eviction prevention, litigation, parking, and access and support services for tenants.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for supervising a team of staff (Tenant Services Coordinator's, Community Services Cooridnator's and Clerks) that help tenants maintain good standing with their housing and that coordinate third party services from a broad range of health, social service and community support providers.
  
  
In this role you will bring your values around creating quality homes in vibrant communities where people are proud to live and work in a manner that supports TCHC's tenant focused culture. Let’s work together to achieve our vision
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Implement service standards and metrics established by the General Manager, in alignment with the Operations Agreement.
* Understand work breakdown structures and hours to complete task to ensure optimal staffing levels are maintained.
* Supervise a team of unionized staff (Tenant Services Coordinator's, Community Services Coordinator's and Clerks) to deliver service that meets the established standards.
* In collaboration with the Manager, Tenancy Management.
* Assist in labour relations matters including grievances and progressive discipline of staff by issuing letter of expectations, verbal and written warnings.
* Implement the accessibility strategy and related processes.
* Oversee the community housing program administration functions including vacancy management, tenant/non-tenant and employee parking, eviction prevention and rent determination.
* Ensure compliance with applicable by-laws, standards and legislative requirements including Residential Tenancies Act, Housing Services Act etc.
* Assist in the Rent Geared to Income (RGI) review process pertaining to rent calculation.
* Provide advice and guidance to front line staff on rent issues, including arrears and litigation.
* Support staff to develop action plans to assist tenants to maintain housing.
* Coordinate the development of action plans to resolve tenancy issues with local staff.
* Provide advice and support conflict resolution between neighbour disputes.
* Assist in resolving tenancy management issues with tenants with complex issues involving multiple barriers such as diminished capacity, physical or intellectual impairments, language and literacy issues, mental health and substance use issues, etc.
* Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Manager.
* Review tenant support partnerships and initiatives, and provide feedback to Manager.
* Maintain creative partnerships and participate in the joint service planning in collaboration with other managers, supervisors, and staff across pillars and regions.
* Adhere to the budget and ensure service delivery is tied to the budget.
* Support the Manager, Tenancy Management by providing input to the region’s operational planning process, development, documentation and implementation of business plans, business cases and initiatives as they relate to tenant support and other services, including parking, Rent-Geared-to-Income (RGI), rent arrears and litigation.
* Assist the Manager in the preparation of funding proposals, business cases and resource development activities in support of tenant support initiatives.
* Review reporting of performance measurement statistics and for areas that are below standard to make suggestions for improvement.
* Implement process improvement initiatives and demonstrate a strong commitment for improving the overall tenant experience.
* Foster an environment of organizational development among frontline staff; participating in coaching and mentoring activities.
* Build and nurture a culture of tenant centric performance excellence through communication, coaching and fair/equitable treatment of staff; promoting a safe, respectful, diverse and inclusive workplace.
* Adhere to established People and Culture policies and procedures.

What you’ll need
  
  

* Completed post-secondary education in Property Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Social Services, Health, Community Development or in a relevant discipline.
* Approximately 5 years of progressive work experience in property management, social services, health, community development or related area.
* Knowledge with annual rent reviews, market rent strategies and principles.
* Demonstrated experience in the coordination of support services, preferably in a housing context.
* Knowledge of the principles, practices and techniques related to the delivery and coordination of tenant and community programs including services for mental health and addictions, seniors, individuals with a history of homelessness and people with special needs.
* Knowledge of the network of health and mental health resources in Toronto, including community-based mental health, supportive housing, community care and long-term care providers.
* Understanding of anti-oppression, human rights, equity and recovery frameworks and proven ability to work effectively with a diverse and vulnerable client population.
* Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse tenant population in difficult situations and resolve sensitive issues.
* Strong listening, verbal communication, writing, conflict resolution and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand complex tenancies and the issues that affect those with social and economic vulnerability, diverse in age, race, sexual orientation, culture and ability.
* Experience working and managing staff in a unionized environment.
* Commitment to providing high quality tenant/customer service
* Knowledge of applicable legislation including Residential Tenancies Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Human Rights Code, Ontario Building Code, Fire Code, Labour Relations Act, Social Housing Reform Act, etc.
* G-License and own vehicle is an asset to travel to various buildings.
* Ability to communicate in a second language is an asset.

What’s next
  
  
Once you apply, we’ll review your resume and contact you if we believe your skills and experience will make you successful in the role. If you are selected to move forward, the process will include one or more interviews and/or assessments and reference checks.
  
  
**Please note:** This temporary position may be extended or become permanent in order to meet business needs. If this occurs, the position may not be reposted.
  
  
Thank you for your interest in Toronto Community Housing
  
  
We recognize that people bring experience and talent that goes beyond the technical skills and requirements of a job. If you possess similar experience that is close to what we’ve included in the job postings below, we encourage you to consider applying. We strongly believe that diverse experience, transferable skills, and passion are key!
  
  
Once you have submitted your application successfully, you will receive a confirmation email. We encourage you to check out our careers page often, as new opportunities become available on a regular basis.
  
  
Our commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion
  
  
We are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and strive to create a diverse workplace that reflects the cultural mosaic of our great city and the communities we serve. We recognize the value that comes from different viewpoints, unique experiences and diverse perspectives of our employees, who bring fresh, new ideas to our business. Diversity plays a key role in our ability to deliver on our mission to provide clean, safe, well-maintained, affordable homes for tenants.
  
  
TCHC is committed to diversity and inclusion within its community and encourages applications from Indigenous peoples, racialized persons/persons of colour, persons with disabilities, women, 2SLGBTQ+ persons, and others who can help us provide vibrant communities and make our city a great place to live. In an effort to ensure access to information for people with disabilities, we have noticed that some screen readers do not function properly with our job portal. If you are a person with a disability and are experiencing issues with our job portal and would like access to our job postings in an alternative format, please email your request to our People and Culture Division at accessibility.hr@torontohousing.ca.
  
  
Accessibility for applicants
  
  
Toronto Community Housing is committed to equity in employment. Our goal is a diverse, inclusive, and barrier-free workplace that reflects the communities we serve.
  
We will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities at all stages of the hiring process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code, the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005, and Toronto Community Housing’s Accessibility Policy.
  
  
If you are a person with a disability and need the job posting in an alternative format or any other accessible accommodations during the hiring process, please email your request to our People & Culture department at Accessibility.HR@torontohousing.ca or call our accessible accommodations line at (416) 981 - 4119. **About TRCA:**  
With more than 60 years of experience, Toronto and Region Conservation Authority (TRCA) is one of 36 Conservation Authorities in Ontario, created to safeguard and enhance the health and well-being of watershed communities through the protection and restoration of the natural environment and the ecological services the environment provides.
  
  
TRCA is considered the provincial leader in conserving, restoring, and managing natural resources to advance safe and sustainable development. Also, TRCA was recently recognized as a Greater Toronto’s Top Employer for 2026 and a Canada’s Greenest Employer for 2026.
  
  
To apply to this posting, click on the “Apply” icon. Please submit your resume and cover letter in one file (PDF or Word) and upload using only the ‘Resume’ feature within the application prior to 11:59 pm on December 1, 2026.
  
  
**How you will contribute as part of the TRCA team:**  
The Education Interpreter delivers hands-on environmental and nature programs to visitors and visitor groups at Tommy Thompson Park. The Education Interpreter also conducts daily park inspections and assists with visitor emergencies, and plays an active role in customer experience ensuring all visitors have a positive experience. The Education Interpreter is comfortable working in a small team, under minimal supervision. Education Interpreters typically work in teams of two on weekends (Saturday and Sunday and holidays, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m./4:30 p.m. (summer/winter)) every other weekend, however, the schedule is flexible and based on staff availability. This is an occasional contract position in the environmental field.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities:**  

* Engages with the public and delivers hands-on interpretation of Tommy Thompson Park history, wildlife, habitats and restoration work. Ensures visitors are well-informed about how to use the park responsibly to maintain public health and safety.
* Greets visitors to the park, communicating permitted activities and trail etiquette.
* Conducts site inspections to identify any major hazards, incidents and issues.
* Addresses injuries and incidents at the park.
* Learns program content to be able to effectively deliver interactive programs to various audiences.
* Ensures program equipment/supplies including artifacts are well maintained, clean and stored appropriately.
* Provides support in program development and administrative tasks as required.
* Incumbents may also be assigned other duties.

Education (degree/diploma/certifications/licenses)
  

* Minimum pursuing a post-secondary diploma or degree in a related field
* Valid Standard First Aid & CPR/AED Level C Certification
* Valid Ontario Class G2 driver's license

Knowledge/Skill/Ability - Competencies
  

* Understanding of Tommy Thompson Park and the area’s flora and fauna.
* Ability to deliver programs/information to audiences of various ages, adapting style to ensure audience appropriateness.
* Ability to communicate effectively with tact and courtesy.
* Experience interacting and connecting with persons of various social, cultural, or economic backgrounds; at ease with a variety of audiences.
* Strong communication skills to provide clear and concise communication in both non-emergency and emergency situations.
* Able to self-manage workload and prioritize tasks independently.
* Demonstrates responsiveness to internal and external customer requests and needs.
* Able to comprehend written documentation and procedural guidelines.
* Must be flexible to work all required shifts, including weekends and holidays.

**What TRCA has to offer you:**  
As part of a progressive team you will have the opportunity to make a positive impact to preserving and protecting nature, while maintaining a balance between the natural environment and built environment. Working with experts within our field, you will join a team of colleagues that are committed to TRCA’s core values by demonstrating the following behaviours; integrity, collaboration, accountability, respect, and excellence (icare).

* Makes a positive difference in the communities we serve.
* Fosters high performance and collaborative teams.
* Provides continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits program (including Defined Benefit Pension Plan – OMERS/OTPP).
* Pregnancy & Parental Leave Top-Up Program.
* Provides unique TRCA Perks.
* Offers potential for career growth and advancement.

TRCA is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Our goal is to attract, develop and retain highly talented employees from diverse backgrounds, allowing us to benefit from a wide variety of experiences and perspectives. The Toronto Center for Liver Disease (TCLD) is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator I (CRC I). The CRC I will work with studies that involve regulatory approval from Health Canada. The successful candidate will be responsible for ethics submissions, regulatory oversight and will support and monitor project progress against metrics, timelines, and plans. Furthermore, they will actively identify and resolve issues affecting timely and successful completion of projects, and escalate issues to the Research Finance Manager and PI of the TCLD.

**Duties**

* Serve as the primary lead for project implementation, ensuring alignment with project objectives and stakeholder needs.
* Manage all phases of the project lifecycle in collaboration with the Principal Investigator (PI), Research Finance Manager, and key stakeholders.

* Present project updates, key milestones, and recommendations to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support project success and engagement.
* Identify project risks, issues, and mitigation strategies, providing recommendations to project leadership.
* Support grant applications and manage multiple concurrent priorities within a fast-paced research environment.
* Lead regulatory and Research Ethics Board (REB) submissions, regulatory compliance activities, participant recruitment, informed consent, and site coordination.
* Coordinate study operations, including participant visits, data collection, sample processing, monitoring/audits, and functional supervision of staff, while ensuring compliance with UHN policies and ICH/GCP standards.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree, or recognized equivalent, in a health or science-related discipline
* Holds recognized certification in clinical research (e.g. ACRP)
* At least three (3) years clinical and/or professional experience required
* Minimum 1 year clinical research experience required
* Experience with investigator-initiated multicentre studies an asset
* Experience with Health Canada an asset
* Experience in management of research ethics (REB) submissions internationally and locally (required)
* Knowledge of research regulations and guidelines preferred (such as ICH/GCP, Tri-Council Policy, Declaration of Helsinki, FDR, CFR and Health Canada TPD required
* Project planning, management, and implementation experience

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Title: Client Consulting Analyst
Description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Title: Senior Systems Engineer - Enterprise Services
Description:
The Senior Systems Engineer – Enterprise Services is responsible for the administration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based technology solutions across ZainTECH's customer environments. The role ensures the availability, performance, security, and reliability of critical infrastructure services while providing advanced technical support and maintaining operational standards in accordance with customer requirements and industry best practices.

Working closely with customers, technical delivery teams, Project Managers, and other infrastructure specialists, the Senior Systems Engineer supports the full lifecycle of enterprise infrastructure solutions, including deployment, configuration, migration, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance. The role also contributes to infrastructure improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer to ensure effective service delivery and long-term operational stability.

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Infrastructure Administration & Operations

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based systems across customer environments.
* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly operational activities to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of critical infrastructure services.
* Monitor system health, capacity, and performance, proactively identifying and addressing potential operational issues.
* Implement and maintain system configurations, security controls, and operational procedures in accordance with established best practices.
* Support the administration of enterprise infrastructure services, ensuring secure and reliable access for authorized users.
* Perform preventive maintenance, system updates, and routine operational checks to minimize service disruptions.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

* Provide advanced technical support to enterprise customers through on-site and remote troubleshooting.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve infrastructure incidents, system failures, and performance-related issues.
* Support major customer accounts through proactive technical engagement, issue resolution, and ongoing service improvement.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including Active Directory, Exchange Server, Microsoft 365, virtualization, and cloud services.
* Escalate complex technical issues to relevant specialists or vendors where required, ensuring appropriate follow-up and resolution.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to customer IT teams to support effective system administration and operational continuity.

Infrastructure Implementation & Migration

* Install, configure, deploy, and integrate enterprise infrastructure solutions in accordance with approved technical designs and customer requirements.
* Implement Microsoft infrastructure technologies, including identity services, messaging platforms, virtualization, and cloud-based solutions.
* Support and supervise infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and system modernization activities while minimizing disruption to customer operations.
* Configure and optimize infrastructure environments to meet performance, availability, and security requirements.
* Coordinate implementation activities with Project Managers, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
* Validate infrastructure configurations and ensure deployed solutions meet agreed technical specifications and operational requirements.

Microsoft Cloud & Enterprise Services

* Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services, identity management, authentication, and access control solutions.
* Support Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and associated collaboration technologies.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization environments and related infrastructure services.
* Support Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Azure AD Connect, Active Directory Federation Services (ADFS), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Administer Microsoft Azure infrastructure services, including virtual machines, virtual networks, storage accounts, and related cloud resources.
* Support Microsoft Intune, information protection, and enterprise mobility and security capabilities.
* Implement and maintain monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery solutions using Microsoft Azure and associated technologies.

Testing, Documentation & Reporting

* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, implementation records, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Document infrastructure changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure accurate technical records.

* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance infrastructure performance, security, and service delivery quality.

Title: Customer Delivery Software Architect
Description:
**About The Role**
Cisco Customer Experience (CX) is seeking a Customer Delivery Software Architect to lead the design and delivery of automation and AI-enabled solutions for a major service provider in Saudi Arabia.
  
  
You will define scalable software architectures that connect network infrastructure, operational systems, data platforms, and business workflows. Working with customer stakeholders and cross-functional Cisco teams, you will translate complex operational needs into secure, reusable, and maintainable solutions.
  
  
This is a software architecture role—not a network migration or product implementation role. Its primary focus is establishing sound architecture, engineering practices, integration patterns, and governance for network automation and intelligent operations.
  
  
Frequent onsite collaboration in Riyadh is required due to customer access controls, local testing requirements, and the need to work closely with engineering and operations teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end software architecture for network automation, orchestration, assurance, observability, and AI-enabled operational solutions.
* Translate business and operational requirements into architecture blueprints, technical roadmaps, integration patterns, data models, APIs, and engineering backlogs.
* Design secure, modular, scalable solutions integrating network platforms with systems such as Cisco Crosswork.
* Establish engineering standards covering source control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, release management, security, and software lifecycle governance.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design and delivery, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring implementations meet functional and non-functional requirements.
* Leads and influences global, cross-functional teams—including PMs, PgMs, SDMs, CEs, TLs, and customer stakeholders—to ensure successful delivery of complex, multi-architecture solutions aligned to business outcomes
* Define practical approaches for applying AI and analytics to use cases such as anomaly detection, operational insight, decision support, and workflow automation.
* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices while mentoring engineers and strengthening software architecture capabilities across delivery teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 12 or more years of relevant experience; master’s degree with 8 or more years; PhD with 5 or more years; or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade software, automation, orchestration, or systems-integration solutions.
* Strong proficiency in software architecture principles, distributed systems, API design, event-driven architectures, data modelling, and integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with Python or a comparable programming language, APIs, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and modern development practices.
* Experience architecting solutions that integrate network infrastructure, operational platforms, telemetry, data, and business workflows.
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and their practical application to automation, analytics, and operational use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional engineering teams and communicate effectively with tech.hnical and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with Cisco NSO or comparable orchestration platforms, including service modelling, lifecycle management, device integration and reusable automation components.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in telecommunications, service-provider, or other large-scale, mission-critical environments.
* Knowledge of network orchestration, assurance, observability, and automation platforms, including Cisco Crosswork.
* Experience establishing engineering governance and reusable automation frameworks across multiple teams.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, streaming technologies, data platforms, and AIOps.
* Understanding of responsible AI, data governance, model lifecycle management, and security-by-design.
* Experience mentoring software engineers and helping organizations adopt modern software-engineering practices.
* Nature of work: Onsite Full time
* Hours of work: 48 hours per week
* Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.
* Application start and end date: 27th October for 4-5 weeks

**Why This Role Matters**
This role will shape the software foundations for scalable network automation and intelligent operations. The successful candidate will combine architecture leadership with practical engineering expertise, helping transform automation into secure, reusable capabilities that deliver sustained operational value.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

**The Role**

  

As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.

Title: Terminal Operations Supervisor

Responsibilities include executing service level failures mitigation plans, monitoring critical systems, responding to calls, and conducting terminal and safety inspections. It further includes oversight of security, safety, guest experience and facilities-related contract management. Is responsible of ensuring compliance with the rules and regulations of government agencies as well as those of the terminal. This position has a special emphasis on airside activity overseeing ramp operations and ensuring safe movements of aircraft by directing aircraft by two-way radio. This role reports to the Manager, Terminal Operations and requires a high degree of initiative, sound judgment, operational excellence, and leadership.

  
Responsibilities:

**Major Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Working with personnel and programs to enhance the airport terminal and curbside operations, ensuring safe and efficient flow of passengers through the terminal facilities while promoting a world-class guest experience.
* Establishes strong working relationships and effective liaisons with all stakeholders, including airlines, tenants, business partners and government agencies.
* Conducts regular inspection tours of the entire facility for appearance, safety, staffing, security, and maintenance while encouraging Terminal B brand standards are adhered to.
* Utilizes the terminal inspection program, performance measurement tools and standards to improve overall performance and guest experience. Continually monitors and analyzes data on area of responsibility and makes recommendations on process improvement.
* Monitors site systems, assesses trends, investigates abnormalities, and may coordinate corrective action.
* Generate and track work orders in Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
* Directs and monitors daily performance of company subcontractors.
* Supports Terminal B rules and regulations by reinforcing the Terminal B Breach of Rules program (TBBOR).
* Directs guest service efforts of partners and subcontractors during periods of irregular operations.
* Supports the snow team during winter operations. Terminal Operations Supervisor

Responds to incidents/accidents, conducts investigations as necessary, and prepares medical/Incident reports.

* Coordinates with the Port Authority, airlines, tenants, and operations personnel in emergency situations.
* Maintains a daily log of terminal activities including issues or concerns that may require follow up.
* Building the daily gate, check-in counter, claim device and outbound baggage schedules for maximum efficiency.
* Monitors daily allocation of common-use resources; troubleshooting scheduling conflicts as they arise while maintaining a strong focus on guest experience.
* Controls the safe movement of aircraft on the apron area, ensuring safe sequencing and separation as indicated in the Terminal B Apron Management Plan.
* Operates two-way radio system to direct aircraft movement on Terminal B apron area. Including but not limited to, aircraft pushbacks, approved taxi routes, ground delay advisories, any construction advisories and/or emergency situations.
* Prepares various reports for internal and external stakeholders as required.
* Communicate effectively to ensure priorities are understood and acted upon, with clear turnover for continuity across shifts.
* Assists the operations management team with the onboarding and training of newly hired team members.
* Acts in the position of On-Duty Terminal Operations Manager if required.
* Perform all other duties as required.

* Terminal operations and/or guest experience background preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated focus on continuous improvement.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and multi-task, function effectively in intermittently high-pressure environment.
* Strong decision-making skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with others to solve issues.
* Excellent computer, written/oral communication skills.
* Proven relationship management skills with internal and external stakeholders.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Experience in an aviation/airport setting or guest experience.
* Experience working effectively in a regulated environment.
* Knowledgeable in airport airside and terminal operations.
* Facility/property management knowledge

Title: Operations Controller
Description:
About the Company:

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that's shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.

About the Role:

When the unexpected happens, are you ready to make that critical call which keeps the network moving?

Central to this key role is your ability to execute day-of-operations network control for assigned flights, missions or regions within the published IOCC control  
window, under the operational control of the IOCC Shift Manager and day-to-day guidance of the Senior Operations Controller.

A core part of the role is monitoring the flying program, aircraft rotations, and operational systems to identify emerging risks early. Material issues must be escalated promptly so the right decisions can be made at pace.

Working closely with internal teams, stations, handling partners, and external agencies, the role coordinates approved actions from operational readiness to flight completion. This includes managing delays, cancellations, diversions, technical events, weather disruption, and airport or airspace constraints.

With responsibility for operational data integrity, this position ensures flight movements, aircraft assignments, delays, remarks, and event records are updated accurately in real time. The role also supports stakeholder notifications, handovers, operational reports, and aircraft allocation information in line with approved procedures.

You can expect to help coordinate slots, landing permissions, overflight permissions, and related approvals when operational changes require them. The position also supports special operations such as positioning flights, aircraft deliveries, inaugural services, charters, training activity, and functional check flights.

*At the center of a fast-moving operation, your judgment, precision, and calm coordination will help keep our network resilient every day.*

About You:

Diploma qualified at minimum, you will demonstrate a minimum of 4 years of experience in airline operations within an IOCC/OCC, network control, flight dispatch, crew control, operations planning, airport operations, or a comparable environment.

We’d love to hear from you even more if you have possession of a valid Flight Dispatcher License.

You will bring strong operational monitoring, disruption recovery, and prioritisation skills, along with clear communication, sound procedural discipline, systems confidence, and excellent attention to detail under pressure.

This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.

Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

Title: Project Principal Consultant
Description:
**Job Description**
What you'll bring
  
  
You have more than ten years of core SAP project and program management experience and a proven record of leading at least five large programs, each involving teams of more than twenty people for six months or longer. You are a career program manager rather than a solution or functional lead moving into project management, and you have owned at least three engagements with budgets of USD 2 million or more. Your experience includes recent delivery in the Middle East and work in at least one of the Oil and Gas, Utilities or FMCG industries, supported by functional knowledge across at least two S/4HANA areas such as Finance, Supply Chain or Human Resources. You have delivered at least two cloud projects using platforms such as SuccessFactors, Ariba or CX and have acted as a trusted advisor on partner-led implementations.
  
  
You can demonstrate practical examples of using AI in SAP delivery or project management, while applying responsible practices for privacy, confidentiality and human review. You hold PMP or an equivalent qualification, SAP Activate Project Manager certification and certification in at least one major SAP module. SAP Business AI, SAP BTP or SAP Joule enablement, an Agile qualification, experience with RISE with SAP and cloud migrations, and exposure to SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Signavio or process mining strengthen your fit. You communicate fluently in English, with Arabic capability considered an advantage, and you are confident working with C-level executives, large multi-party teams, enterprise project management tools and commercially binding project documentation.
  
  
What you'll build
  
  
You will lead large, complex SAP S/4HANA and cloud programs for major enterprises across the Middle East, taking accountability from inception through on-time and on-budget completion. You will plan and control scope, schedule, resources, cost, quality and people, lead quality assurance gate reviews in line with SAP Activate, and keep decisions, records and documentation audit-ready. You will establish effective governance, manage steering committees and drive the decisions needed to keep delivery on track, while advising customer sponsors, project teams and partners and handling status, risk and escalations directly with senior executives.
  
  
You will align with SAP product management where roadmap items affect scope or timelines. Commercially, you will own forecasts, margin, change requests and large project budgets, apply statements of work, order forms and contract terms throughout delivery, and produce clear management reporting for internal and customer audiences. You will also position and deliver SAP Business AI use cases, including SAP Joule and embedded AI across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors and Ariba. This includes assessing customer readiness across data quality, process maturity, security and change impact, using AI to improve reporting, meeting records, RAID analysis, document review and test planning, and coaching teams and partners to use AI safely and practically.
  
  
Where you belong
  
  
You will be part of SAP Services and Delivery for Middle East South, based in Dubai with regional travel, and will provide leadership across complex customer, partner and SAP delivery environments. The role relies on your ability to act as a trusted advisor, bring structure to high-stakes transformation programs and motivate large, multi-party teams while maintaining precise communication and documentation. You will combine strategic judgement with commercial discipline, using tools such as MS Project, Jira and SAP Cloud ALM to sustain delivery control. You will also help teams distinguish where AI can create practical value and where established programme controls and human judgement remain essential. If you are motivated by leading some of the region's largest SAP transformations and want to raise the predictability, quality and pace of delivery, this role offers the opportunity to do so at scale.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Project Management
* Customer Orientation
* Project Implementation
* Conflict Management
* Project Planning and Implementation
* Business Acumen
* Influencing skills
* AI Adoption Capability

Additional Information
  
  
**About SAP**
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.
  
  
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.
  
  
We win with inclusion
  
  
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. **Introduction**

Women’s College Hospital (WCH) is seeking a dynamic, inspiring and visionary medical leader to lead the Department of Medicine and join the medical leadership team. The Department Head will advance innovative models of specialized ambulatory care and strengthen academic, interprofessional, and interorganizational collaboration to improve access, quality and health outcomes for women and gender-diverse people.

The Department Head will report to the Hospital President & CEO through the Vice President, Medical Affairs & System Transformation and Lead Medical Executive. The Department Head is responsible for aligning the Department of Medicine’s clinical, academic and research activities with the Hospital’s strategy, in partnership with the Clinical Director for Specialized Medicine programs. The Department Head works collaboratively with the Temerty Faculty of Medicine, the Toronto Academic Health Science Network (TAHSN), partner hospitals, and the Women’s College Hospital Foundation leadership team.

**The Department of Medicine**

The Department of Medicine at WCH advances the practice and science of medicine through holistic, innovative, and interprofessional approaches to complex health conditions and distinctive models of specialized ambulatory care. The Department advances care for conditions that disproportionately affect women and special populations, including through the specialized Dermatology, Menopause and After Cancer Treatment Transition Clinics.

The Department includes approximately 150 physician faculty members, including clinician teachers, educators, quality and innovation leaders, clinician investigators and clinician scientists. Its Specialized Medicine programs bring together nursing and health discipline professionals as well as clinical and academic administrative staff.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

The Department Head will lead the clinical, academic and resource oversight of the WCH Department of Medicine. More specifically, the Department Head will:

* Provide visionary leadership and operational oversight of the Department to advance the Hospital’s strategic plan and delivery of high-quality, equitable and integrated specialized ambulatory care.
* Build and lead a team of dedicated medical professionals committed to excellence in clinical care, clinical innovation, and continuous quality improvement through physician engagement and collaborative leadership.
* Pursue excellence and represent WCH in academic medicine by advancing the educational, research and scholarly objectives of the Temerty Faculty of Medicine.
* Participate actively in WCH medical leadership.
* Grow existing and build new partnerships to advocate for and advance the goals of WCH beyond its walls.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

The successful candidate will be:

* A Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of Canada or equivalent, eligible for medical licensure in Ontario, and for an academic appointment at the rank of Associate or Full Professor in the Temerty Faculty of Medicine.
* An individual with a demonstrated record of supporting others engaged in education, research and creative professional activity, in addition to having their own strong record of scholarship.
* A dynamic, compassionate and people-oriented leader, who demonstrates an empathetic, trusting, and responsive demeanor, with strong mentorship skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate strategically, engage physicians and lead change collaboratively and with accountability.
* An individual experienced in interprofessional models of care and committed to interprofessional education and patient care.
* A person with a strong commitment to social justice, equity and the health of women, gender-diverse people and equity-seeking communities, both locally and globally.
* A person with demonstrated fiscal management and resource stewardship skills, with an emphasis on linking quality outcomes with optimizing costs.

  

**EXPECTATIONS & TERM**

The successful candidate will be an outstanding academic leader and clinician, with proven excellence in managing complex health care environments. Candidates should have a deep commitment to scholarly enterprise, with experience in advancing peer-reviewed research and education in Medicine.

Salary for the role of Department Head will reflect an expected 2.5 days per week commitment, in addition to clinical compensation and other academic support based, in part, on fee-for-service billings and sessional fees.

**Posting Number:** #2186

**Position Title:** EMS Education Manager

The Public Health Institute (PHI) is an independent, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting health, well-being, and quality of life for people throughout California, across the nation and around the world. As one of the largest and most comprehensive public health organizations in the nation, we are at the forefront of research and innovations to improve the efficacy of public health statewide, nationally, and internationally.

PHI was distinguished as one of the top 50 “Best Non-Profit Organizations to Work For” by the Non-Profit Times in a national search.

  

##### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Bridge Center (Bridge) at the Public Health Institute (PHI) works across the health care system to expand access to low-barrier addiction treatment and sexual and reproductive health care, and to advance health equity. Since 2019, CA Bridge has supported more than 290 hospitals to implement medications for addiction treatment (MAT) in the emergency department (ED) based on the CA Bridge model for 24/7 low-barrier access to evidence-based care. Since then, Bridge has trained teams in 22 states, 56 EDs, and 6 EMS agencies. Collectively, they reach 2,181 providers whose EDs see nearly 2.5 million patient visits a year.

EMS Bridge extends low-barrier MAT to paramedics, bringing EMS-initiated buprenorphine to communities across the country, including in California. The National Expansion Project builds capacity for emergency department-based MAT across the country; the ED Syphilis/HIV/HCV Screening Program supports emergency departments in implementing routine opt-out screening and linkage to care; and Access Bridge increases access to contraception and treatment for pregnancy emergencies from the ED.

##### **POSITION OVERVIEW**

Bridge is hiring an EMS Education Manager to work with our EMS Bridge team. EMS Bridge began in California, which remains home to our largest EMS program and much of our ongoing EMS research and implementation work, and now supports EMS agencies in other states. The EMS Education Manager will lead day-to-day planning, coordination, and delivery of EMS Bridge education, training, and technical assistance for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders. Additionally, this role will lead the development and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge curricula, run EMS Bridge learning collaboratives, and support grant reporting on training and technical assistance activities. Strong project management expertise will be necessary in these tasks. The successful candidate will bring direct experience as a paramedic or EMT and as an EMS educator and will work with a range of team members and external partners to support EMS agencies to offer buprenorphine and connection to ongoing care for people with opioid use disorder.

The full salary range for this position: $79,333 to $115,098 per year. The typical hiring range for this position is from $79,333 (minimum) to $97,216 (midpoint). The starting salary is determined based on the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and budget availability.

Employment Type: Full Time

* This is a regular full-time 1.0 FTE position with a schedule of 40 hours per week.

* The selected candidate will determine their work schedule in collaboration with their supervisor and is expected to be available during core business hours (9:00am – 2:00pm Pacific Time). * This position is open to applicants nationwide.
* **To apply, please submit a resume and cover letter detailing your interest in and qualifications for this position.**

##### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following:**

##### **EMS Training & Technical Assistance**

* Under the direction of the National & EMS Program Director, lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of trainings for paramedics and EMTs, in person and virtually, including initial buprenorphine trainings, refreshers, case reviews, and scenario-based sessions.

  + Fostering opportunities for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators to learn from one another and build professional connections across agencies and regions.
* Partner with EMS educators, training officers, and agency leaders to build their capacity to teach EMS Bridge content within their own agencies.
* Provide individualized and group mentorship to field providers and EMS educators participating in Bridge programming, drawing on direct experience as a paramedic or EMT and as an EMS educator.
* Assess the training and technical assistance needs of field providers and participating agencies and identify appropriate strategies, resources, and subject matter experts to address those needs.
* Alongside other members of the EMS Bridge team, provide technical assistance related to implementing EMS-initiated buprenorphine, including protocol rollout, field workflows, documentation, patient engagement, crew buy-in and addressing stigma, and handoffs and linkage to care with emergency departments and community treatment programs.

* Track participation and capture feedback and testimonials from trainings, site visits, and learning collaboratives.
* Represent the Bridge Center’s EMS training and technical assistance work at meetings, trainings, EMS conferences, and other events as requested.

##### **Curriculum & Educational Resource Development**

* Under the direction of the National & EMS Program Director, support development, adaptation, and ongoing improvement of EMS Bridge training curricula and educational resources for paramedics, EMTs, and EMS educators.
* Develop practical, accessible training materials and resources, including presentations, facilitator guides, case scenarios, skills and simulation activities, job aids, quick-reference tools, and other educational products.
* Collaborate with Bridge clinical experts and other subject matter experts to translate clinical guidance and evidence into practical educational materials for field providers.
* Coordinate subject matter expert review of curricula and resources to ensure materials are accurate, relevant, consistent with Bridge’s approach, and appropriate for EMS audiences.
* Support processes for offering continuing education credit for EMS Bridge trainings, where applicable.
* Incorporate participant feedback, implementation experience, emerging evidence, and changes in the EMS and substance use care landscape into ongoing curriculum and resource improvements.

##### **Project Management & Reporting**

* Manage the day-to-day implementation of assigned EMS training, technical assistance, learning collaborative, and curriculum-development activities from planning through completion.
* Maintain and support the development of project workplans, timelines, milestones, and deliverable trackers to ensure activities remain on schedule.

* Support grant reporting by preparing training and technical assistance data, narratives, and site summaries in line with funder deliverables.

Perform other duties as assigned.

* Five years’ work experience, including at least one year of experience as a paramedic or EMT, and experience teaching or training others in EMS and/or other clinical settings
* Bachelor’s degree; or high school diploma and an additional four years of relevant work experience, or associate’s degree and an additional two years of relevant work experience.

* Strong training and presentation skills, and ability to facilitate and engage small and large groups of field providers in dialogue and learning.
* Experience developing training curricula and materials for EMS providers.

  + Transformer (bank) differential and restricted earth fault protection
  + Bus differential schemes
  + Breaker protection, breaker failure, and transfer trip schemes
  + Generator and motor protection systems

  + Electromechanical, solid state, and microprocessor-based relays and networked protection systems

* Proficiency with relay test equipment (e.g., Omicron, Doble, Megger or equivalent test sets).
* Experience with relay settings software for major relay manufacturers.

* Experience with SCADA integration and control system troubleshooting.
* Competency in Microsoft Office and Windows-based software platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and field tasks efficiently.

Field-based work with exposure to varying environmental conditions.
